links.title: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: proposes decision-theoretic framework decomposing LLM decision loss into belief formation and belief-to-action components, evaluated on a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth
Section 3: defines R_total = R_belief + R_opt with normalization M(ℓ), distinguishing reported, optimal, and belief-implied actions

Section 6: three domains (synthetic, HailFinder weather, SimSUM clinical), nine threshold loss functions, Qwen3-8B base with separate LoRA adapters per strategy trained via GRPO with eight sampled completions
Appendix E Tables 1-3: intervention deltas vs base with 95% bootstrap CIs; e.g., belief-only ΔR_belief = -0.125±0.014 (HailFinder, independent), decision-only ΔR_total = -0.184±0.019 (HailFinder)

Section 7: claims belief-only training improves beliefs without transferring to decisions; decision-only learns shortcut bypassing belief formation; joint training format-dependent, consistent with tables
Appendix I Table 4: interventions trained on τ∈{0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8} generalize to held-out thresholds with small gaps
Appendix H: reference sensitivity analysis showing mean normalized total regret decreases 18% at d=3 and 25% at d=5 when using empirical frequency instead of true posterior
Discussion: acknowledges single base model for RL, binary-only states, and possible elicitation distortion of reported beliefs
Reproducibility statement: 'All source code will be available on GitHub' - future availability claim only
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic LLM methodology paper: decision-theoretic evaluation of LLM probabilistic reasoning plus targeted RL post-training (Section 5), matching LLM, reasoning, RL/alignment, and evaluation preferences. The regret decomposition R_total = R_belief + R_opt (Section 3) is a clean, well-motivated contribution that differs from prior belief-action coherence work by endowing utility functions and using known reference posteriors (Section 2). Rigor is high: controlled synthetic benchmark with known ground truth (Section 4), matched training controls (same base checkpoint, LoRA+GRPO, Section 6), bootstrap 95% CIs (Appendix E), and three ablations (elicited vs revealed beliefs Appendix G; posterior-reference sensitivity Appendix H; held-out thresholds Appendix I). Evidence is quantitative and consistent with claims: belief-only reduces R_belief (e.g., -0.125±0.014 HailFinder, Table 2) with limited transfer to total regret under independent format; decision-only improves actions without belief gains, supporting the shortcut-policy finding. Weaknesses: RL experiments use a single base model (Qwen3-8B) and binary outcomes (Discussion), some effect sizes are modest (synthetic ΔR_total ≈ -0.03 to -0.06, Table 1), the weather/clinical tasks inherit external benchmarks rather than contributing domain methods, and code availability is only a future claim (Reproducibility statement).

primary_link.title: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize prob
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常被期待作為在不確定性下進行機率推理的決策助理。本文提出一套以統計決策理論為基礎的診斷框架,將模型的總懊悔分解為兩個成分:信念損失(報告的機率偏離貝氏最佳後驗)與最佳化殘差(未依明確給定的損失函數選出最佳行動)。作者以真實後驗已知的合成基準,檢視 GPT-5.5、Gemini、Claude、Llama、Qwen 等前沿與開源模型,發現簡單任務上信念與行動幾乎完美對齊;任務變難時懊悔主要源自信念損失,而未能遵循損失函數的模型則以最佳化殘差為主。研究進一步以 Qwen3-8B 搭配 LoRA 與 GRPO,在合成資料、天氣預報(HailFinder)與臨床推理(SimSUM)三個領域比較四種 RL 介入:僅信念訓練、僅決策訓練、分離多工訓練與序列對齊訓練。主要結果顯示:單一目標訓練只改善被訓練的成分,效益未必轉移到其他成分;僅決策訓練可能學到繞過信念形成的捷徑策略,其優勢在雙輪評估下大幅縮小;聯合訓練可同時改善兩者,但序列對齊訓練需要評估格式與訓練流程相符才有效,分離多工訓練則對格式較穩健;各介入對未見過的損失函數閾值仍能泛化。限制包括僅探討二元狀態與行動、口語報告的信念可能受引出方式扭曲,以及 RL 實驗僅使用單一基底模型。此框架為嚴謹診斷與改善 LLM 在明確決策成本下的機率推理提供了可量化、可控的基礎工具,對醫療等高風險應用尤具意義。
papers.title: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models

links.title: Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation from Off-the-Shelf Teachers

evidence: Abstract: GC-OPD improves mean success over vanilla OPD from 24.70% to 48.78% on ScienceWorld (4B), 53.36% to 85.26% on ALFWorld Unseen, and 29.10% to 37.65% on WebShop with the same original teachers.
Table 1(a): ScienceWorld 1.7B GC-OPD 46.18±1.13 SR exceeds the strongest GRPO-teacher baseline (Vanilla OPD 38.70±0.46); 4B GC-OPD 48.78±0.58 vs 46.66±0.36.

Table 2(a) ablations (ScienceWorld 1.7B): Hindsight-only 31.64%, Minimum-prefix 33.70%, GC success-only 43.68%, full GC 46.18% — isolating contributions of hindsight, graph retrieval, and failed records.
Section 4.1: 'Each trained model is evaluated with four inference seeds at temperature 0.4'; Figure 1(a) caption: '305 tasks, one seed per checkpoint' — no multi-seed training variance reported.
Table 1(b): GC-OPD entries under the Qwen3-32B GRPO teacher condition for ALFWorld are dashes, so the off-the-shelf-vs-GRPO claim is not tested with a GRPO scoring teacher there.
Appendix B.2: state descriptors are environment-specific (ScienceWorld physical-configuration hash, ALFWorld PDDL facts hash, WebShop page/ASIN hashing), requiring manual design per environment.
Appendix C Table 6: K16 collection costs 212.48 GPU-h vs GRPO teacher training 1,169.28 GPU-h; GC-OPD student training 68.79 GPU-h vs vanilla OPD 47.31 GPU-h, supporting the efficiency claim.

Section 3.3 / Appendix B.3: teacher context retains at most one successful and one failed complete source per scored decision with source identities and anchors; full Algorithm B.3 and Table 5 hyperparameters (AdamW, lr 1e-5, clip 0.2, batch 32) are provided.
Title page: code released at https://github.com/hanyi2021/GC_OPD; Appendix A.1 gives model revisions (e.g., Qwen3.5-0.8B at 2fc06364715b).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to top-weighted preferences (LLM agents, on-policy distillation, RL-based teacher training). The method is an incremental but substantive contribution: a source-preserving execution graph that retrieves complete successful/failed records to condition a frozen teacher's token-level scoring, addressing student trajectory divergence. Rigor is strong on baselines (TCOD-B2F/F2B, FTB, TurnOPD under two teacher conditions), ablations (hindsight-only, minimum-prefix, success-only, K budget, generator/scorer swaps), and cost accounting, but weakened by single training runs, SD over only four inference seeds, one-seed validation curves, and missing GC-OPD cells under the GRPO teacher on ALFWorld (dashes in Table 1b). Evidence is detailed and mostly self-consistent (case study probability shift, pass@16 reference, GPU-hour tables), though baseline reproductions are the authors' own. Generalizability is limited by hand-crafted environment-specific state descriptors (Appendix B.2). Reproducibility is good: code link, full hyperparameters, algorithm, and model revisions.

primary_link.title: Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation from Off-the-Shelf Teachers

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains compact language agents with teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories. In multi-turn tasks, compounding errors can move students beyond the teacher's effective supervision. We introduce Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation (GC-OPD), which enriches an off-the-shelf teacher's scoring context with execution evidence. A graph indexes repeated teacher executions by shared states while preserving complete successful and failed histories. After ea
papers.summary_zh: 本論文改良多回合任務的 on-policy 蒸餾（OPD）：小型代理在自身取樣的軌跡上接受教師回饋，但錯誤會累積，使學生超出教師的有效監督範圍；且既有方法常需以 GRPO 等強化學習訓練任務專用教師，成本高昂。作者提出 GC-OPD，不修改教師參數，先以原始 OPD 熱身，再把教師的重複執行紀錄（含成功與失敗的完整歷史）以共享狀態定位器建為圖索引。學生每完成一回合，系統依當前狀態檢索可比對的成功參考；若無，則回溯較早學生狀態作為歷史錨點，結合學生事後檢視（hindsight）與至多一則成功、一則失敗的完整來源紀錄，供凍結教師為學生原始思考—行動 token 評分，僅更新學生。實驗顯示 ScienceWorld 上 4B 學生成功率由 24.70% 升至 48.78%，ALFWorld Unseen 由 53.36% 升至 85.26%，WebShop 由 29.10% 升至 37.65%；相同學生規模下，平均成功率超越所有受評估的 GRPO 教師基線，且平均互動回合更少。消融實驗證實圖檢索、歷史錨點與失敗紀錄皆有貢獻。限制包括需為每個任務預先收集多次執行的離線資料庫，狀態描述子與比對規則依環境而定，且來源涵蓋率未必反映蒸餾成效。本研究證明豐富教師的評分情境可取代昂貴的教師參數最佳化：總量測成本 281.27 GPU 小時，遠低於 GRPO 教師路線的 1,216.59，部署時亦不需呼叫教師或圖檢索。

links.title: Delta-Matching: Closing the Final Gap of Native 8-bit Training for LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'Delta-Matching matches BF16/FP32 mixed-precision training loss and overall downstream performance' and 'We will release our implementation, trained models, and data recipes' (release promised, not yet available).

Section 3.4, Eq. 4–5: proves δ_i^matched = Σ_j P_ij dP̂_ij restores the zero-row-sum invariant under stated numerical assumptions; explicitly builds on 'the direct backward correction (Qiu and Yao, 2026)'.
Section 4.2, Table 1(a): Delta-Matching validation CE 1.4162±0.0006 vs BF16/FP32 1.4178±0.0004; naive stale-delta FP8 1.8970±0.0296; consistent-dO intermediate 1.4667±0.0175 (two seeds).
Section 4.5, Table 4: at 5.29B parameters, naive FP8 CE 1.9327 vs BF16/FP32 1.3349 (RULER-8K 53.5→16.3), Delta-Matching 1.3374±0.0005, demonstrating scale-dependent degradation onset.

Section 4.6: stale-delta loss gap exceeds 0.01 only after ~19,000 steps during 8K-to-64K context extension; Table 5 shows one of two cuDNN/TE FP8 seeds diverged, supporting the error-accumulation claim while noting the confound from the step-18,000 corpus expansion and TE amplitude-history reset.
Appendix C.1, Table 10: instrumented kernel probes show stale-delta pre-cast row-sum residuals 1.1×10⁻²–4.7×10⁻² vs Delta-Matching 1.4×10⁻⁷–7.1×10⁻⁷, rising to 2.7×10⁻³–3.4×10⁻³ after FP8 casting.

Appendix A.4 (Limitations): admits experiments reach only 5.29B/30B tokens, no quantitative law predicting degradation onset, single-initialization Muon study, and timing measurements that 'are not like-for-like training-step comparisons' (Appendix C.2).

Appendix C.5: some architectures (2.58B pure-GQA, Mamba-2/GQA) conceal severe gain corruption (max gain product 878.9/404.1 vs ~2–4 for references) behind near-reference loss — an honest negative-control discussion.

Appendices B.1–B.6: detailed data recipes (Nemotron-CC v2.1 subsets, Llama-2 tokenizer, 0.02 validation holdout), optimizer schedules, precision scopes (Table 7), and full FP8 kernel numerics enabling independent reimplementation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-training-efficiency paper (FP8 attention pretraining), squarely matching the LLM/Transformer/efficiency preferences with no off-scope domain application. The methodological contribution — deriving the stale-delta invariant violation and a matched-delta correction enabling native FP8 in all seven attention-core matmuls — is solid but builds directly on Qiu and Yao (2026)'s earlier BF16/FP32 direct backward correction, so novelty is good rather than exceptional. Rigor and evidence are strong: controlled two-seed comparisons with standard errors, paired validation-loss contrasts over 2,000 windows, kernel-level residual probes (Appendix C.1, Table 10), multiple architectures (GDN/GQA, GDN/MLA, KDA/GQA, Mamba-2/GQA, pure GQA), scales (569M–5.29B), variants, optimizers (AdamW/Muon), and honest ablations of alternative mitigations (Appendix C.4) — with acknowledged confounds (implementation differences, single-seed Muon/auxiliary-output studies, non-like-for-like timing). Generalizability is bounded by the authors' own admission (Appendix A.4) that behavior at substantially larger scales/durations is unestablished and no quantitative law for degradation onset is provided. Reproducibility is excellent in documentation (data recipes, hyperparameters, kernel numerics in Appendices B.1–B.6) though code/model release is only promised, not yet available.

primary_link.title: Delta-Matching: Closing the Final Gap of Native 8-bit Training for LLMs

papers.summary: Reliable FP8 attention remains a barrier to fully native 8-bit large language model training. We derive how forward-backward inconsistencies produce stale delta and empirically show how it distorts training dynamics. Our stale-delta hybrid runs show a modest loss gap at 569M parameters but substantial loss increases and downstream degradation at 1.67B and 5.29B. QK normalization, NoPE (no positional encoding), and lower-learning-rate context extension mitigate or delay degradation without elimin
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對 LLM 原生 8-bit（FP8）訓練尚未解決的關鍵難題：可靠的 FP8 attention 訓練。作者從理論與實驗指出，FP8 attention 前後向數值不一致會產生「stale delta」：沿用 FlashAttention 以儲存輸出計算反向修正的捷徑時，前後向各自量化的運算元使 softmax 梯度違反零列和不變性，造成注意力列被選擇性銳化或平坦化，並持續放大特定通道的 key RMSNorm 增益。實驗顯示 569M 時損失差距溫和，但 1.67B 與 5.29B 會出現明顯損失上升與下游退化，且錯誤隨最佳化器更新累積；QK normalization、NoPE 與降低學習率的長上下文延伸僅能延緩而無法消除。據此提出 Delta-Matching：以未量化的 FP32 機率與 FP8 反向運算元的 FP32 乘積重算列修正，在所述數值假設下恢復零列和不變性，使全部七個 attention 核心矩陣乘法皆可原生使用 block-scaled FP8，且無須修改架構、縮小批次或額外前向輸出。跨 GDN/GQA、GDN/MLA、KDA/GQA、Mamba-2/GQA 等架構與多種規模、訓練階段，其驗證損失與整體下游表現皆與 BF16/FP32 混合精度基準相當（1.67B 驗證 CE 為 1.4162 對 1.4178），naive FP8 則高達 1.8970。限制包括實驗至 5.29B／30B tokens、修正的獨立通道增加約 21–28% 反向時間、部分架構損失相近卻仍有增益腐蝕，且不保證任意模型與配方收斂。此研究凸顯前後向數值一致性是可靠 8-bit 訓練的關鍵，為全面原生 FP8 LLM 訓練提供務實路徑。
papers.title: Delta-Matching: Closing the Final Gap of Native 8-bit Training for LLMs
papers.title_zh: Delta-Matching：補齊 LLM 原生 8-bit 訓練的最後缺口

links.title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback

evidence: Abstract: GRPO stays flat at 0-1% Pass@1 on Pass@128=0 splits while RLTL;DR reaches 12-13% Pass@1 at eval time without insights in context
Section 4.1: GRPO baseline tuned to 72.2% Pass@1 on Appworld test-challenge, near the 73.4% official leaderboard best, supporting baseline quality
Section 5.1: main testbed is a 'proprietary dataset similar to Appworld' with 16k train tasks, limiting external reproducibility
Table 2 (Section 5.2): SFTL;DR deduplicated with 68k backward tokens reaches 16.9% eval Pass@1 vs 20.9% for SFT on 3.5k full rollouts (400M forward tokens), supporting the compacted-training claim
Table 3 (Section 6): removing failed-unit-test access drops eval Pass@1 to 3.4-10.0%; TL;DR format beats diagnostic/summary/code hints for internalization (19.2% vs 16.0-18.6%)
Section 4.2: authors 'refrain from claims on either approach outperforming' regarding RLTF-SD, indicating honest calibration of novelty claims
Figure 2 (Section 4.2): Pass@1 curves averaged across 3 seeds with std; Leetcode acknowledged as likely overfitting
Appendix B: three-step reproduction guide including literal insight-insertion context format, backprop mask editing, and verification checks; Table 4 gives full hyperparameters on 8xB200 nodes
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope LLM-methodology paper: RLVR/GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B agent on tool-calling and coding tasks, using sequential self-generated TL;DR insights plus an SFT loss on (task→insight) tokens to escape the Pass@128=0 learning barrier. High preference relevance (agents, RL, LLMs, code, reasoning). Rigor is strong: deconfounded insight-free metrics, macro-averaging, tuned GRPO baseline (72.2% on Appworld test-challenge, Section 4.1), 3 seeds, and extensive ablations (Tables 2, 3, 8, 9). Evidence is credible but the primary testbed is a proprietary 16k-task 'Synthetic-API' dataset (Section 5.1) and the filtered splits are small (34 Appworld tasks), so external validation is limited. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself frames RLTF-SD as 'similar in kind' and explicitly refrains from outperformance claims (Section 4.2); the striking, well-supported contribution is the SFTL;DR reduction showing (task, insight)-only training nearly matches full SFT (Table 2). Generalizability is partially demonstrated (heldout SAPI/Appworld gains) but Leetcode overfit and the authors flag domain limits (Section 7.2). Reproducibility is hampered by the proprietary dataset and no stated code release, though Appendix B gives a detailed three-step reproduction guide with prompts, masks, and hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback

papers.summary: The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. In this paper, we introduce RLTL;DR. After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and le
papers.summary_zh: 本論文處理強化學習結合可驗證獎勵(RLVR)在自我改進場景的困境:當任務難到模型 128 次嘗試全數失敗(Pass@128=0)時,GRPO 因缺乏正向樣本而無法學習,形成學習障礙,且無更強教師模型或標準解答可蒸餾。作者提出 RLTL;DR,核心有二:一是把平行取樣改為序列式嘗試,每次失敗後讓策略依驗證器輸出(如失敗的單元測試)寫出一句話的 TL;DR 洞見,並在後續嘗試將先前洞見置於上下文;二是更新時對洞見 token 反向傳播,以 SFT 損失內化「任務→洞見」映射,即使測試時從不生成洞見。在 Appworld、Synthetic API 與 Leetcode 極難分割上,GRPO 停滯於 0–1% Pass@1,RLTL;DR 突破障礙,評估時(無洞見輔助)達 12–13%,含洞見的訓練成功率為 14–31%。作者再化簡為 SFTL;DR:僅以約 4k 筆(任務,洞見)配對做 SFT、完全不反向傳播 rollout,即逼近完整效能,顯示簡短洞見能泛化到未見任務。消融顯示簡短 TL;DR 比詳細診斷更利於內化,能否存取失敗單元測試則是洞見品質關鍵,移除後訓練成功率僅剩 3.4%。限制:Leetcode 出現過度擬合;過於特定、缺乏共通規則的任務可能不適用,此能力或需仰賴充分預訓練。此工作確立「在這類任務記住這類要點」的精簡訓練典範,對無教師的自我改進學習深具啟示。

links.title: Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: reads four signal families from a single forward pass of a frozen model; explicitly 'a predictive measurement rather than a mechanistic localization'
Section 4.2 / Table 1: BEATRICE best on almost every column (e.g., .932/.826 with-context ID test vs best baseline SAPLMA .892/.744); text admits sampling baselines overtake on closed-book TriviaQA
Appendix D Table 6: paired bootstrap vs strongest of 23 baselines significant (p≤.007) on all four with-context columns and closed-book ID; closed-book OOD not significant, TQA Δ=-.046
Appendix A: label quality check — blind human re-annotation of 100 items agrees 98%, Cohen's κ=0.96; consensus filter discards 2.3%
Section 4.3 / Table 2 & Appendix D Table 7: fusion champion beats hidden-only encoder in every column, significantly on held-out single-hop sets (+.016 to +.021 AUROC)
Appendix H Tables 12-13: zero-shot transfer to real E5-retrieved context, BEATRICE first at .891 AUROC (+.039) on Qwen and .911 (+.064) on Gemma
Appendix K: full pipeline re-run on Gemma 4; closed-book-encoder benefit is base-model dependent (nine of Gemma's ten best combos carry none); sampling methods collapse to/below chance
Appendix B / Algorithm 1: full training details (AdamW 2e-4, batch 512, greedy selection δ=5e-4, layer-17 sweep) and judge/rewrite prompts in Appendix A; no code/data availability statement found

Appendix E Table 8 & Section 4.3: answer-span ablation most damaging (e.g., with-context TQA -.027 AUROC), supporting the answer-span localization claim, though main-text '0.01 closed-book' understates TQA -.032

Appendix I Table 14: PGIR leads macro EM (.408) and F1 (.484) at <4 generations/query, but SeaKR overtakes on the two hardest multi-hop sets at 13.63 generations — limitation stated plainly in Section 5.2
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM methodology: probing frozen-LLM internal signals (hidden states, token probabilities, residual-stream, attention) for answer-correctness detection, tied to adaptive retrieval (PGIR). Preference relevance is high via LLM, interpretability, RAG, and evaluation matches. Novelty is moderate: the families are individually established (Azaria-Mitchell, INSIDE, Lookback-Lens, etc.); the contribution is unifying four families under early/late fusion with greedy selection and a predictive 'anatomy' study, plus a retrieval controller — solid but incremental. Rigor is strong: 23 re-implemented baselines across three tiers, validation-only design, 3-seed means, paired bootstrap with Holm correction, and honest reporting of losses (closed-book OOD not significant; Bayesian SE wins TriviaQA by -.046, Appendix D). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent (Table 1 matches Appendix C/D numbers), with gold-context caveats addressed by a real-retrieval test (Appendix H) and a second-backbone replication (Appendix K) that also honestly reports base-model dependence of the closed-book-encoder benefit and collapse of sampling baselines on Gemma. Generalizability is bounded to English open-domain QA and correctness detection; reproducibility is good on hyperparameters/prompts/algorithm (Appendix A/B) but no code or data release is stated. Minor issues: LLM-judge labels validated only on 100 human items, and main-text span-ablation deltas ('about 0.02/0.01 AUROC') slightly understate Table 8 values.

primary_link.title: Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models

papers.summary: Language models expose internal signals that predict whether an answer is correct, readable from a single forward pass of a frozen model without additional generations. Yet existing probes often commit to one signal family or layer and can be brittle under distribution shift; in retrieval-augmented settings, many specialized detectors instead target passage faithfulness, which can diverge from correctness when retrieved evidence is unhelpful or conflicting. We therefore ask where answer correctn
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討能否從凍結大型語言模型的內部狀態讀出「答案是否正確」的訊號。既有探測器多依附單一訊號家族或單一層,在分布偏移下脆弱;檢索增強場景的偵測器又多針對忠實性,與正確性未必一致。作者提出 BEATRICE,於單次前向傳播讀取四類內部訊號:隱藏狀態、token 機率統計、殘差流貢獻與注意力分布,訓練十五種組合編碼器,再以貪婪前向選擇進行晚期融合,並分別在閉卷與有上下文兩種設定獨立搜尋;標籤由三種提示的 LLM 評審一致同意產生。在 Qwen3.5-9B 與六個開放域 QA 資料集上,BEATRICE 勝過 23 個重新實作的基線,域內與零樣本域外大多領先,取樣式方法僅在閉卷 TriviaQA 勝出,且閉卷域外的領先未達統計顯著;多訊號融合的增益在域外最明顯。解剖分析顯示:隱藏狀態訊號最強但非自足,各家族互補而非冗餘;正確性訊號集中在答案區段;閉卷先驗在檢索後是否有價值取決於基礎模型(Qwen 保留一個閉卷編碼器,Gemma 4 則捨棄)。下游應用 PGIR 以閉卷分數決定是否檢索、以上下文分數決定是否信任答案草稿,以較少生成次數提升 macro EM 與 F1。限制包括:偵測正確性不保證推理過程有效、注意力家族的可靠度受檢索品質左右、分析屬預測性讀取而非機制性定位。其價值在於把探測器設計從試誤轉為對基礎模型的系統性測量,可隨模型演進重複施行。

links.title: Retrieval Capacity of Self-Attention Under Competition

evidence: Section 3: 'We evaluate nine decoder-only checkpoints: Qwen-2.5-1.5B/7B, Gemma-7B, Gemma-2-9B, Llama-2-7B, Llama-3-8B, Llama-3.2-1B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Mistral-Small-24B-Base-2501', evaluated on OpenWebText and WikiText-103.
Appendix B.3: 'All 28 saved numerical parity checks pass, with maximum NLL discrepancy 5.76x10^-7', with recorded H100/bfloat16 environment and seed 2027.
Appendix C.4 / Table 3: matched final-128-target scoring shows 5% set-size estimates growing 4.12-6.63x as L goes from 256 to 2048 (e.g., Gemma-7B OWT 76 to 504) while N*/L decreases.

Section 3.3 / Table 6: BABILong qa1 with fixed annotated support shows 0.10-nat set sizes rising from 0K to 4K (Gemma 64 to 760, Llama 32 to 316), and Figure 7 reports support rank displacement ~50x and mass reduced to 0.435x (Appendix D.1).
Appendix E.1 Table 9: renormalizing retained weights reduces Gemma-7B's 5% attention-ranked estimate from 226 to 7, showing aggregation dependence.
Appendix C.2 Table 1: Spearman correlations between geometric F_N and NLL degradation weaken or flip sign after excluding N<=4, supporting the paper's qualified interpretation.

Reproducibility Statement: 'The accompanying source archive contains the manuscript and figure assets. Raw per-document measurements, experiment code, and environment manifests are needed to independently reproduce the empirical summaries.'
Section 4: authors state experiments 'do not demonstrate an inference speedup' and the conditional theory's assumptions 'have not been verified for the tested models'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM interpretability/efficiency study of self-attention: measures an 'effective attention set size' via Top-N attention deletion across nine decoder-only LLMs (Qwen, Gemma, Llama, Mistral), with controlled BABILong competition experiments, context-length sweeps, renormalization controls, and conditional theory with proofs. Core relevance to LLMs, transformers, interpretability, and long context; no domain-application drift. Novelty is a solid but incremental extension of the authors' prior geometric token-selection work and existing attention-sink/sparse-attention literature, though the functional loss-based measurement and aggregation controls are distinctive. Rigor is exceptionally high: formal recovery bounds, hash-seeded sampling, adaptive threshold search, 95% bootstrap/Wilson uncertainty, and numerical parity checks (max NLL discrepancy 5.76e-7, Appendix B.3), plus unusually candid caveats (e.g., geometry-loss correlations can flip sign when N<=4 excluded, Table 1). Evidence is strong and multi-model but estimates are conditional on evaluated sizes, the useful set is unobserved, some BABILong crossings remain unresolved, and the 24B run mixes 8-bit precision. Generalizes plausibly across decoder LLMs but only four lengths/tasks and 50-document samples. Reproducibility protocols are exhaustive, yet the archive reportedly contains only manuscript/figures, with code and raw measurements noted as still needed.

primary_link.title: Retrieval Capacity of Self-Attention Under Competition

papers.summary: How many tokens from its context does a language model actually use, and what determines that number? We study this question through self-attention. Without retraining, we retain only the tokens with the highest attention weights at each head, layer, and query, keeping their original weights unchanged. By varying the selected set size and measuring the increase in negative log-likelihood (NLL), we estimate the effective attention set size needed to stay within a chosen loss tolerance. Relatively
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型實際運用了上下文中的多少個 token?本文以自我注意力為切入點,在不重新訓練的前提下,於每一層、每個注意力頭與每個查詢位置僅保留注意力權重最高的 N 個 token,並維持其原始權重不變。透過調整 N 並測量負對數概似(NLL)的上升幅度,作者估計在指定損失容忍度內所需的「有效注意力集合大小」。實驗評估九個 decoder-only 模型檢查點,結果顯示相對較小的選取集合即可讓 NLL 貼近完整注意力的基準,且依注意力或貢獻量排序的選取明顯優於隨機選取;選取集合雖呈幾何結構,但幾何可分性本身不足以證明損失被保留。當固定預測目標而延長上下文時,所需集合大小隨之增加,惟其佔上下文的比例在測試範圍內下降。在 BABILong qa1 實驗中,固定標註支持事實並加入背景文字,會使支持 token 在注意力排名中後移、獲得的注意力權重總量降低,並在多個模型中推高所需集合大小。重新正規化保留權重可大幅縮減所需集合,顯示估計值亦取決於被選表示的聚合方式。限制方面:有效集合是跨層與頭的共同上限、假設中的有用集合不可直接觀測、平均損失可能掩蓋個別樣本變化,且因先計算完整注意力,並未示範推論加速。此測量方法為量化注意力實際依賴的上下文規模提供了操作化工具,對稀疏注意力與快取精簡等效率研究具參考價值。

papers.title_zh: 競爭下自我注意力的檢索容量

links.title: Context Language Models

evidence: Abstract: claims 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus and 65% greater improvement on a 24-hour agent-swarm task

Section 5.1.1: CLM scores 59.4% on BrowseComp-Plus at 32K context limit, exceeding Codex-style summarization by 11.4% relative with 21.5% fewer prefix-reuse FLOPs; matches TB2.1 accuracy using 70% of its FLOPs

Section 4.2: defines success-gated efficiency advantage A_eff over successful GRPO trajectories using prefix-reuse FLOPs; Table 2: RL improves Qwen3.5-9B from 28.8% to 42.5% on BCP at 1.34 vs 2.19 PFLOPs/question for the trained summary harness

Section 3 and Appendix D: ContextBench diagnostic (Needle Retention, Sudoku Sketchpad, KV Store, Log Triage) decouples context management from reasoning; 'none of the existing methods performs perfectly' at up to 24x context pressure (Figure 2)

Appendix B: SCR patch to SGLang reuses cached states of surviving tokens beyond the matched prefix with K=6 cap; sensitivity analysis on 64 BCP questions (Figure 13); Figure 14 shows 5.3 of 7.8 points of reuse come from reasoning-token stripping

Appendix E: evaluation details — all 830 BCP questions with Qwen3.5-27B judge at temperature 0, method-specific skills 'released with the benchmark', one run per method on math optimization, three seeds for EdgeBench-10

Section 6: discusses safety risk of editable context (prompt injection persisting via compaction summaries, citing OpenAI 2026b); Appendix G probes limited context-length awareness with bucketed token estimates
Section 5.1.2/Table 1: CLM beats OpenEvolve on all four math optimization problems with Claude 4.6 Sonnet, but with 'one run per method' (Appendix E)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference LLM/agent methodology paper: model-controlled context management ('context as a file'), stepwise GRPO RL with a success-gated efficiency advantage, in-context skill evolution, and a serving contribution (Suffix Cache Reuse in SGLang), evaluated on coding, deep-research, and long-horizon agentic tasks. Core idea is an incremental extension of a well-populated line (RLMs, MEM1, ACM, Self-Compact, MemGPT) that the paper itself frames as the 'limit' of increasing model autonomy; SCR resembles prior non-prefix cache reuse (PIE, CacheBlend) applied to agent contexts. Rigor is above average: shared Mini-SWE-Agent backbone, original baseline implementations with comparable method-specific skills, held-out splits and bootstrap CIs for steering/evolution, K-sensitivity ablation for SCR, reward ablations, and a size comparison (Qwen3.5-9B vs 27B) showing gains scale with model capability. Deductions: several experiments are single-run (math optimization, 24h Software World), key results live in figures rather than tables, and the largest gains depend on frontier/proprietary models; code URL is claimed but not verifiable from the text. Internal quantitative claims are consistent (abstract 11.4%/21.5% matches Section 5.1.1; 28.8->42.5 matches abstract's 47.6% relative).

primary_link.title: Context Language Models

papers.summary: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety o
papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出 Context Language Models（CLMs），把上下文管理從外部 harness 交還給模型本身：將即時上下文映射為一個可用 Bash 自由編輯的檔案，修改即時同步到下一輪生成，並自然延伸至多代理系統，讓多個上下文檔案共存。作者提出 prefix-reuse FLOPs 衡量前綴快取下的真實推理成本，並開發 Suffix Cache Reuse（SCR）重用編輯後仍存留 token 的快取狀態。實驗顯示，既有模型零樣本轉為 CLM 後，在 BrowseComp-Plus 準確率高於最強基線 11.4% 且省 21.5% FLOPs，12 小時 EdgeBench 高 5% 且省 59% FLOPs，24 小時多儲存庫 agent-swarm 任務在相同花費下提速多 65%，數學最佳化問題也勝過 OpenEvolve；自製 ContextBench 診斷基準顯示摘要壓縮等固定策略會遺漏資訊或產生幻覺。CLM 並湧現維護計分板、自創筆記角色、定義可重用壓縮函式等行為。透過情境引導與技能演化，held-out 準確率最多提升 35.9 分；以 stepwise GRPO 搭配 success-gated efficiency advantage 進行 RL，Qwen3.5-9B 在 BrowseComp-Plus 從 28.8% 升至 42.5% 並省 12% FLOPs；SCR 另可減少 35% 伺服器端運算。限制包括模型可寫入上下文帶來提示注入與自我指令持續的風險、小型模型編輯意願與能力較弱、SCR 屬近似重用，且現有 LM 的上下文長度感知不足。此研究呼應 The Bitter Lesson，讓模型內建並學習上下文管理，對長時程代理深具意義。

links.title: You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference

evidence: Section 3 / Table 2: median within-cell price-accuracy Spearman correlation is +0.05 vs. price-latency -0.61, negative in 21/21 benchmark-scale cells, showing price predicts speed but not quality.

Section 5 / Table 18: measured-map router achieves 94% mean accuracy at 1.57x cheapest cost with 0% below-floor, vs. premium routing at 3.67x cost with 17% below-floor; Appendix H shows OOS below-floor rises to 22.2% under a 2-point margin, quantifying map aging.

Section 7 / Table 6: 36-hour live deployment on Llama-3.3-70B across 12 providers served 538 queries with 130 probes, moving traffic from a $1.04/M anchor to a $0.21/M certified endpoint for 63.7% serving-cost reduction at 88.3% accuracy; the text notes no quality slip occurred, so slip detection was not live-validated.

Appendix U: TOST equivalence established in only 4/17 cells and CI-supported savings fall from 55% to 46%, with point-estimate median CI gap of 6.7 points at n~150 - a candid account of sampling-power limits.

Appendix A: limitations state all measurements traverse a single aggregator from one client location, claims are attribution-agnostic, and detector comparisons use a single Llama-3.3-70B/GSM8K replay cell; no code or artifact availability is claimed anywhere in the document.

Appendix M / Table 23: 40-seed component control with a matched monitor isolates certification (cold-start exposure 0.00-0.02% vs. 6.10% periodic) from monitoring (0.23-0.57% vs. 17.30% periodic), with probe-spend reductions of 8-23x.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-systems work squarely within the preference profile: open-weight LLM inference routing (LLM 2.5), serving/latency/cost optimization (Inference & Serving, Scaling & Efficiency), bandit-based online decision-making, and reliability/safety framing. The provider-selection axis after model choice is a genuinely novel formulation (inverse bandit with fail-safe certification), supported by unusually careful methodology: multi-wave measurement, out-of-sample sweeps, component controls over 40 seeds, TOST/Newcombe confidence checks, and honest negative results (Appendix T falsified prediction; Appendix U underpowered equivalence tests). Evidence is strong but partly bound to one aggregator, one client location, replay-simulated drift, and a single live run that validates cold-start migration rather than slip detection; no code/data release is claimed. Generalizability of the framework is good, empirical transfer beyond the measured market is less certain, and exact replication is inherently difficult for a time-varying market.

primary_link.title: You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference

papers.summary: Existing LLM routers choose among models using static per-model costs. We show that open-weight inference markets introduce a second, largely ignored decision axis: after choosing a model, a client must still choose which provider serves it. Measuring live endpoints across [nummodels] open models, competing providers, multiple task types, and three measurement waves, we find that provider choice cannot be inferred from the price list. The same model can vary sharply in quality, latency, availabi
papers.summary_zh: 本論文指出,現有 LLM 路由器只回答「該選哪個模型」,卻忽略第二個決策軸:在開源權重推論市場中,選定模型後仍須選擇由哪家供應商服務。作者釘住供應商,實測 6 個開源模型、多種任務與三波共 43 天,發現同一模型在不同供應商間的品質、延遲、可用性與價格差異劇烈:價格與延遲呈穩定負相關(中位 Spearman 相關係數 −0.61),卻無法預測品質或可用性;可行性更具任務選擇性,同一端點在知識型任務上近乎正常,卻可能在多步推理上嚴重退化,且供應商地圖會隨時間漂移。論文將同模型供應商選擇形式化為價格接受者的市場感知路由問題:實測地圖路由器選出最便宜、品質等價且健康的供應商,相對溢價供應商中位可省約 50% 成本,並將低於品質下限率維持在 0%;接著提出 facet,為每個(供應商 × 任務)面向建立線上可行性認證,未認證的便宜端點一律退回錨點而不服務,再以連續監控隔離事後退化的端點。消融實驗分離了故障安全錨定與任務條件化認證的貢獻;系統能容忍不完美的任務分配與稀疏回饋,但系統性評測偏誤構成品質訊號的信任邊界,需以 ground-truth 探針或稽核緩解。36 小時的 Llama-3.3-70B 線上部署顯示,認證可將流量從 $1.04/M 錨點遷移到 $0.21/M 的認證端點,服務成本降低 63.7%,準確率維持 88.3%。限制包括:量測經單一聚合器、歸因不可知;facet 在漸進漂移或多點同時退化下未必勝過滑動視窗方法;系統仍需維護錨點與可信的品質證據。此研究說明市場感知 LLM 路由不僅要決定用哪個模型,更須量測由誰來服務。

links.title: Authority Bias in Language Models: Source Deference and User Agreement Are Not Interchangeable

evidence: Abstract: a verified-source note endorsing a wrong answer flips 45–88% of baseline-correct responses in seven of eight models; compliance rises with how authoritative the note sounds.

Section 4.3 / Table 4: source-direction removal reduces source-cued compliance by −69.6 pp (Qwen3.5 L5), −77.5 pp (GPT-OSS L16), −64.3 pp (OLMo-3.1 L22) with 10,000-sample paired bootstrap CIs, while user removal shows the reverse preference.

Section 4.4 / Table 5: separately fitted attribution patch moves compliance bidirectionally (e.g., −30.5/+32.0 pp for GPT-OSS on 512 held-out items) with all paired intervals excluding zero; Appendix H shows robustness across five layers, three wordings, two cue positions, and dose response.

Section 4.5 / Appendix E: authority direction is nearly orthogonal to the assistant axis (|cos| ≤ 0.06) and weakly overlaps the NRC-VAD valence/arousal plane (≤0.103), with causal controls showing removal effects persist outside both planes.

Section 6 Limitations: confidence intervals at strongest-sweep settings do not account for layer/strength selection; Appendix B concedes some held-out item-level outputs were not retained and OLMo-2 L16 assistant-removal runs were not reconciled.

Appendix L: Gemma-4 audit shows the fitted direction tracks endorsement presence (probe AUROC 0.53–0.60) but the 10.6% steering effect is not robust (clean rerun 1.7%), and removal changes compliance by only −2.9 pp.
Table 9 / Section 5.2: capability checks use n=300 MMLU-Pro and n=200 GSM8K per model, detecting no accuracy change but with lower bounds allowing roughly 6–14 pp losses.
Section 6: the study does not evaluate retrieval itself or agent actions on live tool outputs; retrieved-document tests begin after the claim is in context.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/interpretability research squarely within preferred topics (LLMs, sycophancy/authority bias, activation steering, RAG trust, evaluation). The central claim—that source-attributed and user-attributed wrong answers are causally dissociable inside models despite near-identical direction geometry—is novel relative to cited prior authority-bias and sycophancy-steering work, though built from established techniques (CAA-style steering, direction removal, attribution patching). Rigor is unusually high: shuffled-label, placebo, random-direction, assistant-axis, and lexical-affect controls; Wilson/Newcombe/paired-bootstrap intervals; cross-judge SYCON audit; and candid negative results (Gemma-4 failure audit, OLMo-2 confound, Gemini outlier). Main deductions: layer/strength settings are best-of-sweep selections with CIs that do not account for selection; some held-out validation runs use different layers and unreconciled/discontinued artifacts (Appendix B); capability checks are underpowered (n=300/200 with intervals allowing 6–14 pp losses); no live retrieval/agent pipeline test, limiting real-world generalizability; and mitigation transfer is not universal.

primary_link.title: Authority Bias in Language Models: Source Deference and User Agreement Are Not Interchangeable

papers.summary: Language models tend to agree with whatever a user asserts, and post-training increasingly targets this sycophancy so that models evaluate claims on their merits rather than deferring to the user. Yet the same models are far more compliant when a wrong answer is attributed to a verified source, which is how retrieval results, tool outputs, and grounded-search content often present information. We measure this gap across five open-weight families and three closed APIs. A single verified-source no
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型經後訓練以減少對使用者主張的諂媚附和,但當錯誤答案被冠上「已驗證來源」的框架(如檢索結果、工具輸出)時,模型是否同樣抗拒?本文比較五個開放權重家族(Qwen3.5、GPT-OSS、OLMo-2、OLMo-3.1、Gemma-4)與三個封閉 API(GPT-5.4、Grok-4.20、Gemini-3.1-Pro):其中七個模型在單句「根據已驗證來源,答案是X」下,有 45–88% 原本答對的題目翻轉,附和程度並隨來源措辭的權威強度遞增,僅 Gemini-3.1-Pro 近乎免疫。作者從殘差流激活擬合線性方向,以向量添加、投影移除與 attribution patching 進行因果介入。在 Qwen3.5、GPT-OSS 與 OLMo-3.1 中,移除「來源方向」使對錯誤來源的附和下降約 65–80 個百分點,遠大於移除使用者或助理方向的效果;移除「使用者方向」則呈相反偏好,顯示即使兩方向餘弦相似度高達 0.90–0.99,兩種行為在模型內部仍可因果分離。歸因修補在提示文字完全不變下,於三個模型中雙向改變附和程度。於問答題擬合的權威向量不需重新擬合即可轉移到 PIQA 與多輪 SYCON 對話;五家族中四個在移除後降低錯誤來源附和,且 MMLU-Pro 與 GSM8K 未偵測到能力下降。限制包括:最佳設定取自掃描、未校正選擇偏誤;機制實驗僅限開放權重模型;OLMo-2 存在助理方向混淆;Gemma-4 對線性介入不敏感;亦未測試真實代理與工具管線。此研究指出,對來源的順從與對使用者的迎合是不同的失敗模式,必須分開評估與緩解,對 RAG 與代理系統安全尤為重要。

links.title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: claims 'cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points', consistent with Table 1 (AppWorld FOCUS-D 64.9 vs 56.0; OfficeBench FOCUS-O peak 3.81 vs 7.27, dep 1.16 vs 4.43).
Section 4.3: dependency indicator X_i^(k)=1[s_i in Dep(p_k)] with utility u_hat_i as citation frequency across N draft rollouts; thresholding S_U={s_i: u_hat_i >= tau}.
Appendix A.2 'Remark (What the guarantee does not say)': explicitly states u_i >= u_j does not imply U(s_i) >= U(s_j) and characterizes gap/proportional-perturbation conditions for ranking agreement.
Appendix A.2.6: estimator validation on 30 reconstructed compression events; keep-set overlap 0.85 (OfficeBench) / 0.90 (AppWorld), Spearman 0.39 / 0.48 versus KL counterfactual reference.
Table 4 (rollout ablation, OfficeBench): N=1 71.6, N=3 77.9, N=5 74.7, N=10 74.7 - saturating and non-monotonic gains, no variance reported.
Table 1c (8-QA): FOCUS-D dependency 4.05 exceeds the no-compression 3.32 while peak 9.17 is above other compression baselines; FOCUS-O EM 0.386 vs 0.366 baseline.
Appendix A.10: documented failure mode - set-generalized plans undervalue per-entity spans (task ff58e36: agent befriends 4 of 5 required users after enumeration span is pruned).

Appendix A.9: hyperparameters and settings given (N=3, tau=0.3, delta=4096 AppWorld / 2048 OfficeBench & 8-QA, temperature 0.0 seed 42 agent, 0.7 drafts, cl100k_base tokenizer) and full draft prompt reproduced; no public code repository is stated.
Table 12: draft model adds ~3% of total cost; parallel rollouts cut mean compression latency 5286ms to 2145ms (~2.5x) on OfficeBench.
Section 5 RQ2 / Table 3: Qwen3-8B draft lifts AppWorld accuracy to 65.5% with gpt-4.1 agent, supporting draft-model independence across families.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core methodology is LLM-centric and squarely in-scope: training-free, test-time context compression for LLM agents (span-level selection via draft-model Monte Carlo plan rollouts), evaluated on five agentic benchmarks (AppWorld, OfficeBench, 8-QA, WebVoyager, tau2-Bench) with GPT-4.1 and open-weight drafts (Qwen3-8B/14B, Phi-4). Novelty is solid rather than groundbreaking: recasting compression as forward-looking counterfactual utility tied to an Information Bottleneck objective is a fresh framing versus offline-learned compressors (ACON, PAACE), but rollout-based dependency estimation and defensive rescue are incremental engineering on known planning ideas. Rigor is above average: formal assumptions (1-6) with honest 'what the guarantee does not say' remarks, Hoeffding-style concentration, estimator-vs-KL validation on 30 compression events, ablations over N, delta_mem, draft model, plus a candid failure-mode analysis (set-valued goals, task ff58e36). Evidence strength is tempered by single-run results without confidence intervals (only a +/-1.4% variance note), a noisy N-ablation where N=3 (77.9) beats N=5/10 (74.7), uneven gains (FOCUS-D dependency on 8-QA 4.05 exceeds the uncompressed 3.32; tau2 dependency essentially unchanged), and modest improvements on some benchmarks (+4.5 WebVoyager, +2.0 airline). Generalizability is supported by architecture-agnostic operation across draft families and diverse environments, though the method needs extra draft calls and its benefit profile varies by environment. Reproducibility is decent: hyperparameters (N=3, tau=0.3, delta=2048/4096), tokenizer, seeds, pricing, and full prompts are provided, but no code release URL is stated.

primary_link.title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents

papers.summary: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories.
papers.summary_zh: LLM agent 在長程任務中會持續累積互動歷史，使推論成本呈二次方成長，並因注意力稀釋而損害決策品質。既有壓縮方法需離線最佳化指引、蒸餾壓縮器或以 RL 訓練策略，成本高昂且政策在推論前即固定，無法因應測試時才浮現的任務相依性。本文將脈絡壓縮重新框定為「因果決策保存」問題，提出免訓練、完全在測試時運作的 FOCUS 框架：以輕量 draft model 進行蒙地卡羅 rollout，抽樣多份隨機計畫草圖，要求每個規劃步驟標註所依賴的歷史 span，再以被引用頻率估計各 span 的反事實未來效用；作者證明此效用與 Information Bottleneck 目標相連，並對被捨棄 span 的決策損失給出單邊安全上界。另加入防禦性驗證，搶救未被引用但刪除後可能導致重複失敗或遺失關鍵狀態的 span。在 AppWorld、OfficeBench、8-QA、WebVoyager 與 τ²-Bench 上，以 gpt-4.1 為主 agent，FOCUS 最高削減尖峰脈絡 48%、相依度 73%，任務成功率提升達 8.9 個百分點，總 token 用量與 API 成本亦同步下降；搭配 Qwen3-8B、Phi-4 等小型開源 draft model 仍維持增益，且 N=3 次 rollout 即接近飽和。限制方面：對需逐一處理多個實體的「集合型目標」任務，計畫草圖易低估列舉類 span 而造成漏做；防禦驗證在部分基準僅與樂觀版持平；理論保證屬單邊性質，依賴效用間隔與 draft-main 一致性等假設。整體而言，本研究顯示前瞻性、決策感知的壓縮可作為即插即用、跨模型的實用方案。
papers.title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: FOCUS：免訓練、決策保存導向的 LLM Agent 脈絡壓縮框架

links.title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation

evidence: Table 1: RASO reaches 49.03±1.85 (OfficeQA) and 63.33±2.69 (SpreadsheetBench) with GPT-5.6-Luna vs strongest update baseline SkillOpt at 45.54/57.02; results reported as mean ± standard error over three random seeds.

Table 3: ablation isolates components — RFSI+RFSU 40.70 → RASI+RASU 49.03 on OfficeQA (+8.33) and 51.67 → 63.33 on SpreadsheetBench (+11.66); adaptation adds +3.88 (RASI) and +2.33 (RASU) on OfficeQA.

Section A.1: per-benchmark blocklist removes entire repositories matching benchmark keywords from the GitSkills corpus to prevent contamination; task/harness descriptions generated once by a coding agent 'not given access to test instances'.
Tables 9-10: rollout budgets matched across methods (196/320/114/360); RASO has lowest API cost on 3 of 4 benchmarks ($0.84-$10.28 vs TextGrad up to $41.03).
Section 5.2/Figure 3: performance peaks at K=5 retrieved sections and degrades at K=10; ablations (Tables 2-4, Figures 3-4) are run only on OfficeQA and SpreadsheetBench.

Section A.4, Table 8: under fixed RFSI initialization RASU beats SkillOpt by +2.02 (47.56 vs 45.54) on OfficeQA and +4.05 (61.07 vs 57.02) on SpreadsheetBench; no significance tests reported anywhere in the document.

Limitations for reproducibility: no code/data release or artifact availability statement appears in the provided text; method relies on the public GitSkills corpus and a proprietary GPT-5.6-Luna backbone alongside open Qwen-3.5-9B.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper (skill/context optimization with retrieval), squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, RAG & Knowledge, and Prompting preferences; not an out-of-scope domain application. Experimental design is careful: four benchmarks, two backbones, three seeds with SE, matched rollout budgets (Tables 9-10), a matched-pipeline retrieval-free control (RFSI, Section A.1), a conservative blocklist against corpus contamination, and ablations isolating init, update, and adaptation (Table 3). Novelty is moderate: retrieval plus LLM adaptation of external knowledge is a natural combination of SkillRouter-style retrieval and Agent KB-style cross-domain adaptation, with the cross-harness adaptation operation and whole-optimization-loop use being the main increments. Evidence is internally consistent (reported deltas in Sections 5.1, 5.2, A.4 recompute correctly from tables), though statistical significance is never tested and several SEs overlap (e.g., ALFWorld 74.13±1.00 vs 72.64±0.90); ablations cover only OfficeQA and SpreadsheetBench. Generalizability is supported by four diverse text-agent settings and one open 9B model, but limited to text-based agents and a single external corpus. Reproducibility is helped by detailed hyperparameters (K=5, minibatch 40, chunk 8, vLLM/A6000, Section A.1) but no code or artifact release is stated, and prompts are not shown.

primary_link.title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation

papers.summary: An agent skill is a reusable, actionable natural-language artifact that guides an agent to perform a task effectively under a given harness. Recent studies have explored the optimization of agent skills, contributing to a growing collection of publicly available skills spanning diverse tasks, domains, and harnesses. Despite millions of publicly shared skills, existing skill optimization methods largely overlook this accumulated knowledge, instead relying solely on expensive agent rollouts to ite
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理在執行框架（harness）下完成任務時，仰賴以自然語言撰寫、可重複使用的「技能」文件。現有技能最佳化方法多僅靠昂貴的 agent rollout 逐步修正，忽略了網路上已累積數百萬筆公開技能的知識。本文提出 RASO（Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization），以外部技能語料庫 GitSkills 作為先驗知識，分為兩個互補階段：RASI 在完全不執行 rollout 的情況下，由任務與框架描述產生需求—查詢對，以 BM25 檢索章節級技能內容；RASU 則在執行失敗後依文字梯度產生查詢，檢索可彌補缺失知識的內容。兩階段共用 Cross-Harness Adaptation，將來自不同領域與框架的檢索結果改寫成符合目標框架物件、指令與單位的可行動指引，避免直接重用造成的領域與框架錯配。在 OfficeQA、SpreadsheetBench、ALFWorld 與 WebShop 四個基準上，搭配 GPT-5.6-Luna 與 Qwen-3.5-9B 兩個模型，RASI 初始化即優於免檢索初始化 RFSI 與 SkillRouter；完整 RASO 亦超越 TextGrad、GEPA、SkillOpt 與 WikiSkill，例如 GPT-5.6-Luna 在 SpreadsheetBench 達 63.33（較最強基線 +6.31）。消融實驗顯示初始化與更新的增益互補，Cross-Harness Adaptation 在兩階段皆帶來穩定提升，檢索段落數 K=5 最佳，API 成本亦低於多數基線。限制包括效能受語料庫覆蓋範圍影響、僅評估四個基準、採用較簡單的 BM25 檢索器，且調適品質仰賴 LLM 的改寫能力。整體而言，本研究證明外部技能知識在初始化與更新全程皆具價值，為低成本、可遷移的代理技能最佳化提供新方向。
papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 透過跨執行框架調適的檢索增強式技能最佳化（RASO）

links.title: Do LLM Agents Execute the Plans They Declare? From Planning-Mode Declaration to Pattern-Specific Execution

evidence: Abstract: pattern-specific executors raise task success from 0.48 to 0.92 on ALFWorld and from 0.36 to 0.44 on SWE-bench Verified over Plan+ReAct; across three benchmarks only 22-45% of Plan+ReAct trajectories preserve declared structure.
Section 5 [RQ1], Table 1: overall structure maintenance 21.5-44.6% across ALFWorld/Mind2Web/SWE-bench models, declining with plan length (e.g., ALFWorld 4-5-step 36.5-49.6% vs >10-step ~0%).
Appendix E.3: verifier-human agreement kappa=0.31/0.34 vs human-human kappa=0.35 (71% raw agreement) on 100 ALFWorld trajectories, indicating a noisy central metric transparently reported.
Appendix I, Table 18: retry-matched control reduces residual oracle gap (H_retry@3) to between -0.025 and +0.027 for most benchmark-model pairs, tempering the routing-headroom claim.

Appendix K, Table 19: top-1 declarations show Delta(pi) within the 95% permutation null for all benchmark-model pairs (min one-sided p=0.094; Holm-corrected p>=0.944), an honest negative selection result.

Section 5 [RQ3] vs Appendix I.1 Table 17: inconsistency between stated Search-vs-3xReAct margins (0.117-0.381 ALFWorld, 0.153-0.233 WebArena in text) and Table 17-derived values (0.132-0.392 ALFWorld, 0.128-0.191 WebArena).

Reproducibility statement: executors, prompts, verifier, and analysis scripts plus derived trajectories 'will release ... upon publication'; prompts (Appendix N), sampling configs (Appendix D, Tables 10-13), and seed protocol (seeds 7, 13, 42) are documented in-text.

Section 4 / Appendix C: evaluation spans ALFWorld (134), Mind2Web (1341), SWE-bench Verified (500), WebArena (204) with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it backbones under fixed inference budgets.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent research: highly relevant to Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, reasoning/planning, and evaluation preferences, with a code benchmark (SWE-bench) and few-shot prompting components. The diagnostic framing (Plan Declaration-Execution Gap) and deterministic mode-to-executor routing are a fresh but incremental twist on known planner-executor and plan-adherence work. Rigor is strong: 4 benchmarks, 3 backbones, 3 seeds with SDs, a task-blind 5,000-permutation null with Holm correction, rollout/retry-matched pass@k controls that honestly deflate the oracle headroom, and LLM-judge cost analysis. Evidence is solid but not airtight: the central structure-maintenance metric rests on a verifier with only modest human agreement (kappa ~0.31-0.35 vs human-human 0.35), some cells are sparse, prior-system comparisons are uncontrolled context, and there is a numerical inconsistency between Section RQ3 text (0.117-0.381 ALFWorld margin) and Table 17-derived values (0.132-0.392). Generalizability is decent across embodied/web/coding environments but limited to four hand-picked patterns, task-level one-shot routing, and moderate-size models. Reproducibility is supported by extensive prompt/config appendices but code and trajectories are only promised 'upon publication'.

primary_link.title: Do LLM Agents Execute the Plans They Declare? From Planning-Mode Declaration to Pattern-Specific Execution

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) enable agents to solve long-horizon tasks by generating a plan and then executing it in an environment. However, successful planning requires two distinct capabilities: selecting an appropriate plan for the task and executing it faithfully. Existing planner--executor systems can fail at either stage, while final task success alone cannot distinguish selection from execution failures. We therefore study the Plan Declaration--Execution Gap and introduce Planning-as-Rou
papers.summary_zh: 此論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）代理人在長程任務中是否會確實執行其宣告的計畫。規劃可能以兩種方式失敗：執行時偏離宣告的計畫，或忠實執行了不適合任務的計畫，而單看最終成功與否無法區分兩者。作者提出「計畫宣告—執行落差」診斷框架與 Planning-as-Routing 架構：LLM 先宣告四種規劃模式之一（Predefined、Sequential、Hierarchical、Search），再由確定性路由器分派至對應的模式專屬執行器。實驗涵蓋 ALFWorld、Mind2Web、WebArena 與 SWE-bench Verified，使用 Qwen3.6-35B、DeepSeek-V4 與 Gemma-4-26B 三種模型，比較 Flat ReAct、Plan+ReAct 與路由式執行。結果顯示 Plan+ReAct 僅約 22%–45% 的軌跡保留宣告結構，且計畫越長偏離越嚴重；模式專屬執行器則依設計強制維持結構，並將 ALFWorld 成功率從 0.48 提升至 0.92，SWE-bench Verified 從 0.36 提升至 0.44。最強模式隨環境與模型而異：ALFWorld 以 Search 最佳，SWE-bench 以 Hierarchical 最佳。然而目前 LLM 尚未能為個別任務可靠選出最強模式，相對於任務盲目的置換基線並無統計顯著的任務特異優勢；少量範例示範可改善模式選擇（增益約 +0.004 至 +0.16），開啟思考模式則未必有幫助。限制包括僅涵蓋四種規劃模式、採固定執行預算的任務層級路由，且 oracle 增益部分來自額外的重複嘗試，結構忠實性亦不保證動作正確。此研究指出可靠的代理規劃須兼顧選對模式與以相符執行器落實結構，凸顯流程層級代理評估的重要性。
papers.title: Do LLM Agents Execute the Plans They Declare? From Planning-Mode Declaration to Pattern-Specific Execution
papers.title_zh: LLM 代理人會執行其所宣告的計畫嗎？從規劃模式宣告到模式專屬執行

links.title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA

evidence: Abstract: trained 0.6B planner achieves 77.40% accuracy on LoCoMo and 71.29% on LongMemEval-S, exceeding a 30B planner without retrieval-grounded training by 4.10% and 3.96%
Section 4.2, Table 1: MERA-RL attains highest accuracy among compared methods with Qwen3-30B on both benchmarks (77.40 LoCoMo, 71.29 LongMemEval-S) with token-cost accounting per method
Section 4.3.1, Table 2: planner ablation MERA-Small 68.40/59.80, MERA-Large 73.30/67.33, MERA-RL 77.40/71.29 (LoCoMo/LongMemEval-S)
Section 4.6: graph-flat gaps positive in all six comparisons (e.g., 14.41 and 16.17 points for MERA-RL), but the paper states the comparison 'does not isolate graph representation alone'

Appendix A.4.1: LoCoMo training questions synthesized with the benchmark's released data-generation utilities; LongMemEval questions generated from training conversations; 2,996 and 2,312 states retained after filtering
Appendix B.1: all LongMemEval-S test evaluations use a held-out test split of 101 questions, while LoCoMo uses all 1,986 questions
Appendix E.2: reasoning errors account for 63.5% of LoCoMo failures and 87.1% of LongMemEval-S failures; temporal question accuracy remains 39.3%
Section 3.5 and Appendix A.4.3-A.4.4: reward R_ret = x_t[1+p_t(1-x_t)] for newly recovered gold parent turns, optimized with GRPO; memory index, evidence model, and answer model held fixed
Appendix C.2, Table 6: MERA-RL runtime 48.3 s/question vs MERA-Large 155.5 s/question on LongMemEval-S (1.12x vs 3.60x relative)
Reproducibility Statement: complete code repository and training data will be publicly released 'once this paper has passed peer review'
Appendix F: LoCoMo accuracy ranges from 74.97% to 77.63% across retrieval hyperparameters (k=4/8/16, T_max=5/10)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM research: memory-augmented QA for LLM agents with RAG-style retrieval, a verifier-gated evidence graph, and GRPO training of a lightweight query planner, evaluated with Qwen3-30B and GPT-4o-mini. Novelty is a solid but incremental combination of known ideas (IRCoT-style iterative retrieval, CONQRR-style outcome-based query rewards, Memory-R1-style RL for memory) with the specific contribution of incremental missing-evidence rewards and decoupled evidence state. Rigor is above average: two benchmarks, nine baselines, planner-scale and graph-vs-flat ablations, cost/runtime/termination diagnostics, and honest caveats (graph ablation conflates workflow; RL ablation is holistic; judge-based accuracy without human validation; LongMemEval-S test split is only 101 questions; planner training uses the same question-generation pipeline as LoCoMo, raising benchmark-overfitting concerns not tested cross-dataset). Evidence is detailed and internally consistent, but lacks significance testing and some analyses rest on single runs. Generalizability is limited to English conversational memory QA and requires gold parent-turn evidence for reward. Reproducibility documentation is thorough (models, hyperparameters, serving setup), but code and training data are only promised post-review.

primary_link.title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA

papers.summary: Long-term memory enables language models to use past interactions in future conversations. However, evidence needed to answer a question may be scattered across distant turns, while the question itself omits clues needed to locate it. Retrieved facts can reveal these clues, motivating retrieval decisions conditioned on evidence already found. We introduce MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation), which separates globally searchable memory from a question-specific evidence state. Verified e
papers.summary_zh: 長期記憶問答的難點在於：答案所需的證據常散落在相距遙遠的對話輪次中，而問題本身往往缺少定位這些證據的線索，僅依相似度檢索可能遺漏關鍵事實。本文提出 MERA（缺失證據檢索增強），將可全域搜尋的原子事實記憶索引，與針對特定問題、由驗證器把關的證據狀態分離。輕量規劃器（0.6B）依據證據圖、問題與查詢歷史產生結構化檢索意圖；驗證器僅允許有助解題的事實進入證據圖，已驗證的實體與時間關係可引導後續檢索，且不限制對全域記憶的存取。訓練上，作者以強化學習 GRPO 微調規劃器，獎勵定義為實際執行查詢後新找回的缺失黃金證據，重複命中不給分，因此措辭不同但找到相同證據的查詢獲得同等回饋。實驗顯示，以 Qwen3-30B 處理證據與生成答案時，訓練後的 0.6B 規劃器在 LoCoMo 達 77.40%、LongMemEval-S 達 71.29%，分別領先未經檢索訓練的 30B 規劃器 4.10 與 3.96 個百分點；多輪檢索將 LoCoMo 累積證據召回率自 55.5% 提升至 80.5%。消融實驗顯示證據圖在所有設定下都優於扁平證據列表。限制方面：推理錯誤仍是主要失敗來源，時間推理準確率僅約 39%，且 RL 規劃器的優勢在移除證據圖的扁平變體上不復存在，離線原子事實抽取也有成本。此研究凸顯『依已找到的證據決定下一步檢索』的重要性，並證明以檢索結果訓練輕量規劃器可勝過單純擴大模型規模。
papers.title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA
papers.title_zh: 學習為長期記憶問答檢索缺失證據

links.title: Learning What to Remember: Long-horizon Counterfactual Memory Optimization

evidence: Abstract: 'MGPO improves extraction while reducing average memory length by nearly 80% relative to the initial memory policy'
Section 3.2, Table 1: MGPO reaches 51.3 entity-cluster F1 and 26.5 binary-relation F1 on SciREX with 43-token average memory, outperforming MemAgent (49.9/19.2) and HiMPO (43.3/16.5)
Section 2.3, Eq. (7)-(11): MG_t = r_t^fact + Phi_{t+1} - Phi_t; shows E[psi_t Phi_t]=0 so the expected policy gradient is preserved (potential shaping)
Section 3.3: 'MGPO reduces aggregate across-rollout gradient variance by 24.9% (95% CI: 6.4%-42.6%)'
Appendix E.1, Figure 7: linearized surrogate tracks exact F1 gain with Spearman rho=0.988 on n=261 SciREX samples
Section 3.4, Table 2: one MGPO-trained 8B writer improves 6 readers across Qwen3, Llama3.1, Nemotron, Phi-4 families (e.g., Qwen3-14B cluster F1 40.0 to 51.3)
Appendix C.1, Table 3: SciREX test has 66 documents; AIPAN-10K is a 50-document subset (Appendix C.1) drawn from the authors' own prior corpus (Tang et al., 2026)

Appendix C.3: full hyperparameters (AdamW lr 1e-6, PPO clip 0.2, KL beta 1e-3, EMA alpha 0.9, 1 epoch) supporting reproducibility; Appendix C.5 states 'Full runtime prompts are released with the implementation' without a public repository link
Appendix G: acknowledges gain is 'attributed to the rewrite at which that utility becomes observable rather than divided among the preceding contributing updates'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology work: RL-trained persistent memory writer (Qwen3-8B) optimized against a frozen LLM reader, with clean potential-based credit-assignment theory (Eq. 7-11) showing Memory Gain preserves the factual policy gradient. Novel contribution is the 'inherited utility' decomposition and long-horizon counterfactual crediting of memory rewrites, clearly differentiated from HiMPO/MemAgent/Memory-R1 (Related Work), though it adapts established ideas (COMA, difference rewards, potential shaping from Ng et al. 1999). Rigor is strong: credit-assignment ablations (Terminal/Factual/Myopic/Full, Sec. 3.3), variance reduction 24.9% with CI, surrogate fidelity Spearman 0.988 (Appendix E.1), sampling-noise analysis (E.2), sensitivity and EMA-vs-GRPO cost comparisons (E.3-E.4). Evidence is solid but test sets are small (66 SciREX docs, 50 AIPAN-10K docs, Table 3), and AIPAN-10K comes from the same authors' prior work; apparently single training runs with 4 evaluation runs each. Generalizability is well supported: cross-reader transfer to 6 readers/4 families (Table 2), OOD domain/schema transfer (Table 1), BABILong up to 128K (Appendix D.2), though the reward requires structured gold supervision. Reproducibility is good (Algorithm 1, full hyperparameters Appendix C.3, prompts C.5) but no explicit public code link is stated. Limitations honestly note higher-order rewrite interactions are not decomposed (Appendix G).
topics: counterfactual credit assignment / RL policy optimization

primary_link.title: Learning What to Remember: Long-horizon Counterfactual Memory Optimization

papers.summary: Persistent textual memory allows language models to carry information across long interactions, but learning what to remember is fundamentally a credit-assignment problem. A memory rewrite may only become useful many steps later, while much of the observed utility may be inherited from information already stored before the rewrite. We introduce Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO), which isolates the incremental value of each memory rewrite by crediting it for its marginal contribution to curr
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型的持久記憶讓模型能在長時間互動中保留資訊，但學習該記住什麼本質上是個信用分配（credit assignment）問題：一次記憶改寫的價值可能要到很多步之後才顯現，且下游任務觀察到的效用多半繼承自改寫前已儲存的內容，掩蓋了最近一次更新的貢獻。本文提出記憶增益策略最佳化（Memory Gain Policy Optimization, MGPO），訓練一個可學習的記憶寫入器搭配固定的下游讀取器，反事實比較改寫前後記憶在同一批當前與未來目標上的效用差，定義記憶增益（Memory Gain），將延遲效用轉為密集的學習訊號；理論上此回報屬於位能塑形（potential-based reward shaping），期望策略梯度與原始事實目標一致，且如同控制變異數能降低估計變異。實驗以 SciREX 文件級資訊抽取為主，MGPO 相較 Direct Readout 將實體叢集 F1 提升 30.9%、二元關係 F1 提升 60.6%，平均記憶長度較初始策略縮減約 78.7%，並能在不額外訓練下遷移至不同領域的 AIPAN-10K、橫跨四大模型家族的多種讀取器，以及 BABILong 問答任務；消融實驗顯示長時程反事實信用（Full）優於事實回報、短視或終端獎勵等變體。限制方面，MGPO 未顯式分解多次改寫間的高階交互作用，效用浮現時功勞全歸當下改寫，反事實矩陣亦帶來額外評估成本，文件極長時訓練開銷可能超過 GRPO 等群組式方法。整體而言，本研究顯示有效的記憶學習關鍵不在單純保留有用資訊，而在辨識哪些記憶更新能創造持久的增量價值，對長文件處理與持久記憶系統設計具參考價值。
papers.title: Learning What to Remember: Long-horizon Counterfactual Memory Optimization
papers.title_zh: 學習該記住什麼：長時程反事實記憶最佳化

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: training-free inference-time sampling (Parallel Power Tempering) to improve reasoning in small LLMs, squarely matching LLM (w2.5), Reasoning/CoT (w2.5), Inference & Serving, and RL-via-GRPO-comparison preferences; clearly not an out-of-scope domain. Novelty is solid but incremental: parallel tempering/replica exchange is classical, power-sharpened MH sampling and LLM replica exchange already exist (Karan and Du 2026; He et al. 2026); the genuine new contributions are the truncation-bias analysis and fixed-horizon correction plus power-ladder design (Appendix C/D). Rigor is strong: exact kernel preservation and convergence proofs, compute-matched controls against deeper single-chain refinement, uncoupled ladders, and Best-of-N (Tables 4, 5, 10, 11), component ablations isolating fixed-horizon vs swaps (Table 12), ladder/replica/schedule ablations (Fig 5, Table 13), 5-seed std devs (Appendix H). Concerns: ladder powers, block sizes, and MCMC steps are tuned per model-benchmark (Tables 6-7) without a stated validation split, a mild overfitting risk; the 'matches or exceeds frontier models' claim is only partially supported (Table 2: ties GLM 4.7 on GPQA 85.9, trails on LCB 84.9 vs 89.4); some baseline numbers (PowerSMC collapse on AIME 61.7 for Qwen3-4B) are unexplained. Evidence strength is good with internally consistent tables and honest cost accounting (3.7x/2.5x memory, Table 3), but no code release is stated and the strongest headline claim is slightly overreached, capping the score in the upper 0.7s.

primary_link.title: Explore Broadly, Reason Sharply: Push Small Models toward the Frontier via Sampling

papers.summary: Power-sharpened sampling is an inference-time alternative to reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training for enhancing reasoning in large language models (LLMs). High-probability sequences are amplified under the base model without parameter updates or external rewards, avoiding the costly optimization and jagged generalization of RL. However, this approach faces a fundamental exploration--exploitation trade-off, as % strong sharpening restricts exploration, trapping samplers in plausible but inco
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出一種不需訓練、在推論時提升大型語言模型推理能力的方法。RL 後訓練（如 GRPO）成本高昂且可能有泛化不均的問題；既有的冪次銳化抽樣（Power Sampling）雖免於參數更新，卻面臨探索與利用的兩難：銳化過強會讓抽樣器陷入看似合理但錯誤的推理路徑，過弱則答案分佈過於分散。作者提出 Parallel Power Tempering（PPT），將平行回火（parallel tempering／replica exchange）MCMC 應用於序列層級的冪次銳化抽樣：多個副本在強度不同的冪次階梯上並行執行，低冪次副本自由探索多樣推理軌跡，高冪次副本專注於高似然回應，相鄰副本依 Metropolis–Hastings 準則互換整條序列；由於序列對數機率已快取，交換幾乎不需額外模型運算。論文並指出早期停止式冪次抽樣存在單向截斷偏差，一旦提早 EOS 便無法回復，改以固定長度上限（EOS 後補滿填充符）的建構消除偏差，證明其核心保持目標分佈並漸近收斂。實驗在 Qwen3-4B/8B、Qwen3.5-9B 等模型與數學、科學、程式設計六大基準上進行：PPT 於全部 15 個模型—基準組合皆為最佳或並列最佳，計算量匹配的控制實驗顯示增益來自交換機制而非額外算力；以 Qwen3.5-9B 時甚至匹敵 GPT-5、Opus 4.5 等前沿模型。限制包括高峰值記憶體用量（約為單鏈的 2.5 至 3.7 倍）、副本數超過四至五個後收益遞減，且在其他模型家族上的改善較不一致。此結果顯示小型凍結模型無需 RL 後訓練即可逼近前沿推理水準。

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1: piPPO overall 50.3% (Qwen3-4B) and 51.6% (Qwen3-8B) vs DAPO 46.2/49.3, VAPO 45.3/47.6, PPO 43.5/47.9, GRPO 45.2/48.3 across AIME24/25, BeyondAIME, HMMT Feb/Nov

Section 5.2, Table 2: ablations w/o labels 44.1, w/ same polarity 43.6, w/ GT only 45.6 vs full 50.3 (Qwen3-4B), linking gains to contrastive organization of online evidence
Section 4.3: asymmetric 0.6B/1.7B critics cut parameters ~85%/79% with EV 0.655/0.632 vs actor-sized PPO 0.446/0.564; overall drops only 2.5/1.7 points
Section 3.2, Eq. (6)-(7): privileged critic value is action-independent so remains a valid baseline; actor conditioning identical at train and inference; Propositions 1-2 with proofs in Appendix A
Appendix B.1: 250 steps, Clip-Higher 0.2/0.28, gamma=lambda=1.0, 50-step frozen-actor value pretraining; no seed count, variance across runs, or code-release statement given

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: improves PPO value estimation in RLVR by conditioning the critic on leave-target-out verified sibling rollouts while keeping the actor's conditioning and inference interface unchanged. Strongly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, RLHF/RL, training). Method is a fresh but adjacent contribution—critic-side privileged information differs from hint-based RL and on-policy self-distillation, and the paper includes a clean validity argument (Eq. 6 baseline property) plus two elementary variance-decomposition propositions. Evidence is solid: controlled comparisons vs PPO/VAPO/GRPO/DAPO on shared hyperparameters (Sec 4.1), consistent gains (Table 1: 50.3%/51.6% overall vs best baseline 46.2%/49.3%), EV/loss improvements (Fig 2), MC-reference diagnostics (Sec 5.1), and component ablations (Table 2). Weaknesses: single training domain (DAPO-17K math), single model family, no multi-seed variance or confidence intervals on small AIME/HMMT sets, two of three self-distillation baselines reportedly collapsed under adaptation (Appendix D.2), and no explicit code release; proofs are straightforward. Reproducibility support is strong (Algorithm 1, prompt template, hyperparameters) but seeds and artifacts are unstated.

Their effectiveness, however, hinges on reliable value estimation, a difficult task requiring the critic to both assess progress toward a correct solution and anticipate an evolving policy's future behavior; errors in
papers.summary_zh: 在以可驗證獎勵進行強化學習（RLVR）訓練大型語言模型時，稀疏的終端獎勵使中間步驟的信用分配成為核心難題。PPO 等 actor-critic 方法依賴價值函數產生 token 級優勢估計，但傳統評論家僅能依據當前狀態預測期望回報，須同時理解正確解的空間並預測策略未來行為，估計品質難以保證。本文從資訊角度重新檢視價值估計，並在理論上證明僅以狀態為條件的預測風險存在下限，而額外證據可降低此種不確定性。作者據此提出 πPPO：將同一提示下已驗證的 rollout 群組轉化為對比式證據，為每條目標軌跡構建排除自身的參考脈絡（涵蓋成功與失敗範例），僅供評論家使用；此特權價值估計仍是有效的策略梯度基線，不影響 actor 的訓練與推論一致性，也無需額外生成。在 Qwen3-4B 與 Qwen3-8B 上以 DAPO-17K 訓練，πPPO 於 AIME、HMMT 等五項數學基準的平均準確率達 50.3% 與 51.6%，優於 PPO、VAPO、GRPO 與 DAPO，並展現更高的解釋變異數與更低的價值損失；消融實驗顯示正確性標籤與相反結果的對照範例是成效關鍵。即使改用 0.6B/1.7B 的小型非對稱評論家，優勢仍大致保留。其限制在於依賴分組 rollout 與可驗證的二元獎勵，實驗亦聚焦數學推理，跨領域泛化僅屬初步驗證。整體而言，本研究為 RLVR 的信用分配提供了以資訊補充為核心的新設計視角。

links.title: How Local Mixing Encodes Relative Position in Global NoPE Attention

evidence: Abstract: 'SWA and gated linear attention induce a recency bias in the residual stream that propagates to, and is selected by, the global attention logits' - central mechanistic claim.
Section III-B: models at '120M and 350M scales', SWA windows 'w ∈ {64,...,4096}', trained on the Prolong dataset, 12B/24B tokens - experimental scale stated.

Section IV-B: 'smaller windows achieve lower loss than their larger-windowed counterparts... these experiments did not match compute across window sizes' - acknowledged confound in the performance evidence.
Section VII: 'we still have not developed a complete quantitative account of how the recency bias propagates through all modules' - stated limitation.
Appendix D-B: random-token controls 'corroborate the main-text findings' though logit transfer is 'less consistent than in natural language' - control evidence with caveats.
Appendix E-B: 'the same empirical pattern appears' for KDA-interleaved models - mechanism extends beyond SWA to gated linear attention.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-architecture interpretability work highly aligned with LLM (Kimi K3, Qwen3-Next, Gemma references), Transformer Architecture, Interpretability, and Long Context preferences; not out of scope. Novelty is solid but incremental over Zuo et al. (2025) and Puvvada et al. (2025), extending recency-bias analysis from short global-NoPE sequences to hybrid models at scale. Rigor is strong: paired theory (moving-average/cross-moment derivations, KDA exponential profile) and empirics (120M/350M, seven window sizes, RoPE/NoPE-in-SWA, random-token controls, KDA extension). Evidence is largely correlational; authors concede the window-size/loss link is confounded ('did not match compute across window sizes', Sec. IV-B) and no causal ablations are performed. Generalizability is decent across two scales and two local mixers but untested at frontier scale. Reproducibility is middling: training/measurement setups are detailed (Appendix A) but no code or checkpoint release is stated.

primary_link.title: How Local Mixing Encodes Relative Position in Global NoPE Attention

papers.summary: The attention operation is naively position invariant. However, positional information is fundamental to natural language, and therefore a variety of explicit position encodings have been developed in transformer-based models, such as rotary position encoding (RoPE). Although explicit position encodings have long been assumed to be required, recent methods that interleave local mixing layers, such as sliding window attention (SWA) and gated linear attention, while not encoding position (NoPE) in
papers.summary_zh: 注意力本身對位置排列不變,因此 Transformer 通常仰賴 RoPE 等顯式位置編碼。然而近期混合架構交錯使用滑動視窗注意力(SWA)或 KDA 等閘控線性注意力與全域 NoPE 注意力層,並在大規模訓練中展現成效,但這些模型如何在 NoPE 層表示位置仍不清楚。本文提出機制性解釋:局部混合層會在殘差流中誘發近因偏誤,該偏誤經殘差相加、正規化與 MLP 傳遞,再被全域 NoPE 注意力的 query-key 投影讀取,形成隱性的相對位置編碼。理論上,SWA 在期望上近似移動平均卷積,其近因尺度由視窗大小決定,不隨序列長度稀釋;相較之下,僅靠因果遮罩的全域 NoPE 位置訊號會隨長度衰減。實證以 120M 與 350M 模型驗證:近因偏誤在初始化即存在,並隨訓練與深度增強;較小視窗產生更強偏誤,且驗證損失更低(NoPE-in-SWA 的大視窗甚至訓練崩潰);隨機詞元對照與 KDA 延伸實驗亦支持此機制。限制方面,作者尚未建立偏誤跨模組傳播的完整量化理論,也未量化其與長度泛化能力的關聯,視窗對損失的比較亦未隔離近因因素。此研究釐清了無顯式位置編碼的混合模型為何有效,並為可外推至更長序列的位置編碼設計提供指引。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability work (attention-head scoring, attribution patching, zero-ablation, RSA) squarely matching LLM, transformer-attention, and interpretability preferences, evaluated against human EEG rather than being a domain application. The claimed novelty—a direct test of whether brain-aligned heads are causally important by ablating them—is credible and yields a clear dissociation (Section 2, Figure 3). Rigor is high: attribution patching validated against activation patching (r=.983, 95% top-20 overlap, Appendix A.3.4), random and layer-matched controls, damage-matched random sets (Appendix A.6.1), and a 17-model replication cohort with bootstrap bands. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent (FV peak excess loss 42.6 pp vs 12.8 pp brain-ranked; repetition removal preserves concept RSA while costing accuracy). Generalizability is limited by a single abstract-pattern task, one group-average frontal-FRP RDM with only 28 dependent comparisons, and fixed raw three-shot prompting, all acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is supported by unusually detailed appendices (prompts, seed 42, electrode lists, pipeline stages) but no explicit code-release URL is stated.

primary_link.title: Which Attention Heads are like the Human Head? Not the Ones that Compute
