On an abstract pattern-completion task (AAABAAA $\rightarrow$ B), we compare LLM attention-head representations with human EEG and test how ablating those heads affects task performance. Alignment and causation dissociate: brain-aligned heads contribute to performance, but their removal is substantially less d
papers.summary_zh: 大腦—AI對齊常被解讀為模型與人腦執行相似運算的證據，但被對齊的單元是否真參與運算，鮮少被直接檢驗。本研究以抽象序列填空任務（如AAABAAA→B）為平台，比較LLM注意力頭表徵與人類腦電圖（EEG額葉FRP，與眼球注視鎖定）的相似度，並透過消融實驗直接檢驗其因果貢獻。作者為每個頭計算三種分數：腦對齊分數、以attribution patching估計對正確答案預測貢獻的FV分數，以及衡量跨格式抽象圖形表徵的CV分數，並在17個3B–72B參數的模型（Llama、Qwen、Phi-4、DeepSeek蒸餾版）上依序累積移除頭部。結果顯示腦對齊與因果重要性大致脫鉤：腦分數與patching效應僅微弱相關，FV排序的移除破壞力遠大於腦排序（超出隨機消融的峰值損失42.6對12.8個百分點）。腦對齊頭呈現兩種跨模型重複出現的注意力輪廓：偏好獨特符號的novelty頭，移除損害甚至低於隨機；偏好重複符號的repetition頭，與CV表徵相關，移除中度損害表現卻未摧毀可測得的圖形資訊。novelty頭的注意力更呼應人類注視的模式相依變化。限制包括僅八種圖形、固定三範例提示與單一額葉FRP目標，novelty頭在其他運算中的角色亦未完全排除。本研究提醒：與人腦相似並不可靠地指出模型解題所依賴的元件；對齊更多反映模型如何閱讀刺激，而非如何解題。
papers.title: Which Attention Heads are like the Human Head? Not the Ones that Compute
papers.title_zh: 哪些注意力頭像人腦？並非真正負責運算的那些

links.title: Scaling Influence Functions in LLMs through Eigenbasis-Corrected One-Bit Gradient Projection

evidence: Abstract: 'On GPT-2, EOGP predicts retraining outcomes more accurately than the evaluated compression baselines while using one-sixteenth of their per-example storage. On OLMo 2 SFT models from 1B to 32B parameters, EOGP remains competitive with the baselines allocated over 100 times as much storage per example.'

Section 3.1, Proposition 1 (proof in Section A.1): storing 'U^top t~_i', the top-k PCA coordinates of half-whitened training gradients, minimizes the worst-case influence error E(V,M) in Equation 7 among k-dimensional linear representations.

Section 4.1 Results: 'In LDS, EOGP at 96 KB exceeds all compression-based baselines at 1,536 KB, despite using 16 times less per-example storage. At 384 KB, it achieves LDS close to the uncompressed K-FAC reference.'

Section 4.2 (Figure 3): EK-FAC-fidelity proxy validated on GPT-2 with 'Spearman correlations (rho) between the x-axis metric and LDS across configurations: 0.95 for NDCG@20 and 0.84 for overall ranking agreement.'

Section 4.3: ablations on OLMo 2 7B at matched storage budgets and matched coordinate counts; 'one-bit and FP16 representations achieve similar NDCG@20, indicating that one-bit quantization substantially reduces storage with little loss in ranking agreement.'

Appendix F: 'we construct variants of LoGra and GraSS that apply our EK-FAC half-whitening before their respective projections... EOGP substantially outperforms both variants at matched per-example storage budgets,' addressing the circularity of sharing the reference curvature.
Appendix E.3, Table 3: store-construction time 0.247 s/example for EOGP vs 0.278 for LoGra on the 32B model on a single NVIDIA B200; PCA fitting is a one-time 18.4-minute cost.

Appendix C: full experimental configuration including named checkpoints (e.g., allenai/OLMo-2-1124-7B-SFT), damping lambda_u = 0.1 tr(Lambda_u)/d_u, and a PCA fitting set of 10,000 conversations; Appendix D specifies LDS/counterfactual and NDCG@20/Spearman protocols with seeds and bootstrap resamples.

Section 4.2 limitations acknowledged: 'Since retraining-based evaluation is computationally prohibitive at this scale, we use agreement with EK-FAC influence rankings as a proxy for attribution quality.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on reusable compressed gradient stores for influence-based training-data attribution, spanning GPT-2 and OLMo 2 (1B-32B) with strong efficiency framing. Contributes a clean worst-case optimality result for half-whitened PCA compression (Prop. 1, proof in A.1), an EK-FAC-subspace PCA refinement with a monotone-error guarantee (Prop. 2), and one-bit scaled sign quantization. Rigor is solid: retraining-based validation (LDS, counterfactual retraining with 5 seeds and bootstrap CIs, Sec. D.1), multiple compression baselines (LoGra, GraSS, LoRIF, Gaussian control), component ablations at matched storage and matched coordinates (Sec. 4.3), and a control in Appendix F showing the advantage is not from matching the reference curvature. Main weakness is that billion-parameter evaluation relies on fidelity to EK-FAC rather than retraining ground truth, mitigated but not eliminated by the GPT-2 proxy validation (rho 0.95/0.84, Sec. 4.2). Theory is competent but builds on standard Eckart-Young arguments; method assembles known pieces (EK-FAC, PCA, SRHT, 1-bit quantization) in a well-motivated new combination. Detailed configs and runtime accounting support reproducibility, though no explicit code-release claim is made.

primary_link.title: Scaling Influence Functions in LLMs through Eigenbasis-Corrected One-Bit Gradient Projection

papers.summary: Influence functions estimate how individual training examples affect the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Analyzing how training data influence different behaviors of an LLM involves repeated influence computation. Reusing stored training gradients reduces the computational cost, but storing full gradients is prohibitively expensive at LLM scale. We study how to compress these gradients while preserving influence estimates for future queries that are unknown at storage time. Through a w
papers.summary_zh: 影響函數能估計個別訓練範例對大型語言模型（LLM）行為的影響，是訓練資料歸因的基礎工具。重複使用預先儲存的訓練梯度可避免反覆反向傳播，但在 LLM 規模下，單一範例的完整梯度即需數十 GB，直接儲存不可行。本文探討如何在未來查詢未知的前提下壓縮梯度並保留影響估計品質。作者在標準化最壞情況影響誤差準則下證明：對半白化（half-whitened）訓練梯度取前 k 個 PCA 座標，是所有 k 維線性表示中的最佳選擇。據此提出 EOGP：先以 EK-FAC 曲率近似降低梯度維度，再於保留子空間內以 PCA 校正壓縮基底，最後進行一位元量化，僅儲存每個座標的正負號與每模組一個縮放係數，使固定預算下能保留更多座標；另提供以 SRHT 取代 PCA 的 EOGP-R 變體以因應較大維度。實驗顯示，在 GPT-2 上，EOGP 以每範例 96 KB 的儲存即勝過基線方法使用 16 倍空間的結果，並以遠低於 400 倍的空間逼近未壓縮 K-FAC 參考的線性資料建模分數（LDS）；反事實重訓中，其選出的範例移除後造成更大的困惑度上升。於 1B 至 32B 的 OLMo 2 SFT 模型上，EOGP 在約 10⁴ 至 10⁶ 倍壓縮率下仍準確重現 EK-FAC 影響排名，每範例低於 16 KB 仍具競爭力。限制包括 32B 模型的共用 PCA 校正矩陣需約 481 GB（雖可隨儲存規模攤提），且大規模評估以 EK-FAC 一致性作為代理指標，而非直接以重訓驗證。此研究使可重複使用的梯度儲存庫在 LLM 規模更為實用，有助於資料選擇、微調除錯與不良行為來源分析。
papers.title: Scaling Influence Functions in LLMs through Eigenbasis-Corrected One-Bit Gradient Projection
papers.title_zh: 透過特徵基底校正的一位元梯度投影，擴展 LLM 影響函數規模

links.title: Merged, Not Measured: An Empirical Study of Performance Issues Fixed by Coding Agents

evidence: Section 3.1 / Table 1: three-step pipeline (text filter, model codebook coding, author codebook coding) reduces 71,677 AIDev v4 agent PRs to 1,262 confirmed performance fixes in 582 repositories, with Cohen's kappa 0.86 (models) and 0.91 (authors), plus a 1-in-10 audit of model rejections at kappa 0.96.

Section 4.3 / Figure 4: pilot re-execution of 23 rejected fixes with attached measurements found 6 reproduced, 4 partly reproduced, 13 failed (median speed-up 1.02x), including fixes that run slower or omit the claimed change.

Section 5.1 / Table 8: nested logistic models show the repository-history block (F4) lifts pseudo R-squared from 0.145 to 0.232 with pre-opening merge rate OR 13.7 (CI 6.3-30.0), while coded content and description features are not significant; deleted-line share is the only fix-level variable surviving within agent and repository (OR 10.5).

Section 7.3: of 30 re-executed merged fixes, 18 met the delivery criterion, 3 fell below the claim, 9 showed no significant gain or regressed, and 14 changed behavior on untested inputs; the paper explicitly refuses to compare the two re-execution arms due to different sampling and protocols.

Section 9: threats section acknowledges same-vendor bias risk (Claude Opus judge/executing agent vs 60 Claude Code fixes), possible training-data contamination for the judge, purposive merged-arm sampling, and that content differences (lazy evaluation, file-count gradient) would weaken under multiple-testing correction.

Declarations (Data and code availability): data, codebooks, coding sheets, model outputs, container results and scripts are available 'upon acceptance' with a DOI archive to follow, so artifact availability is promised but not yet publicly verifiable.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An empirical mining study of six LLM-based coding agents' performance-fix PRs, squarely matching the high-weight Agents & Tool Use (coding agents, agent misbehavior, agent evaluation) and Code & Programming preferences, with secondary LLM relevance since the agents and the study instruments are LLM systems. Novelty is solid: it is the first to hand-confirm agent performance fixes, separate fix content from repository history, and re-execute claimed speed-ups on both rejected and merged PRs. Rigor is high: staged dataset construction with reported kappas (0.86 model, 0.91 author), nested logistic models with clustered SEs, within-agent/within-repository contrasts, blind-pair judging, and an unusually candid threats-to-validity section (same-vendor judge bias, multiple testing, purposive merged-arm sampling). Evidence is strong for the association findings (repository history and deleted-line share) via converging analyses, though the re-execution claims rest on small samples (23-run pilot with mostly agent-constructed workloads; 30 purposively selected merged fixes) and are honestly framed as not population rates. Generalizability is bounded by one AIDev v4 snapshot, >100-star repos, and feasibility-filtered re-execution. Reproducibility is supported by detailed protocols and promised replication packages, but artifacts are only available 'upon acceptance'. Overall a well-calibrated, relevant, carefully executed empirical contribution.

primary_link.title: Merged, Not Measured: An Empirical Study of Performance Issues Fixed by Coding Agents

From the 71,677 agent PRs of AIDev v4, a text filter and codebook coding by language models and by the authors select 1,262 performance issues fixed by six agents in 582 repositories. We code each issue and its tests and re-execute 23 rejected and 30 merged fixes. (1) 57% of closed fixes are merged, 61% o
papers.summary_zh: 本論文實證探討六大編碼代理（Copilot、Codex、Devin、Cursor、Claude Code、Jules）在 GitHub 上修復效能問題之 pull request 的接受情形與實際效益。團隊從 AIDev v4 的 71,677 筆代理 PR 中，先以啟發式語言模式文字過濾，再由語言模型與作者依編碼手冊雙重編碼，選出 582 個儲存庫中的 1,262 個效能修復，並重新執行 23 個被拒與 30 個已合併的修復以檢驗其宣稱。主要發現：（1）已關閉修復的合併率為 57%，61% 的拒絕未說明理由，被拒修復重跑後僅 6/23 的宣稱成立；（2）接受與否最受儲存庫對代理 PR 的既有態度影響：開啟前合併率由 33% 升至 84%，代理過往紀錄亦使接受率從 31–37% 升至 70%；修復內容變項（根本原因、描述、測試、附帶量測）多無區別力，僅刪除行比例（0.26 對 0.15）在代理內與儲存庫內皆穩定成立；（3）重複運算與冗餘資料處理佔成因 44%，46% 的修復屬架構層級（人類為 27%），快取是最常見解法；（4）37% 的修復更動測試，僅 11% 附效能測試或基準；重跑 30 個已合併修復，18 個達交付標準、9 個無顯著增益或反而退化，14 個在未測輸入上改變行為。研究限制包括重跑樣本小、工作負載多由代理自建，且屬觀察性關聯而非因果證據。本文凸顯合併不代表宣稱屬實：維護者應親自重量測，以合併作為品質標記的研究則須控制儲存庫歷史。

links.title: KV-Kaizen: Learning Context-Adaptive Cache Compression Choices

evidence: Abstract & Section 3.4, Table 2: composed 4x cache configuration plus SnapKV keep-0.125 yields 32x decode-time reduction on Qwen2.5-14B at 16k with QA 0.531 vs 0.543 uncompressed control (-0.012, within reported seed range)

Section 3.2 & Table 10: post-hoc plain 4-bit quantization collapses to 0.057 mean accuracy while the same quantizer trained-under reaches 0.670, supporting the 'model must train under the configuration' claim; KIVI post-hoc caps near 5x
Section 3.3 & Table 1: at 4x reduction, precision+depth is -0.000 vs control at 7B and +0.031 at 14B, but depth alone is -0.283 at 7B; gap closes with model size across Qwen2.5, Mistral-7B, OLMo-3-7B

Table 16 (Appendix F.6): seed variance up to 0.053 on the uncompressed 7B control, explicitly used as the bold-marking threshold; several headline differences (e.g., +0.040 at 14B) sit near this noise band

Table 7 (Appendix D.2): adaptive rate multiplier is worse than a swept constant in 4 of 10 pairs, by up to 0.307 (precision+depth, 7B, 8x), an honestly reported method weakness with a proposed cap fix

Table 15 (Appendix F.5): evenly spaced anchors (0.452) beat the learned placement (0.396) at 7B depth-only, and no-sharing (0.571) matches the learned selector, partially undercutting context-adaptivity
Table 20 (Appendix F.9): six of twelve selectors return a single cache configuration across 224 prompts, so per-context selection is inconsistent across models/budgets

Appendix B: full optimizer settings (AdamW, lr 1e-5, 270k steps, 8 GPUs), public Dolci-Instruct-SFT dataset with HF link, complete selector architecture (2.6-3.7M params), quantizer formula, and adaptive-beta rule (lambda 0.9, eta 0.05, delta 0.02), but no code-release statement

Section 6 limitations: mixed-width/bit configurations need specialized kernels, MLA conversion cost varies by model (e.g., -0.105 at 7B), and budget conditioning degrades as the target range widens (Table 18)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A technically strong LLM inference-efficiency paper squarely on core preferences (LLMs, KV cache/serving, scaling & efficiency, quantization, long context). Novelty is compositional rather than conceptual: depth sharing, MLA rank, and KV quantization each exist, and the paper honestly positions itself against learned per-layer allocators (MatryoshkaKV, KVTuner, STAR-KV, Palu, DMC), claiming the unified 17-action space, single bits/token budget, and runtime budget conditioning as the contribution. Rigor and evidence are unusually good: fine-tuned controls per attention class, static/random/search baselines, seed-variance reporting (0.053) used as a significance threshold, honest negative results (adaptive beta loses to swept constant by up to 0.307 in Table 7; evenly spaced anchors beat learned placement at 7B in Table 15), storage-overhead accounting, and on-device benchmarks. Caveats: many reported gaps are within seed noise, the task suite is narrow (IFEval, GSM8K, RULER only), several selectors degenerate to a single static configuration (Table 20), the method needs an expensive 270k-step SFT plus CARE MLA conversion and specialized kernels, and no code release is stated despite very detailed hyperparameters. Overall a well-executed, relevant, incrementally novel systems contribution.

primary_link.title: KV-Kaizen: Learning Context-Adaptive Cache Compression Choices

papers.summary: As the context size of text processed with an LLM grows, the size of KV caches can outstrip the memory allocated for the original model weights. This impacts LLM throughput negatively, since decoding is memory-bound and decode cost grows with cache size. Recent work alleviates this bottleneck by discarding the least relevant tokens. Eviction introduces a tension, since a one-off decision to discard content may prove detrimental later. Instead, we focus on alternative choices that can lead to cac
papers.summary_zh: 此論文針對大型語言模型推論時 KV cache 膨脹的瓶頸：上下文越長，快取記憶體可能超過模型權重本身，而解碼受記憶體頻寬限制，快取越大吞吐量越低。有別於永久丟棄 token 的驅逐式方法，作者提出 KV-Kaizen，訓練輕量選擇器讀取提示詞的 embedding，在統一預算下為每一層挑選三種壓縮軸線的組合：跨層共用快取的深度、降低位元寬度的精度，以及截斷 MLA 潛在表示的 rank，並以每 token 位元數作為共同成本。選擇器以 Gumbel-softmax 與直通估計器訓練，損失結合語言建模與預算達成項，並與主幹模型一起 fine-tuning，使模型適應實際快取組態；推論時僅在 pre-fill 前執行一次，約 3 毫秒。實驗涵蓋 1.5B 至 32B 多個模型家族：在 IFEval 與 GSM8K 上，學到的逐層組態在相同快取大小下優於靜態、隨機與 post-hoc 量化（如 KIVI）等基線；7B 以上模型 4 倍壓縮幾乎無準確度損失，且壓縮後的大模型比同快取大小的較小未壓縮模型更準。在 16k 長上下文 RULER 上，本方法可與 SnapKV 等驅逐法疊加相乘，於 Qwen2.5-14B 達到 32 倍解碼快取縮減且準確度與控制組相當；Apple M3 Ultra 實測也顯示尖峰記憶體近乎持平、解碼更快。限制包括混合層寬度與位元寬度需要專用 kernel、rank 軸依賴 MLA 轉換且轉換本身有準確度成本、預算條件化在目標範圍過寬時會降低準確度。整體支持「先訓練大模型、部署前再壓縮」的實務策略。

links.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments on Qwen3.8-27B and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct across both long- and short-generation benchmarks show that STEPQuant closely matches FP32-state accuracy under a nominal 6-bit budget'
Sec 5.2/Table 1: STEPQuant@6bit mean 80.59% vs FP32 80.60% and INT6 45.04% on Qwen; STEPQuant@4bit 80.51% outperforms uniform INT8 (71.86%)
Sec 3.1/Appendix B.5: gate half-life vs accumulated INT6 state error with full-population Spearman correlations 0.8004 (Qwen) and 0.8017 (KDA)
Sec 5.4/Table 4: component ablation on Qwen, STEPQuant@4bit 84.72% vs Spatial-only 73.95%, Temporal-only 12.87%, Q-Mamba@4bit 7.64%, FP32 84.61%

Appendix G/Table G8: DAMP comparison is cross-study, 'differences in evaluation settings preclude a strictly controlled cross-study comparison' (6.30 bits, 100.51% retention vs DAMP 9.9 bits, 100.99%)

Appendix H Limitations: 'Our evaluation covers two GDN/KDA models under fixed hardware and workload settings; accuracy and systems gains on other architectures and under dynamic serving workloads remain to be verified'
Sec 5.6/Appendix F.5: 68.7% total serving memory reduction at batch 512 (419.73 to 131.18 GiB) and up to 20.53% decode throughput gain on Qwen, with documented timing protocol

Reproducibility Statement and code link https://github.com/Dreamer-Toby/STEPQuant; Appendices C and D specify calibration data (32 WikiText-2 segments), allocation optimizers, and analytical storage costs (6.361/4.621 bits per value for Qwen)
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM systems paper: post-training quantization of Delta-rule recurrent states in linear-attention LLMs (Qwen3.8-27B, Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B) for serving efficiency, evaluated on standard reasoning/code/language benchmarks. Strong core match to LLM, scaling/efficiency (quantization, compression), inference/serving, and transformer-architecture (linear attention, SSM/Mamba-adjacent) preferences; reasoning and code appear only as evaluation domains. Novelty is moderate-solid: lifetime-aware bit allocation and key-row-aware dual-axis fitting are engineered combinations of known mixed-precision and scaling ideas, but the temporal error-propagation analysis and application to gated Delta-rule states are new relative to Quamba2/Q-Mamba/DAMP. Rigor and evidence are strong: formal error propagation result, controlled intervention experiments, 13 benchmarks, component ablations against adapted Q-Mamba DSQ, memory/throughput accounting, generation-length analysis, and an honest limitations section. Caveats: only two hybrid GDN/KDA models on one hardware configuration, cross-study (not controlled) DAMP comparison, and a minor table cross-reference slip (Sec 5.2 cites Table 2 for long-generation results that are in Table 1). Generalizability beyond Delta-rule recurrent states is unverified, which the authors acknowledge. Reproducibility is high with released code, pinned SGLang version, and detailed calibration/storage protocols.

Directly quantizing recurrent states to low precision often leads to severe accuracy degradation, as quantization errors propagate through successive state updates. We discover that the impact of these errors depends on two complementary dimensions: temporally, errors in long-lived memory can persist across many decoding st
papers.summary_zh: 線性注意力以固定大小的循環狀態取代隨序列增長的 KV cache,但在併發服務下,每個請求都需保留一份常駐狀態,狀態池記憶體占用隨併發數上升,甚至可能超過模型權重本身。然而直接對循環狀態做均勻低位元量化會嚴重損害準確率,因為量化誤差會透過後續狀態更新不斷累積傳播。本文從「時間」與「空間」兩個維度分析誤差:時間上,閘門保留率越高的記憶單元,誤差存續越久、累積越大;空間上,不同 key row 的誤差對輸出影響不同,且狀態量值在列與行兩個軸向都存在明顯離群值。據此,作者提出空間—時間後訓練量化框架 STEPQuant:一是「壽命感知位元配置」,以混合精度給誤差大且存續久的單元分配較多位元,並以稀疏 FP16 pivot 保護高風險單元;二是「key-row 感知雙軸縮放」,為 key row 與 value column 分別配置縮放因子,並依各 row 對輸出誤差的影響加權。在 Qwen3.8-27B 與 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct 的七項長生成與六項短生成任務上,6-bit STEPQuant 幾乎追平 FP32 狀態基準,4-bit 配置更優於均勻 INT8。整合至 SGLang 並搭配最佳化 GPU kernel 後,可達逾 5 倍狀態壓縮,總服務記憶體最多降低 68.7%,狀態更新加速 2.91 倍。限制方面,壽命權重僅以閘門衰減近似誤差存續,KDA 在 4-bit 長生成任務仍有精度損失,評估亦僅涵蓋兩種模型與固定硬體設定。此研究證明循環狀態可量化至 8-bit 以下,對記憶體高效的 LLM 併發部署深具意義。
papers.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
papers.title_zh: STEPQuant:Delta-Rule 循環狀態量化中,誤差發生的時間與位置為何關鍵

links.title: It's All Training: A Fully Synthetic Single-Stage Recipe for LLMs

evidence: §4.2/Table 8 (Appendix H): matched 600M runs — Synth without post-training scores 42.2 MCQ / 24.3 open-ended vs post-trained FineWiki 26.1/10.2 and FinePDFs-Edu 25.1/13.5, an 11–17 point gap
§4.2/Table 9: retraining 600M without reasoning traces (matched tokens, optimizer steps, unique examples, seed) drops TruthfulQA −9.1 and NuclearQA −10.0 while MCQ changes only +0.4

§5.1/Table 1 + Appendix F: Baguettotron-600M macro 41.7%±2.2 vs Qwen3-0.6B 31.6%±2.1 on 500 entities, with cluster-bootstrap CIs (B=10,000) and paired Wilcoxon tests; claims of best token-efficiency per tier are table-supported

§5.1/Appendix G: held-out Good-Article entities show Baguettotron-MoE abstention 67% vs 20% in-seed and attempted precision 82%→62% (OLMoE 7% abstain, 81% precision), honestly bounding the factuality claim; Aho–Corasick leakage scan reported
Appendix C: 16,044 H100 GPU-hours incl. 10,804 generation and 81,264 Gemini 2.5 Pro Stage-1 calls (133.2M output tokens) — transparent cost accounting for the pipeline
NeurIPS Checklist Q5/Q13: Synth (CC BY 4.0) and Baguettotron models (Apache-2.0) released with a 5k-row sample and FActScore eval code, but 'Training and data-generation code is not released'

§7 Limitations: hard knowledge ceiling from ~58k seed articles, English-centric seed selection, difficulty calibrated for SLMs; baselines in §4.1 'differ from ours in architecture, tokenizer, data, and post-training, so we report them as context'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference core LLM research: fully synthetic single-stage pretraining recipe (LLM weight 2.5), back-translated reasoning traces and trace-ablation analysis (Reasoning 2.5), RAG-style grounded generation and FActScore-style factuality (RAG 1.8), tool-calling adaptation with BFCL v2 (Agents 2.5), plus scaling/efficiency framing. Novelty is a solid but incremental synthesis of known threads (Phi-1.5/Cosmopedia synthetic pretraining, EntiGraph/Active Reading augmentation): the seed-grounded back-translation with constraint priors, injected refusals, and stenographic+epistemic reasoning syntax and the collapse of pre/mid/post-training into one stage are the new elements. Rigor is above average: matched 600M data ablation (Table 8), reasoning-trace ablation matched on tokens/steps/seed (Table 9), cluster-bootstrap CIs and paired Wilcoxon tests (Appendix F), held-out entity validation with leakage scanning (Appendix G), and full compute accounting (Appendix C); weaknesses are single pretraining runs, LLM-judged fact verification, and cross-model comparisons that are explicitly 'context' only since baselines differ in architecture/tokenizer/post-training. Evidence is quantified and honestly hedged (models lag on ARC-Challenge/GeoBench; held-out precision drops 82%→62%), supporting the main claims. Generalizability is demonstrated across 56M–13B MoE and a telecom domain, but bounded by a 58k-article seed ceiling, English-centric seeds, and SLM-calibrated difficulty (§7). Reproducibility is good but incomplete: Synth (CC BY 4.0) and models (Apache-2.0) are released with detailed hyperparameters, yet training/data-generation code is not released and Stage-1 depends on 81k Gemini 2.5 Pro calls.

primary_link.title: It's All Training: A Fully Synthetic Single-Stage Recipe for LLMs

papers.summary: Current pre-training datasets are derived from web crawls, with all their issues, and were not designed to support mid- and post-training pipelines--for instance, they contain little explicit reasoning. Thus, many frontier labs have begun to develop their own internal datasets, starting from state-of-the-art models, to augment their pre-training data mix, eg, with reasoning traces to address cold-start problems. While demonstratively effective, none of these datasets are public, and the effect o
papers.summary_zh: 本論文針對當前LLM預訓練資料依賴網路爬蟲、難以控管且缺乏顯性推理內容的問題。頂尖實驗室雖已改用內部合成資料補強，但均未公開，其對模型知識與技能習得的影響也缺乏系統性研究。作者提出Synth：首個開源的全合成訓練語料庫，以58,698篇Wikipedia文章為受控種子，透過兩階段管線生成約800億token、8種語言的資料——先以frontier LLM蒸餾監督fine-tuning查詢與推理兩個輔助模型，再由種子段落反向生成記憶問答、RAG、算術、創意寫作、編輯等任務，並混入20%拒答與糾正範例，使預訓練、中期訓練與後訓練合併為單一階段，全程不需SFT或RLHF。團隊據此從頭訓練Monad（56M）、Baguettotron-350M/600M，以及13B總參數、1B啟用參數的Mixture-of-Experts模型。結果顯示：相同運算量下，Synth訓練的600M模型在選擇題領先經後訓練的FineWiki與FinePDFs-Edu對照組16-17分；相較Qwen3-0.6B等開源模型，僅用80-700倍更少的token仍具競爭力；FActScore事實精確度於各參數層級皆居冠，模型對種子外實體會主動棄答（67%），並能依推理軌跡中的知識標記校準輸出量與正確性；電信領域與工具呼叫的適應實驗亦見大幅提升。限制包括：模型知識上限受種子語料約束、多語資料以英文種子為本、任務難度針對小型模型設計，且尚未測試混合網路資料的配方。此研究證明資料品質是可操控的關鍵軸線，以網路文本擬合的Chinchilla縮放定律須重新檢視，對開源、可重現且低運算成本的模型訓練別具意義。
papers.title: It's All Training: A Fully Synthetic Single-Stage Recipe for LLMs
papers.title_zh: 一切都在訓練：大型語言模型的全合成單階段訓練配方

links.title: The Unequal Influence of Bad Advice: Using Training Data Attribution to Modulate Emergent Misalignment

evidence: Abstract: 'we use training data attribution to quantitatively estimate how much each harmful example contributes to EM. We benchmark the quality of the attribution via retraining'

Section 4.1 / Figure 1: 'removing 20% of the most influential data drops the misalignment rate to about 40%, while removing the least influential data, increases the rate to almost 55%' from a ~45% baseline
Section 3.4: 'For each filtering experiment, we train 4 different initialization seeds and 3 different data shuffles, for a total of 12 different seeds for filtering experiment'
Section 3.2: 'We find Qwen alignment scores to have a Pearson correlation of about 0.9 with the alignment scores given by GPT-4.1-mini'
Section 4.1: 'WildGuard has an AUC of 0.9998 at identifying bad advice in this setting, while EK-FAC only has an AUC of 0.9171, but despite this EK-FAC can filter data better'

Section 4.2: 'in the automotive advice dataset most models have a Spearman correlation between 0.3 to 0.6, but in the career and educational advice datasets these correlations can be negative'; same-model seed correlation baseline '0.75-0.85'
Section 3.1: 'rank 32 RsLora on all the linear modules... Adam optimizer, with batch size 16 and weight decay set to 0.01... linearly warm up the learning rate for 10 steps to a maximum of 1e-4'
Section 5 (limitations): 'we have not come to a convincing hypothesis about which characteristic of the data leads to an increased misalignment rate when trained on'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment/safety research: applies influence-function approximations (EK-FAC, gradient cosine similarity via the open Bergson library) to emergent misalignment, a heavily weighted topic area (LLM, AI Safety, Alignment, fine-tuning, data). Novelty is solid but incremental: EM is an established phenomenon (Betley et al., Wang et al.) and the attribution techniques are existing; the contribution is the data-centric finding that malign examples are heterogeneous in influence, model-dependent, and partially transferable across model families. Rigor is strong: a black-box baseline (WildGuard), simple-statistics baselines (loss, length), seed-controlled retraining (12 seeds per filtering experiment per Sec 3.4), repeated-data controls for gradient-step count, judge validation (Pearson ~0.9 vs GPT-4.1-mini, Sec 3.2), and threshold/query-set ablations. Evidence is quantified by retraining rather than correlation alone (e.g., 45%->40% removing top 20% vs ->55% removing bottom 20%, Fig 1; AUC 0.9998 vs 0.9171, Sec 4.1). Weaknesses: modest effect sizes in places, LoRA-only attribution limiting claims about full fine-tuning, judge is Qwen 3 32B which overlaps the studied Qwen families (mitigated by cross-judge correlation), no statistical significance reporting in text, and the authors concede no mechanistic explanation for which data properties drive influence (Sec 5). Generalizability is decent across three families and three datasets but confined to narrow wrong-advice EM datasets and LoRA adapters. Hyperparameters, datasets, judge prompts, and evaluation questions are disclosed (Sec 3.1, A.1) but no explicit code/data release for this paper's own artifacts is stated.

primary_link.title: The Unequal Influence of Bad Advice: Using Training Data Attribution to Modulate Emergent Misalignment

papers.summary: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow, misaligned tasks can undo their post-training alignment and induce novel misaligned behaviors -- a phenomenon known as \emph{emergent misalignment} (EM). EM has been linked to persona-like representations, where fine-tuning might reduce loss by amplifying a harmful or 'evil' persona. It remains unclear which properties of the training data drive this effect: whether all harmful examples contribute approximately equally to misalignment and whether diff
papers.summary_zh: 這篇 EleutherAI 的研究探討湧現錯位現象：當語言模型在狹窄的錯誤建議資料上進行 fine-tuning 後，會在無關情境中廣泛產生有害回應。作者追問：是否所有有害訓練範例對錯位的貢獻都相同？研究團隊運用訓練資料歸因技術，透過 EK-FAC 近似影響函數與梯度餘弦相似度，估算每個範例對模型錯位行為的影響力，並以重新訓練實驗驗證歸因分數的品質。主要證據顯示：在 OLMo 3 7B 上，移除影響力最高的 20% 範例可使錯位率從約 45% 降至 40%，移除影響力最低的 20% 則升至近 55%；僅訓練精選的 5% 資料即可造成高達 60% 的錯位率，而不同的 5% 選擇可能只有 20%。影響力呈連續梯度而非二分，且比 WildGuard 有害性分類器更能有效過濾資料。跨模型實驗發現 Qwen 與 Llama 家族的各型號模型都會錯位，但最具影響力的範例因模型而異；歸因分數雖可跨模型轉移，效果仍不及以目標模型自身計算的分數。限制在於研究無法解釋為何特定範例更具影響力，以 LLM-as-a-judge 評分軸線（如過度自信、明顯錯誤）僅有中度相關，且影響力真值需昂貴的重訓實驗才能確認。此研究對對齊研究意義重大，展示資料歸因可作為調查訓練資料的工具，並凸顯訓練資料篩選在模型安全部署上的價值。
papers.title: The Unequal Influence of Bad Advice: Using Training Data Attribution to Modulate Emergent Misalignment
papers.title_zh: 壞建議的不對等影響：以訓練資料歸因調節湧現錯位

links.title: Correct Answers, Invalid Traces: What Verifiable Grade-School Math Reveals About Chain-of-Thought Traces

evidence: Abstract: 'on the hardest instances, 31.6% of correct answers have invalid traces, over half of which pass all syntactic and arithmetic checks but fail semantic dependency checks'.
Section 4 Setup: '124M-parameter GPT-2-style models are trained from scratch on on-the-fly problems with op ≤ 15 and ip ≤ 20... We evaluate greedily on 4,096 held-out instances per level'.
Section 4, Table 3: semantic-only failures account for 95.0%/78.1%/51.2% of invalid traces at op=15/20/23, dominated by 'a step uses the wrong inputs'.

Section 4, Table 2: 10% shuffled traces 'nearly preserve clean-traces model accuracy, even out of distribution... with no generated trace passing verification'; 30% shuffled reaches 75% at op=15 vs 25% for no-trace.
Section 4, Table 5: re-asking raises padded-trace share from 0.4% to 3.7% (standard, op 20) and 1.3% to 9.6% (widened world), showing minimality is query-placement dependent.
Appendix B, Table 10: 'Runs A and B differ by ten points at op = 23'; reproductions fall short of Ye et al. reported out-of-distribution values.
Conclusion: 'Our models are small and synthetic, so direct extrapolation to frontier systems is unwarranted'.
Reproducibility statement: 'Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/ratishsp/igsm-trace-validity and https://huggingface.co/ratishsp/igsm-trace-validity'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled study of chain-of-thought trace validity on the verifiable iGSM benchmark, squarely aligned with high-weight preferences for reasoning/CoT, interpretability, and AI safety (CoT monitoring). It mechanically separates answer correctness from trace validity: 31.6% of correct answers carry invalid traces at op=23 (Table 3), with over half passing syntactic/arithmetic checks and failing only semantic dependency checks. Novelty is moderate rather than high: it extends the 'reasonless intermediate tokens' program of Valmeekam et al. to grade-school math and stress-tests positive conclusions of Ye et al. (2025a), adding genuinely new interventions (shuffled-prefix dose-response, swapped traces, non-minimal supervision, re-asked queries showing minimality is supervision/query-shaped, Table 5). Rigor is strong: a multi-level mechanical checker, per-op breakdowns, an always-zero baseline caveat, failure taxonomy with annotated examples, and disclosure that their reproductions fall short of prior reported numbers and that runs differ by ten points at op=23 (Appendix B, Tables 10-11). Evidence for the claims made is solid, with appropriate hedging that validity is not faithfulness. Generalizability is the weak point: 124M GPT-2-style models trained from scratch on synthetic data; authors explicitly say direct extrapolation to frontier systems is unwarranted (Conclusion). Reproducibility is excellent: full training recipe and released code and models (Reproducibility statement, GitHub/HuggingFace links).

primary_link.title: Correct Answers, Invalid Traces: What Verifiable Grade-School Math Reveals About Chain-of-Thought Traces

papers.summary: Chain-of-thought traces are widely read as records of how models reach their answers, informing debugging, agent auditing, and claims about reasoning. Testing this interpretation is difficult because natural-language thinking traces are rarely mechanically verifiable. We revisit it in iGSM, a synthetic grade-school mathematics benchmark designed to study thinking traces and used to support claims of learned reasoning and planning. Crucially, iGSM exposes the exact quantities and dependencies tha
papers.summary_zh: 思維鏈（Chain-of-Thought）軌跡常被視為模型如何導出答案的紀錄，並用於除錯、代理稽核與 AI 安全監控。然而自然語言思考軌跡難以機械驗證，其有效性鮮少被直接檢驗。本文選用合成基準 iGSM（小學數學應用題），每道題目附帶完整數量依賴結構，可逐步程式化檢查生成軌跡是否為答案的有效推導。作者以 GPT-2 架構（124M 參數）模型沿 iGSM-med 設定訓練，得出三組主要證據：其一，僅以有效且最小化軌跡訓練的乾淨模型，分布內答案正確與軌跡有效幾乎重合，但在最難的分布外題目（op=23）上，31.6% 的正確答案伴隨無效軌跡，其中過半在語法與算術檢查皆無誤，僅語義依賴檢查失敗。其二，以無關題目的置換軌跡訓練，模型分布內仍答對約 82%，卻從未產出任何有效軌跡；將訓練軌跡前綴 10% 詞元隨機打亂，準確率幾乎不受影響，顯示軌跡即使永遠無效也能承載有用的運算。其三，非最小化訓練軌跡會誘導非最小化輸出；重新提問同一題目的不同數量時，模型仍沿襲原問題的計算，顯示最小化源自監督與問題建構，不足以作為規劃能力的證據。作者強調答案正確且軌跡看似合理，並不等於軌跡語義可信，此落差更隨分布偏移擴大，對依賴軌跡的監控與詮釋構成警示。限制在於模型規模小、設定合成，不宜直接外推至前沿系統，但其精確可驗證性使結論難以忽視。
papers.title: Correct Answers, Invalid Traces: What Verifiable Grade-School Math Reveals About Chain-of-Thought Traces
papers.title_zh: 正確答案、無效軌跡：從可驗證的小學數學看思維鏈軌跡

links.title: Weights Read and Write Features: Scalable Parameter Decomposition Grounded in Activation Space

evidence: Section 4 Setup: 'We evaluate one weight matrix in each of three pretrained models: MLP_in at layer 0 of GPT-2 small, MLP_out at layer 13 of Gemma-2-2B, and the attention O matrix at layer 17 of Qwen-3-8B', trained on 2B tokens with L0=32, 95% CIs reported.
Table 1: ASPD Intruder 0.62 vs VPD 0.20 on Gemma-2-2B and 0.57 vs 0.22 on Qwen-3-8B (chance 0.2); Table 3: ASPD editing ratio 6.7x single / 11.1x multiple vs VPD 0.9x / 0.8x on Qwen-3-8B.

Appendix C: full training details (datasets in Table 4, loss coefficients in Table 5, BatchTopK, Matryoshka loss, auxk revival, judge Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct); code link in footnote 1 (github.com/tue147/weights-read-write).
Appendix D/E/F: ablations showing L_param/L_ablate have mixed or negative effects, VPD remains near chance under favorable activation filtering, and sparsity-adaptive loss does not rescue VPD.

Section 5.1 and Appendix G: parameter-level IOI recovery with attribution patching, behavioral probes (Appendix H), and direct QK component-pair weight editing suppressing the S-inhibition pattern (Figure 2); limitations acknowledged (no John/Mary-specific components, ABC prompt unexplored).
Section 7 AI use statement: generative AI used for methodology feedback, implementation, and writing polish, with baseline reproduction checks described.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM mechanistic interpretability contribution squarely in scope (Interpretability 1.8, LLM 2.5, Transformer 1.2): ASPD jointly decomposes activation and parameter spaces, grounding rank-1 weight components in the activation features they read/write. Novelty is solid but incremental: the shared-sparse-latent surrogate is an elegant reframing built on BatchTopK SAEs, Transcoders (shown as special case, Appendix B), and VPD. Rigor is good: baselines (VPD, VPD+internal, PD Transcoder), 95% CIs, ablations of VPD-specific losses (Appendix D), robustness checks favoring VPD (Appendix E, F). Main limitations: quantitative evaluation covers only one weight matrix per model (Section 4 Setup), both interpretability metrics rely on an LLM judge (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct) without human validation, case studies (IOI, semantic tracing) are GPT-2-only and largely qualitative with causal support from single-prompt interventions (Figure 2). Evidence strength is moderate-to-strong: consistent separation from VPD across three models and three metric families, but self-defined metrics and one-matrix scope temper it. Generalizability is credible (GPT-2 to Qwen-3-8B) but demonstrated narrowly. Reproducibility is strong: code link, datasets, full loss coefficients (Table 5), optimizer details, probe protocols, and an AI-use statement. Not a pure domain application; no instruction-following from paper text.

primary_link.title: Weights Read and Write Features: Scalable Parameter Decomposition Grounded in Activation Space

papers.summary: Activation space and parameter space provide complementary views of model computation. Activations represent information, while weights read, transform, and write that information. Yet existing interpretability methods largely study the two spaces separately, leaving the connection between represented information and parameter-level computation underexplored. We introduce Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition (ASPD), which jointly decomposes activation and parameter spaces and grounds eac
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討模型可解釋性中激活空間與參數空間長期分離的問題：激活刻畫模型所表示的資訊，權重則讀取、轉換並寫入這些資訊，但既有方法很少將兩者連結，且權重矩陣的分解本身不唯一，缺乏語義錨定。作者提出 Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition（ASPD），以共享稀疏表示同時學習激活特徵與 rank-1 權重元件，讓每個元件由其讀取或寫入的特徵所定義，並在目標權重矩陣的輸出端加入內部重建損失，提供局部學習訊號，藉此取代成本高昂的成對特徵—元件干預。在 GPT-2、Gemma-2-2B 與 Qwen-3-8B 上，ASPD 於 Intruder 可解釋性、元件多樣性、語義定位與權重編輯實驗皆明顯優於 VPD，例如在 Qwen-3-8B 的編輯定位達隨機基線的 6.7 至 11.1 倍；另以讀寫互動組成參數層級的 IOI circuit，重現 induction、duplicate-token、S-inhibition 與 name movement 等已知機制，並追蹤新聞組織概念在 MLP 權重中的語義轉換。限制包括部分元件粒度過粗（如僅學到「名字後的詞元」而非特定人名訊號）、若干元件語義尚待細化，且 VPD 特有損失的效益不一致。此框架讓研究者能同時解釋模型「表示什麼」與「權重如何計算」，為參數層級的機制分析與因果編輯提供可擴充的基礎。

links.title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation

evidence: Abstract: claims 6.8k environments and 19k verified successful trajectories, and that SFT raises the rate of reading the relevant skill from 28% to 96%
Section 3.2.3: two-stage builder-reviewer construction with a validity gate requiring v(x0)=0 and v(Exec(rho;E,x0))=1, plus a quality gate auditing information leakage and over/under-strict verifiers

Table 1 / Section 4.2: six backbones improve in 22 of 24 comparisons; Qwen3.5-9B SFT (59.5 SkillGym, 74.7 SkillEval, 49.6 Skill-Use-Bench) vs Qwen3.5-397B (55.8, 73.8, 23.0), though the abstract claims outperformance on only two benchmarks

Section 5.2: gains hold across reasoning structures (16.9 to 22.1 points on SkillGym) but on SkillsBench concentrate on reference-documentation skills (+28.0) while domain-method and shipped-tool tasks do not improve

Table 2 / Section 5.3: token-matched ablations show review-approved data beats validated-only (+4.7 SkillGym, +6.7 SkillEval); four-profile mix is within run-to-run variation of procedural-only but slightly lower on SkillsBench (39.4 vs 42.5)
Table 3 / Section 5.4: Kimi-K3 improves from 60.5% to 68.8% with skills; McNemar exact test p ~ 1e-4 with 52 tasks solved only with the skill and 19 only without
Section 4.1: SFT setup fully specified (2 epochs, lr 1e-5, AdamW, batch 128, 64 GPU hours) across MiniCPM5-2B, Ministral-3-8B, and Qwen3.5 4B/9B/27B/122B
Appendix H / Table 6: curation funnel of 184,430 crawled to 51,131 deduplicated to 11,897 selected skills; total pipeline cost estimated at $5.7k-8.4k, about $1 per released task
Appendix G / Table 10: structure annotation validated via verifier-count check (99/100 on SkillEval) and a regression on 585 tasks with 95% bootstrap CIs finds no structure-specific SFT effect
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper squarely in scope: automatic verifiable environment generation from community skills, multi-harness trajectory collection, and SFT for skill use, evaluated on four benchmarks. Experimental hygiene is above average: held-out skill split (Fig. 3a), McNemar test for skill-criticality, 95% bootstrap CIs plus a difficulty-controlled regression, and token-matched data ablations; limitations are candidly reported (no gains on method/tool-centric skills, 2B SkillsBench regression, ablation models below base on SkillEval). Novelty is incremental: skill-driven synthesis already exists (SKT), with differentiation mainly in four reasoning-structure profiles, reviewer-audited verifiers, and held-out-skill transfer analysis. Weaknesses: abstract/Sec. 4.2 claim the 9B SFT model beats the 397B model on two benchmarks while Table 1 shows a third (Skill-Use-Bench 49.6 vs 23.0); partial-order tasks are excluded from Table 8 counts; key structure-distribution and trigger-rate claims rest on figures; evaluation uses a single harness (MiniSwe-Agent) unlike the four training harnesses; RL is only proposed as future work. Code, full prompts, cost analysis, and detailed curation funnels support reproducibility, contingent on the stated GitHub release.

primary_link.title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation

papers.summary: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, t
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 SkillGym，一套自動化管線，可將社群撰寫的 agent skills 轉換為可執行、可驗證的訓練環境，解決技能使用訓練資料難以合成的問題。流程分三階段：先從 skills.sh 與 GitHub 登錄庫爬取約 18.4 萬個技能，經規則與 LLM 標註篩出 11,897 個可離線執行者；再以 builder-reviewer 雙代理系統建構 Docker 環境與任務，涵蓋流程執行、溯因診斷、約束滿足與偏序規劃四種推理結構，每個任務附參考解答與可執行驗證器，並經品質審查，確保任務需要技能但仍可解；最後由三個教師模型搭配四種 agent harness 收集 19k 條成功軌跡供監督式微調。實驗顯示，SFT 讓三個家族、2B 至 122B 的六個模型在四項技能基準普遍提升，平均增益約 10 至 41 分，Qwen3.5-9B 微調後在兩項基準超越未訓練的 397B 模型，增益並遷移到訓練時未見的技能；行為分析指出訓練主要教會 agent 主動查閱技能，開啟相關技能比例由 28% 升至 96%。限制包括：增益集中在提供參考文件類技能，涉及領域方法或內建工具的任務改善有限；2B 模型在 SkillsBench 反而退步；僅採用 SFT，尚未探索 RL。本文以每題約 1 美元的成本示範可規模化的技能訓練資料合成，對打造善用外部知識套件的 agent 極具參考價值。

papers.title_zh: SkillGym：以自動化可驗證環境生成訓練技能使用型代理

links.title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning

evidence: Section 1/Abstract: REVOIR decides ask-vs-act via cost-adjusted VoI of questions, formulated as a cooperative assistance game with user corrections, targeting LLM-based assistive agents.

Table I.1 (Appendix I.3): REVOIR (Factored + Incremental, ICL) reaches 58.8±0.4% PSR on seen and 56.0±3.5% on unseen personas vs Reflection-DPO 44.1±1.0% / 42.9±1.6%, using ~2.1 vs 9.8 questions, supporting the 13-15% and 5x-fewer-questions claims.

Section 4.1.1 and Fig. 2: REVOIR beats all ReAct variants in correctness under agent termination on Llama-3.1-70B and GPT-5.4-mini; reasoning-effort increases reduce ReAct clarifications, per Fig. 2 and Appendix D.2.
Appendix A, Props. A.1-A.2: Jensen-inequality proof that belief-adaptive best-of-K acting after clarification is never worse than acting immediately, with a finite-K epsilon/delta^K bound.

Appendix E: human validation of user simulator (72/89 agreement, 95% CI [0.72,0.88]) and LLM judge (41/57 agreement, CI [0.59,0.82]) on 9 annotators; small-sample but honestly reported with Wilson intervals.
Appendix D.3 (Figs. D.5-D.6): robustness to an unmodeled 'inattentive' user across p_dismissive 0.2-0.9, with ReAct baselines degrading.
Section 5 (Conclusion): acknowledged limitations — one-step myopic VoI, no dual control or interleaving, no real-user evaluation.

Appendices F, G, K: verbatim prompt templates, model versions (e.g., gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, GPT-4o-mini judge), tuned thresholds (Tables G.1-G.2), splits, and LoRA/ORPO details for the ReflectionDPO baseline; no explicit code-release claim found.
Table D.3: token-cost accounting showing SC-BoN-ReAct at K=20 uses ~74K tokens (>3x costliest REVOIR point) for marginal, non-monotonic correctness gains.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodology paper squarely on LLM assistive agents: inference-time value-of-information reasoning for ask-vs-act clarification, evaluated on ambiguous QA and preference-aligned planning against prompting, CoT/ReAct, self-consistency, EIG, and fine-tuned clarification baselines. High preference relevance (LLM agents, inference-time reasoning, alignment via assistance games, ICL) but not maximal because it is an application of established VoI/assistance-game machinery rather than a new model or training method; novelty is solid but incremental (cost-adjusted VoI over EIG and user-correction handling are the main new twists). Rigor is strong: formal A-POMDP formulation with propositions, many baselines, ablations (joint vs factored beliefs, batch vs incremental updates), budget sweeps, inattentive-user robustness tests, and human validation of the simulator and judge. Evidence is quantitatively backed (Tables D.1-D.2, I.1, token accounting D.3), though it rests on LLM-simulated users, a small human study, reproduced (not re-run) ADAPT baselines, and LLM-judged correctness; variance on unseen personas is high for joint variants. No code release is stated, capping reproducibility despite unusually thorough prompt/hyperparameter appendices. Limitations (one-step myopia, no dual control, no real users) are honestly stated.

primary_link.title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning

papers.summary: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking v
papers.summary_zh: 面對使用者的模糊請求，LLM 輔助代理應直接行動，還是先提出釐清問題？常見做法是在不確定性降至門檻前持續提問，但這忽略了資訊縮減對下游任務表現的影響、提問成本，以及使用者可能主動更正的事實。本文提出 REVOIR（Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning），一個奠基於輔助賽局與 A-POMDP 的推論階段決策方法：代理以 LLM 提案並評分的粒子集合近似對使用者意圖的信念，估計提問或行動的「資訊價值」（VoI），即答案帶來的預期任務獎勵改善，再比較成本調整後的價值決定提問或行動。在 CondAmbigQA 模糊問答與 ADAPT 偏好對齊家務任務規劃兩項基準上，REVOIR 以更少問題取得更高成功率：ADAPT 的 few-shot 設定偏好滿足率達 56–59%，較經微調的 ReflectionDPO 高 13–15 個百分點，提問次數約為其五分之一；當使用者可在行動後更正時，REVOIR 能理性判斷提問不划算而減少釐清。相對地，一般推理代理隨推理努力提升反而更少提問，顯示單純擴大推理無法取代原則性的 VoI 推理。限制方面，單步 VoI 估計較為短視，尚未支援雙重控制及提問與行動交錯的情境，亦需以真實使用者驗證。整體而言，本論文展示決策理論能協助 LLM 代理更理性地權衡釐清與行動。
papers.title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 輔助代理透過資訊價值推理之理性釐清

links.title: LongHarness Bench: Stress-Testing Language Model Harnesses for Long-Context Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: benchmark targets both effectiveness and efficiency of long-context harnesses; best configuration reaches 68% macro-average accuracy across four suites
Table 2 (Section 4.2): GPT-5.6-sol + mini-swe-agent macro 68.0% at $0.816; RLM on Pairs 2% at $7.86 vs direct 44% at $0.780, supporting 'more inference does not ensure success'
Section 1/4.2: RLM 92% on Outlier Memo Detection at $7.23 vs mini-swe-agent 100% at $0.583, consistent with the 12.4x cost claim
Section 4.3: weaker models gain more from harnesses (Qwen3.8-27B 0% direct to 38.5% with OpenCode; GLM-5.3 9.5% to 42.5% with mini-swe-agent)
Section 4.5 / Appendix B.5: cross-benchmark comparison uses only 50 OOLONG-Synth and 50 LongBench-v2 examples, a small evaluation subset

Appendix B: tasks built from private specifications (predicate support sets, relation graphs, computation graphs, executable program families) with independent validators recomputing gold answers; B.4 admits equivalence labels are operational, not formal proofs
Appendix C: full API rate table (USD per million tokens) used for cost estimation, including long-context surcharge rule for GPT-5.6-sol
Omissions: per-task instance counts for LongHarness, run variance/seeds, and an explicit limitations section are not provided in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference benchmark paper: evaluates LLM agentic harnesses (ReAct, RLM, OpenCode, mini-swe-agent) on long-context reasoning with an accuracy-plus-cost axis, hitting LLMs, Agents, Reasoning, Long Context, Evaluation, and Code preferences. Novelty is moderate: efficiency-aware agent evaluation (HAL, token-economy work) and long-context benchmarks exist; each of the four tasks is acknowledged as an extension of prior settings (QUEST, Logic Haystacks, EquiBench, CRUXEval), with the joint adaptive-retrieval/strategy-cost design as the main contribution. Rigor is solid: 5 models x 5 configurations x 4 tasks, deterministic exact-match scoring, documented construction validation (Appendix B), and published API rates (Appendix C); however, per-task instance counts are never stated, no variance/seeds are reported, and there is no explicit limitations section. Evidence is strong and internally consistent (e.g., the 12.4x cost claim matches Table 2: $7.23 vs $0.583 on Memos; 68% macro for GPT-5.6-sol+mini-swe-agent checks out), though cross-benchmark comparisons rest on only 50-example subsets (Section 4.5). Generalizability is decent but tempered by synthetic task construction; reproducibility benefits from a project page, byte-for-byte regenerable instances, and detailed appendices, but is limited by undisclosed instance counts and no explicit code/data release statement.

primary_link.title: LongHarness Bench: Stress-Testing Language Model Harnesses for Long-Context Reasoning

papers.summary: Language-model (LM) harnesses enable LMs to operate effectively over long contexts using additional compute. However, existing long-context evaluations are insufficient for distinguishing modern harnesses, reflected by saturated accuracy across harnesses and largely similar evaluation costs. In this paper, we introduce a benchmark for evaluating both the effectiveness and efficiency of long-context harnesses. Our tasks require diverse retrieval strategies, including lexical search and semantic m
papers.summary_zh: 此論文指出,現有長上下文評測已趨飽和,且僅以準確率衡量,難以區分現代 harness(圍繞基礎模型、管理上下文、工具與互動流程的外部控制層)的優劣。作者提出 LongHarness 基準,涵蓋四項任務:Constraint Solving Search、Equivalent Program Pair Search、Program Execution Tracing 與 Outlier Memo Detection,要求混合詞彙搜尋與語意檢索、跨文件多步推理,並刻意讓不同解題策略具有不同計算成本,以同時評估效能與效率。實驗以五個模型(GPT-5.6-sol、Gemini 3.8 Flash、GLM-5.3、Qwen3.8-27B、Kimi-K2.6)搭配直接推理與四種 harness(RLM、OpenCode、mini-swe-agent、ReAct)進行測試。主要發現:最佳組合 GPT-5.6-sol 加 mini-swe-agent 的 macro 平均準確率僅 68%;相同模型在不同 harness 下成本可相差十倍以上,例如在 Outlier Memo Detection 上 RLM 每實例成本約為 mini-swe-agent 的 12.4 倍;沒有任何 harness 於四項任務全面領先,增加推論運算亦不保證提升準確率,而直接推理較弱的模型反而從 harness 獲得更大增益。限制方面,答案採精確比對,程式等價性以測試行為為準而非形式化證明。此研究確立效率為長上下文評測的重要軸線,並提供發展策略性(而非窮舉式)處理上下文之 harness 的測試平台。

links.title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev

evidence: Section 3.7: releases benchmark suite, harness with content-addressed cache, and all 346,009 raw responses on Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23039006, with a backend for scoring open-weight LLMs on identical requests
Section 3.4: primary metrics per dataset with 95% percentile bootstrap CIs (500 resamples), ECE over 15 bins, Brier score, and AURC for selective prediction
Table 3 (Section 4.2): Jev beats Qwen3.8-27B on 27 of 37 datasets (11 with non-overlapping CIs; none of Qwen's 9 leads significant) and Gemma-4-E4B on all 37
Section 4.3 / Table 4: per-question thresholds tuned on 1,000 train/val examples raise UNFAIR-ToS micro-F1 from 0.499 to 0.748 and GoEmotions macro-F1 from 0.243 to 0.353

Section 4.6 / Table 6: rotating MMLU options leaves calc-heavy accuracy at 0.943 while withholding the question drops it to 0.315 (near chance), ruling out memorized answer positions but not memorized QA pairs

Section 5 (Limitations): one template per dataset untuned, baselines scored with Jev-written prompts without thinking, single run without variance measurement, probes cannot detect memorized question-answer pairs
llm_evaluation.rationale: A thorough zero-shot evaluation/benchmark paper for a commercial non-generative 'System One' decision model, compared on identical requests against two open-weight LLMs (Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma-4-E4B) via exact option probabilities. Strongly relevant to core LLM/NLP evaluation preferences: benchmarking (37 datasets, 346,009 requests), calibration and selective prediction, safety/moderation and prompt-injection datasets, RAG grounding (LLM-AggreFact), rubric scoring (LLM-as-judge adjacent), and MMLU/C-Eval reasoning analysis. Methodology is careful: frozen templates tuned only on 20 train/val examples, full evaluation splits, bootstrap CIs, ECE/Brier/AURC, thresholds tuned on train data only, and memorization probes. Novelty is moderate: the evaluation target (typed decision primitives) is new, but the evaluation science (zero-shot MC scoring, contamination probes, calibration analysis) is standard. Evidence is strong and internally consistent, with appropriately hedged conclusions (e.g., MMLU anomaly attributed only plausibly, not proven, to training exposure). Main deductions: closed-source subject limits generalizability and verification of the model itself; baselines scored with Jev-oriented prompts and no reasoning, no generative proprietary baselines; single run without variance measurement. Reproducibility is excellent: code, harness, frozen templates, pinned jev-1.13.0, and all raw responses released on Zenodo with a content-addressed cache. Not out of scope: this is language-model evaluation methodology, not a pure domain application.

primary_link.title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev

papers.summary: Jev is a commercial System One model from TypeSafe AI that does not generate text: given a state and typed questions, it returns a choice from fixed options, a position on a rubric, or the probability that a statement is true, with probabilities the vendor describes as calibrated. Such models target small decisions in information access pipelines, such as routing queries, checking grounding, moderating content, or rating against a rubric. We evaluate Jev (jev-1.13.0) zero-shot on 37 datasets spa
papers.summary_zh: 本文首次系統性評測 TypeSafe AI 的商業「System One」模型 Jev。此類模型不生成文字,而是針對給定狀態與型別化問題,直接回傳固定選項、量規分數或陳述為真的機率,瞄準查詢路由、grounding 檢查、內容審核等小型決策,避免以生成式 LLM 撰寫 prompt、解析答案的間接負擔。作者以 37 個公開資料集,涵蓋分類、路由、自然語言推論、閱讀理解、常識推理、審核、法律與量規評分七大族群,各資料集凍結單一範本,於完整測試切分零樣本評估 346,009 個請求,成本不到 10 美元;對照組 Qwen3.8-27B 與 Gemma-4-E4B 以選項的精確 next-token 機率在相同請求上評分。Jev 在 IMDB、SST-2、HellaSwag、ARC 達 95–99% 準確率,於 122 種語言的 Belebele 為 86.7%,在 27 個資料集勝過 Qwen(其 9 次領先皆未超出 bootstrap 區間)、勝過 Gemma 全部 37 個;選擇機率校準良好並支援選擇性預測。弱點為低資源語言明顯退化、細粒度或雜訊標籤、法律與生成文本量規判斷;二分機率排序佳但 0.5 閾值位置不佳,調校後 UNFAIR-ToS 的 micro-F1 從 0.50 升至 0.75。值得注意,Jev 在 MMLU 計算型題目反而更準(94% 對 91%),與開源模型相反;旋轉選項不變、隱藏問題降至接近隨機,排除淺層記憶,但無法排除題答配對的記憶汙染。各資料集僅用一個範本且未調校 prompt、對照模型未允許推理,屬主要限制。作者公開程式碼、評測框架與所有原始回應,結果可完全重現,也為此類新型決策模型建立比較基準。
papers.title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev

links.title: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR

evidence: Abstract: GRAFT consistently improves both models over GRPO with the same per-model rollout budget, +2.1 points on average, up to +4.5; stored trajectories retain +1.8.
Section 5.1: three heterogeneous model pairs (SmolLM3-3B, Qwen3-1.7B, OctoThinker-3B) evaluated on MATH500, AIME2024/2025, AMC23, Minerva with pass@1 over five runs, mean and std reported.
Table 1 / Section 5.2: GRAFT beats GRPO(n=8) in all six model blocks (+0.66 to +4.46), matches or exceeds GRPO(n=32) in two pairs; HACPO below GRPO in five of six blocks.

Table 2 (Section 6.3): component ablations show compat-gate removal costs -8.36 (SmolLM3), floor removal -3.56 (Qwen3); alternative update rules (HACPO/SGT/LUFFY with GRAFT selection) all trail full GRAFT.
Appendix C: GRPO(n=8) and GRAFT repeated across three independent training runs; GRAFT mean aggregate higher in all six model blocks (e.g., +3.97 Pair 1 SmolLM3).
Section 6.1 / Appendix D: GRAFT reaches pair-mean 35.25 at 40.9 GPU-hours, exceeding GRPO(n=32) by 1.18 at 0.45x compute; conservative per-model accounting still shows advantage.
Section 7 Limitations: two-model pairs only, math only, base models ≤3B; compatibility score is an empirical proxy, not an exact cross-tokenizer density ratio.
Appendix B Table 3: complete hyperparameters (AdamW, lr 1e-6, clipping 0.2/0.28, verl/FSDP/vLLM 0.8.5, H200s) and full algorithm in Appendix A; no explicit code-release claim found.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training contribution (RLVR/GRPO for mathematical reasoning) squarely matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, reasoning, and RL. GRAFT replaces all-fail rollout groups with balanced peer groups and controls cross-model mismatch via sequence-level compatibility gating plus token-level clipping with peer-last ordering. Novelty is moderate: it clearly builds on HACPO, SGT, F-TIS, and LUFFY, contributing a careful combination (targeted selection, source-computed advantages, gating) rather than a fundamentally new principle, though the ablations show the combination matters. Rigor and evidence are strong: three heterogeneous model pairs, five benchmarks with 5-run std, three independent training repeats, budget-matched and compute-matched baselines, thorough component/alternative-design ablations, clipping dynamics, and disclosed checkpoint-selection rule; however, validation on evaluation benchmarks for checkpoint selection and gains on small-sample AIME subsets with large variance temper confidence. Generalizability is limited by design scope: two-model pairs, math-only verifiable rewards, base models ≤3B, all acknowledged. Reproducibility is good (full algorithm, hyperparameters, baseline configs) but no code release is stated. Not a domain application, medical, or vision paper; in scope.

primary_link.title: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR

While additional rollouts improve the chance of success at higher cost, successful trajectories missing from one model's rollouts may already have been discovered by another. Indeed, we observe that heterogeneous models often succeed on complementary prompts, creating opportun
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討可驗證獎勵強化學習（RLVR）的探索限制：GRPO 等方法僅從自身取樣的回應群組中學習，當整組 rollouts 全數失敗時，群組相對優勢歸零、無法產生策略梯度訊號；增加取樣數雖能提高成功率，成本卻隨之上升。作者觀察到異質模型（如 SmolLM3-3B-Base 與 Qwen3-1.7B-Base）常在不同題目上互補成功，因而提出 GRAFT：當接收端模型全敗、同伴群組同時含成功與失敗樣本時，便以整個同伴群組取代失敗群組，保留源自同伴計算的優勢以維持獎勵對比，並以序列層級的相容性閘門（門檻 δ=0.8、權重上限 1）與 token 層級的重要性比率裁剪控制跨模型失配，再讓含同伴資料的 minibatch 置於最後，使裁剪得以發揮作用。實驗涵蓋三組異質模型配對與五個數學基準：在相同 rollout 預算下，GRAFT 平均勝過 GRPO 2.1 分、最高 4.5 分，兩組配對可追平或超越 rollout 數量四倍的 GRPO（n=32），並分別平均領先 HACPO 4.0 分與 SGT 1.5 分；重用先前儲存的同伴軌跡仍保有平均 1.8 分增益，且在配對 1 上以約 0.45 倍計算量超越 GRPO（n=32）。限制包括：增益取決於兩模型的互補程度、相容性分數僅為跨 tokenizer 的代理量而非精確密度比，且實驗僅限雙模型配對、數學領域與 3B 以下 base 模型。整體而言，本研究證明異質模型無需指定更強的教師，即可透過軌跡互換突破自身探索邊界，為後訓練階段提供具成本效益的跨模型協作學習途徑。
papers.title: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR
papers.title_zh: 學習超越取樣所見：RLVR 中具異策略感知的跨模型軌跡交換

links.title: Looped Transformers as Optimizers

evidence: Abstract: 'OperLoop improves average generative performance over the compared looped and non-looped baselines under matched training FLOPs.'

§5.2 Table 3: OperLoop EM Avg. 25.58 vs 18-layer baseline 23.89 (5B) and 37.46 vs 36.42 (10B), while Wikitext PPL (13.90 vs 13.08) and LL Avg. (59.77 vs 62.19) are worse; paper states 'PPL and LL results are slightly worse... a looped model can achieve better results in the EM evaluation.'
§5.1 Table 2: input-map alignment improves HyperLoop avg commonsense 58.93→59.47 and Parcae 59.14→59.29; deltas are small (+0.15, +0.54) with no significance testing.

§5.3 Tables 5-6: removing the delta objective drops EM Avg. 25.58→24.84; replacing the causal step-size schedule with unit steps drops EM 25.58→24.40 (causal +1.18 pts over unit, +1.56 over non-causal).
§5.3 Table 4: Loop6 raises OperLoop EM Avg. 25.58→31.90 at 1.67x baseline FLOPs, with GSM8K 8-shot CoT 17.13→31.08.

Appendix C Table 10: full training recipe (Muon momentum 0.95, AdamW betas, 281.018B/503.316B nominal tokens, cosine schedule); Appendix D: lm-eval-harness v0.4.13 with task defaults and a single shared seed.
Appendix B Algorithm 1: explicit pseudocode implementing HyperLoop/OperLoop transitions with r=4 streams, but no code or model release is mentioned anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM architecture research: a unified optimization view of looped Transformer transitions (fast weights, projection/objective/optimizer decomposition), with a derived new transition (OperLoop). Strongly aligned with Transformer Architecture, Training & Optimization, Scaling & Efficiency, and Reasoning/test-time-compute preferences, though it does not touch agents, RAG, prompting, or Japanese NLP. Novelty is moderate: unrolling recurrent computation as gradient-like updates has a long lineage the paper itself cites (LISTA, Li et al. 2018, TTT, in-context-learning-as-gradient-descent), and the delta objective is explicitly borrowed from delta linear attention; the depth-axis alignment constraint and OperLoop are the fresher pieces. Rigor is solid but not airtight: FLOP-matched comparisons at two MoE scales, component ablations (delta objective, causal step size, Loop3→Loop6), and detailed training/eval configs, yet single-seed runs, no variance or significance analysis, and small alignment deltas (+0.15 Parcae, +0.54 HyperLoop avg commonsense) make the alignment claim thin. Evidence is honest and concrete — OperLoop improves EM avg (+1.69 at 5B, +1.04 at 10B, +8.01 at Loop6) while the paper candidly reports worse PPL/LL than non-looped baselines — but gains are modest and task-mixed. Generalizability is limited to one MoE/SWA backbone family and English benchmarks, though the framework is analytically applied to seven models. Reproducibility benefits from Algorithm 1 pseudocode, full hyperparameter tables, and lm-eval-harness v0.4.13, but no code or model release is stated.

Recent reasoning models have likewise highlighted the value of scaling test-time computation through longer computation trajectories. However, the principles for designing effective loop transitions remain poorly understood. We view the looped hidden state as a fast weight that is updated throughout the depth. We formulate loop transitions as local gradient-based updates,
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對 Looped Transformers(重複套用共享區塊,在不增加參數的情況下加深有效深度)中迴圈轉移設計原則不明的問題,提出統一的最佳化觀點。作者把循環隱藏狀態視為「快速權重」,主張任何迴圈轉移都可由三個要素以封閉形式推導:讀取狀態的投影(輸入映射)、局部目標函數,以及含權重衰減與步長的最佳化器更新規則。將 Ouro、Huginn、Parcae、HyperLoop 等模型映射進框架後,發現 Parcae 與 HyperLoop 的寫入映射與讀取投影不一致;對齊輸入映射後,訓練損失下降,常識推理平均準確率也提升(如 HyperLoop 由 58.93 升至 59.47)。據此作者設計出 OperLoop,結合明確權重衰減、因果遞減的自適應步長與 delta 目標。在訓練 FLOPs 對齊的實驗中,OperLoop 以約一半參數使 EM 平均超越非迴圈基線(5B 規模 +1.69、10B 規模 +1.04 個百分點),把迴圈次數增至六次更將 EM 平均推升到 31.90;消融實驗證實 delta 目標與步長排程各自都有貢獻。限制在於:迴圈模型的困惑度與 LL 準確率仍略遜於非迴圈基線,增益隨任務與規模變動,且局部目標僅是推導轉移的分析工具,與實際訓練損失不同。整體而言,這套框架為參數高效的深度擴展與測試時計算擴展,提供了兼具理論依據與實證支持的迴圈設計路線圖。

links.title: OmniVCBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning Towards AI Virtual Cells

evidence: Abstract/Sec 3.2.1: unanimous three-annotator audit retains 6,077 of 7,923 candidates (76.70%) with Fleiss' kappa=0.8560 [0.8442, 0.8674]
Sec 3.3/App A.10: production judge correlates with human panel mean at Spearman rho=0.877 over 884 cells; L3 agreement drops to rho=0.709 on 250 cells
Sec 4.2 Table 2: GPT-5.6-sol leads with 55.1% MCQ and 3.28/5 AIVC-Judge; open-weight base models span 15.9-33.8% MCQ

App A.7.1 Tables 19/21: direct-generation distractors are 30.3-38.0 pp easier than released MDHNM items; matched-evidence direct-minus-mined differences (+3.7, +2.7 pp) are not significant after Holm correction
Sec 4.3 Table 3: rank-32 SFT +1.97 pp and multimodal RAG +1.60 pp, significant under paper-clustered Holm-corrected tests; rank-16 change +0.46 pp with p=0.42
App E/Sec A.6: all sources are Nature Communications 2011-2017; GPT-5.6-sol retains 34.7% MCQ accuracy without images, showing text-prior/memorization leakage into the controlled track
App A.12 Tables 29-32: release-level DOI, title, text, and image-hash overlap audits return zero confirmed duplicates
App G: anonymous repository releases judge implementation, rubrics, prompts, and a 300-item demo; full 6,077-item benchmark and 548,450-item training corpus deferred until after review
llm_evaluation.rationale: A rigorous MLLM evaluation benchmark for scientific-figure reasoning with genuine language-methodology content (rubric-conditioned MLLM-as-judge, model-error-derived MCQ distractors, paired open/MCQ tracks, LoRA SFT and multimodal RAG adaptation), matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, reasoning, evaluation, and multimodal AI; it is not a pure domain application since the contribution is evaluation methodology, though the biological framing tempers relevance. Rigor is unusually strong: unanimous three-annotator audit with Fleiss' kappa 0.856, judge-human agreement (rho=0.877; lower rho=0.709 on L3), cluster bootstrap CIs, Holm correction, no-image shortcut and overlap audits, and honest caveats (L3 rubric sensitivity, judge reuse in both tracks inflating cross-track correlation). Novelty is incremental over MicroVQA/FigQA2/SciFIBench: the paired-format design and MDHNM are new combinations, and the paper's own ablation shows error-mining per se contributes little beyond the full configuration. Evidence is extensive and calibrated, but the source corpus is narrow (Nature Communications 2011-2017, microscopy/immunoblot dominated), open-weight coverage is 2B-8B only, and full data release is pending, limiting generalizability and reproducibility.

primary_link.title: OmniVCBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning Towards AI Virtual Cells

papers.summary: Artificial Intelligence Virtual Cells (AIVCs) are envisioned as scientific agents that simulate cellular responses, explain underlying mechanisms, and support hypothesis-driven discovery. Existing AIVC benchmarks, however, operate primarily at the simulation layer, motivating complementary evaluation of how models interpret experimental evidence and formulate biological hypotheses. We introduce OmniVCBench, a figure-centric, source-traceable benchmark for the interpretation component of an AIVC.
papers.summary_zh: 現行 AI 虛擬細胞（AIVC）基準多聚焦於模擬層，評估擾動下的細胞狀態預測，卻缺乏對詮釋層的系統性檢驗——模型如何解讀顯微影像、免疫轉漬等實驗圖表並形成假說。本論文提出 OmniVCBench，以圖表為核心、來源可追溯，含 6,077 道取自文獻的單圖與多子圖問答題，依 Bloom 分類法對應 Predict–Explain–Discover 議程設計三層任務：L1 證據條件推論、L2 機制解釋、L3 證據導向假說提案。配套方法包括：AIVC-Judge 以任務條件化 rubric 對開放式回答逐點評分；MDHNM 將模型推論錯誤轉為選擇題干擾選項；全部題目經三位細胞生物學博士標註員一致審核（保留率 76.70%，Fleiss' κ=0.8560）。評測 15 個多模態模型顯示，最佳專有模型 GPT-5.6-sol 選擇題準確率僅 55.1%，AIVC-Judge 得分 3.28/5，L3 論證最弱；選擇題與開放式評分在 11 個共有模型上高度相關（Spearman ρ=0.964）。以 OmniVCTrain（548,450 筆輔助問答）進行 SFT 與多模態 RAG 僅帶來 1–2 點的有限增益。四個可執行試點顯示取得額外量測可修正預測，但屬單步重播迴路。限制包括資料源集中於 2011–2017 年 Nature Communications、物種與實驗類型偏狹，且無圖對照顯示部分作答可仰賴文字線索。本基準補足模擬層之外的關鍵缺口，定位 MLLM 為連結模擬與實驗證據的詮釋元件，對 AIVC 發展具重要指標意義。

links.title: How Can Recommendation Feedback Evolve Agent Memory?

evidence: Abstract: TIDE achieves +7.75-percentage-point MEG in offline temporal replay and improves UCTR and activation rate in an online A/B test; lowest MAE/RMSE and highest MEG on a delayed-label benchmark.

Table 1 (Section 4.1): TIDE on qwen3.5-27b reaches MEG +7.75, Joint 23.0, inference overhead 750 tokens/request, versus Reflexion +1.25 and Mem0 +0.88; on Qwen3-4B all memory methods have Format 0.0 and TIDE MEG +1.75; SFT+TIDE MEG +6.71 with 153.118 PFLOPs.
Table 2 (Section 4.1): one-week randomized online A/B shows +5.10% UCTR and +4.79% activation-rate relative uplift, both p<0.001.
Section 4.4 / Table 3: on the adapted MemoryCD delayed-label benchmark TIDE attains MAE 0.531, RMSE 0.895, MEG@δ=5 +0.0365, Δ_delay +0.0019, 16.7% user negative transfer.

Appendix C Table 5: removing responsibility credit drops Mean Utility by -0.149 (95% CI [-0.262,-0.044]), the only ablation whose interval excludes zero; temporal, semantic, Revise, Merge, Evict removals are -0.006 to -0.040 with CIs including zero.

Appendix B Table 4 and Figure 8: after ten rounds TIDE reaches Mean Utility 0.809 [0.698,0.909] with 2,121 memory tokens, and 9/10 evictions target injected noise vs 29/120 for Random Replacement (Fisher exact p=5.81e-5).
Section 3.2-3.4: temporal credit gates on lifecycle maturity, semantic credit matches controls and builds evidence chains, responsibility credit requires Used/Align/counterfactual conditions (Eq. 4).
Appendix A: all outputs judged by a frozen DeepSeek-V4-Pro judge with identifiers removed; 50 frozen future requests; FLOPs accounting (2PT/6PT) is an estimate, not wall-clock.
AI Use Disclosure: generative AI used for writing and code assistance, all reviewed by authors; no code or data release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological contribution to LLM-agent memory evolution, squarely in scope rather than a pure domain application: TIDE converts delayed, noisy recommendation outcomes into memory fitness via temporal/semantic/responsibility credit assignment on a frozen generator (qwen3.5-27b, Qwen3-4B), evaluated against strong agent-memory baselines (Reflexion, Mem0, A-MEM, AWM, ExpRAG, RAG, ReAct). Novelty is solid: jointly modeling outcome reliability, delivery-context confounding, and per-memory responsibility with capacity-constrained population selection (reinforce/crossover/mutate/evict) and a new MEG metric goes beyond prior memory or model self-evolution work, though the population/genetic-operator framing has recognizable lineage. Rigor is unusually thorough for an industry paper: chronological anti-leakage replay (Section 4.2, Appendix A), pre-specified one-week A/B (Appendix A), controlled noise-injection attribution episodes (Section 4.3), public-benchmark transfer (Section 4.4), multi-round evolution, credit/operator ablations, population-health and distribution-shift analyses (Appendices B-E), bootstrap CIs and a Fisher test. Evidence is mostly credible but has caveats: all generation quality is judged by a single frozen LLM judge (DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Appendix A) without human validation; headline ablations show only responsibility credit has a CI excluding zero (Appendix C Table 5, Δ=-0.149 [-0.262,-0.044]); CVR rank correlation of 0.116 (Section 4.2) is a weak signal; online absolute metrics withheld for confidentiality. Generalizability is moderate: two backbones plus MemoryCD transfer, but the pipeline presumes recommendation-style delivery context and matched controls. Reproducibility is limited: proprietary e-commerce data and online experiment cannot be replicated, no code release, though prompts (Appendix F), protocol details, and accounting conventions are disclosed. Weighted score ≈0.77.

primary_link.title: How Can Recommendation Feedback Evolve Agent Memory?

However, these signals are delayed and noisy, confounded by audience composition, placement, and recommendation policies, and may result from the combined influence of multiple memories, making accurate attribution difficult. papers.summary_zh: 內容生成代理上線後,會持續收到推薦系統回傳的曝光、點擊、轉換與負向回饋。這些訊號貼近商業目標,但具延遲與雜訊,且受流量分配、版位與推薦策略混淆,難以歸因到特定記憶;既有方法多依賴即時回饋或語意檢索,無法可靠地把推薦結果轉為記憶適應度。本文提出 TIDE,在凍結生成模型的前提下,將記憶視為容量受限的經驗族群,透過三層貢獻歸因驅動演化:時間信用彙整完整生命週期成果並檢查其成熟與可比較性;語意信用對照控制組與環境脈絡,萃取可編輯的內容決策證據鏈;責任信用結合實際記憶使用紀錄與反事實重播,找出真正促成成果的記憶,再執行強化、交叉、變異或淘汰,並於固定容量下擇優保留。作者另提出 Memory Evolution Gain(MEG),以演化後記憶相對無記憶基準在嚴格未來任務上的效用增益,衡量記憶演化是否真正有效。實驗顯示:在電商會員行銷素材生成代理上,TIDE 離線時序重播取得 +7.75 個百分點的 MEG,線上一週 A/B 測試使 UCTR 相對提升 5.10%、Activation Rate 提升 4.79%(p<0.001);在 MemoryCD 延遲標籤基準上也達到最低 MAE 與 RMSE 及最高 MEG。消融分析顯示責任信用貢獻最大。限制包括輸出品質仰賴 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 擔任評審、線上結果僅揭露相對效果,且驗證場景以電商為主。整體而言,本文展示把延遲、受情境影響的環境回饋轉為可追溯、可稽核代理記憶的可行路徑。

links.title: SYNCR: Diagnosing and Learning Cross-Video Reasoning from Simulation

evidence: Sec. 3.2 / Table 1: 22 MLLMs evaluated; best standard open-weight average 37.5% (Qwen3-VL 32B); GPT-6 Astra 64.5% vs human majority vote 89.5% on matched 100-item sets.

Sec. 4.1 / Fig. 4 and Table 9: eight-task SFT raises Qwen3-VL-8B from 32.6% to 61.6% average on matched 200-item sets; GRPO from base yields only +2.5 to +4.2 points under the tested binary-reward configuration.
Sec. 4.3 / Table 20: ordering gains of +9.0/+19.0 (Qwen3-VL-8B), +14.0/+20.5 (InternVL3.5-8B), +19.0/+16.5 (Qwen3-VL-4B) on Assembly101/Panoptic with exact McNemar p<=0.015 or conservative bounds.

App. C.4.2 / Table 15: format-matched placebo trained on identical inputs with wrong labels scores below base on every SYNCR and real-benchmark task (e.g., MVU-Eval TR 43.0% vs base 68.0%, SFT 75.5%).
App. C.4.1 / Table 14: matched-budget SAT supervision arm does not reproduce gains (-8.5 and -17.0 points on MVU-Eval TR and CrossVid PSS vs +7.5 and +10.0 for SYNCR SFT).

App. C.4.5: Benjamini-Hochberg correction; seven of eight SYNCR task gains and both existing temporal-benchmark transfer gains survive; Thinking-checkpoint comparisons do not survive and are explicitly not treated as findings.

App. B.3.2 / Table 8: SYNCR averages correlate with MVU-Eval TR and Comparison (Spearman rho 0.855/0.917, p<0.001; 0.779/0.870 after partialling log10 params), with the caveat that a general video factor could explain this.

Reproducibility statement / App. C.1: evaluation and training metadata plus Habitat/Kubric assets released at huggingface.co/datasets/CrossVideoReasoning/SYNCR; LoRA (rank 16, alpha 32, lr 5e-5) and GRPO hyperparameters fully specified; CLEVRER videos must be obtained separately.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A simulator-grounded cross-video reasoning benchmark plus paired training study for multimodal LLMs. It matches high-weight preferences on LLMs/MLLMs, (visual) reasoning, multimodal AI, benchmark evaluation, SFT/LoRA training and GRPO-style RL, though it is video-centric rather than core text-LLM work and touches none of the top-preference agent/Japanese-NLP/safety topics. Novelty is solid: Table 3 shows no prior multi-video benchmark couples simulator-state labels, matched training QA, evidence controls, and post-training transfer tests, but simulation-based supervision for video MLLMs has precedent (SAT, SIMS-V, Chain-of-Frames). Rigor is exceptional: Wilson intervals, exact McNemar tests, Benjamini-Hochberg correction, three training seeds, format-matched placebo, matched-budget SAT arm, no-video/single-video controls, and timestamp-leakage prevention, with unusually careful hedging of weak results (e.g., cross-camera counting transfer 'not established'). Evidence is strong for the headline claims (SFT 32.6%->61.6% on matched 200-item sets; ordering transfer +9.0 to +20.5 pts with p<=0.015), with honest limitations (proprietary models on only 100 items/task, correlation with MVU-Eval does not establish construct isolation, 4-person majority-vote human reference). Generalizability is decent since structural/camera-rig/simulator shifts are tested, but transfer beyond ordering is mixed and only three model families and multiple-choice visual-only inputs are covered. Reproducibility is good: public HuggingFace release, full hyperparameters (App. C.1), prompt templates, and statistical protocol, with CLEVRER requiring third-party access.

primary_link.title: SYNCR: Diagnosing and Learning Cross-Video Reasoning from Simulation
