We introduce SYNCR, a simulator-grounded framework that connects these two needs through shared task generators. Built on Habitat, Kubric, and CLEVRER, SYNCR derives answers from environment state and provides 4,000 evaluation questions and 15,960 trainin
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 SYNCR，一套以模擬器為基礎的跨影片推理評估與訓練框架。跨影片推理需對齊事件、比對身分、比較運動並整合片段觀察，真實影片基準卻難以精確標註時間偏移與三維關係。SYNCR 建構於 Habitat、Kubric 與 CLEVRER 三個模擬器，答案直接由環境狀態計算，涵蓋時間對齊、空間追蹤、比較推理與整體整合四大類共八項任務，提供 4,000 道評估題與 15,960 道訓練題，影片互斥。作者測試 22 個多模態大型語言模型，發現表現不均：最佳開放權重模型 Qwen3-VL 32B 平均 37.5%，最佳專有模型 GPT-6 Astra 為 64.5%，遠低於人類多數決 89.5%；運動學比較與場景整合尤其困難，規模擴大未必改善。訓練方面，對 Qwen3-VL-8B 進行八任務 SFT 微調後，平均準確率由 32.6% 升至 61.6%，增益在結構與來源改變時多能延續；遷移到真實影片時，時間排序在 Assembly101 與 Panoptic 自建資料集上獲得 9.0 至 20.5 個百分點進步，並在既有時間推理基準上提升。錯誤標籤、無影片對照與多種子實驗支持增益確實來自正確監督。限制包括評估以視覺選擇題為主且多取自模擬環境，跨鏡頭計數的真實遷移尚未確立，RL 結果僅限所測 GRPO 設定。本文將診斷、訓練與遷移驗證整合於同一框架，指出哪些跨影片能力可透過合成監督習得。
papers.title: SYNCR: Diagnosing and Learning Cross-Video Reasoning from Simulation
papers.title_zh: SYNCR：從模擬環境診斷並學習跨影片推理

links.title: SPLASH: Switching Parallel Layouts of Attention with Seamless Handoff for LLM Serving

evidence: Abstract: 'Splash improves end-to-end serving throughput by 1.3–1.73× over fixed-layout deployments' on B200 serving GLM-5.3; open source at https://github.com/ict-agent/SPLASH-sglang.
§5.5/Table 1: all twelve directed switches at B=16, 256K context; Splash overhead 0.02–11.76 ms p50 vs blocking up to 667.31 ms; median overhead under 0.51% of target-ready.
§5.3/Table 3: DOP holds 8,271,360 distinct KV tokens vs 6,497,792 for DP-attention (27.3% more) on B200 at memory fraction 0.85.

Appendix B.1: 'These are one parameterization of Equation 10... The coefficients specify assumed utilization, communication, and overlap, rather than measured rates' — DCU/H200 latency models are illustrative, and H200 pool sizes are 'analytical projections... not measurements'.

Appendix G (Limitations): graph capture per layout, memory headroom for one-layer buffers, imperfect overlap for long-history switches, short-lived regimes, and DOP transfer path requiring 'equal TP and attention-DP degrees with one rank per owner'.
Appendix C: implementation built atop SGLang 0.5.10 with sparse FlashMLA backend; experiments on Vast.ai-rented B200/H200 and BW1000 DCUs; each sweep point averages 10 runs.

§6: acknowledges Pope et al. (2023) 'shard multiquery attention over the batch on TPUs to avoid replicating its KV head', positioning DOP's novelty specifically against DP-attention replicas for absorbed MLA.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on live-switching attention parallel layouts (TP/CP/DP-attention/new DOP) for LLM serving, squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: LLM serving (Abstract: 'improves end-to-end serving throughput by 1.3–1.73× over fixed-layout deployments' for GLM-5.3/DeepSeek-V3.2), long context & KV cache, inference & serving (SGLang 0.5.10 base), and efficiency; agentic/RL-rollout workloads motivate but are not the contribution. Novelty is solid but bounded: the ownership-model framing is clean and DOP is claimed new ('to our knowledge, a new layout', §1), though the paper itself concedes Pope et al. (2023) already sharded MQA KV over the batch (§6), so DOP is chiefly novel for absorbed MLA. Rigor is strong for a systems paper (formal footprint/switch equations §2-3, per-layer primitive timings §5.4, full 128/136/116-measurement tables §D, honest negatives like DOP trailing CP by 42.2% at 128K/B=1, limitations Appendix G), but the abstract's headline 1.3–1.73× follow-the-layout claim is not backed by an explicit dynamic-workload (e.g., rollout trace) experiment, the DCU/H200 latency models are admitted 'illustrative timing law[s]' with assumed coefficients (Appendix B.1), and no empirical comparison against prior reconfiguration systems (Flying Serving, Shift Parallelism) is run. Evidence for switch overheads is strong (0.02–11.76 ms p50 vs up to 667.31 ms blocking, Table 1; 27.3% more KV capacity, Table 3), but end-to-end scheduling benefits are inferred from fixed-layout sweeps. Generalizability is decent—three hardware platforms and three models show consistent regimes—yet DOP's gains are specific to head-free MLA caches and the transfer path requires equal TP/attention-DP degrees (Appendix G). Reproducibility is good: open-source implementation, detailed configuration appendices, seeds, and 10-run averaging, though reproducing requires renting B200/H200/DCU hardware and frontier models.

primary_link.title: SPLASH: Switching Parallel Layouts of Attention with Seamless Handoff for LLM Serving

papers.summary: No single way of parallelizing attention serves large language models well under all loads. Low concurrency favors tensor parallelism, many independent requests favor data-parallel attention, and long prompts favor context parallelism. Reasoning, agentic, and RL-rollout workloads make a fixed choice untenable: a batch that begins as many short requests ends as a few very long ones, so the best layout changes while the same requests run. Serving engines nevertheless fix one layout at launch, beca
papers.summary_zh: 本論文處理 LLM 推論服務中注意力平行配置無法隨負載變動的問題：請求少時 tensor parallelism（TP）最快，大量獨立請求適合 DP-attention，超長提示則需要 context parallelism（CP）；但 RL rollout 等工作負載的批次會從「多而短」變成「少而長」，而現有引擎在啟動時即固定配置，切換得清空請求並重啟 worker。關鍵觀察是：在 KV head 極少或為零的現代注意力（如 MLA）下，KV cache 的存放位置與注意力權重的切分方式已彼此解耦。作者據此建立所有權模型，將配置化約為「投影權重放在哪裡」與「誰擁有 cache」兩個決策，並導出零冗餘的新配置 DOP（Decoupled Ownership Parallelism）：權重如 TP 切分、每個請求的 cache 由單一擁有者持有，KV 容量比 DP-attention 多 27%–60%。系統 SPLASH 在服務不中斷的前提下，於一般推論步驟內逐層搬移目的地缺少的狀態，十二種有向切換僅需 discard、all-gather 與 all-to-all 三種集合通訊；轉換感知排程器挑選最快可行的配置，待另一配置領先一定餘裕才切換。在 B200 服務 GLM-5.3 時，端對端吞吐量較固定配置提升 1.3–1.73 倍，切換僅增加 0.02–11.76 ms（阻塞式可達 667.31 ms），中位數開銷低於所屬步驟的 0.51%；相同規律亦見於 H200 的 DeepSeek-V3.2 與 DCU 的 GLM-5.3-Flash。限制包括 CUDA graph 須為各配置預先擷取、切換需保留記憶體餘裕、通訊與運算重疊不完全，且負載震盪過快時切換不划算；批次大小與請求允入和配置的聯合最佳化仍屬未來工作。整體而言，本系統讓配置隨動態負載即時演進，對 RL rollout 與代理式應用具實務價值。
papers.title: SPLASH: Switching Parallel Layouts of Attention with Seamless Handoff for LLM Serving
papers.title_zh: SPLASH：為 LLM 服務以無縫交接切換注意力的平行配置

links.title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments with Qwen3-8B advisors for Gemini and Claude show that AdviSD outperforms advisor-GRPO by 4.2-6.4 percentage points on BFCL-v3 and by 3.9-5.1 score points on EnvScaler.'
Section 7 (Q2), Table 2: 'AdviSD exceeds matched-count random selection by 2.5-4.9 points and no gating by 3.2-5.1', while 'AdviSD, inverted gate' trails GRPO on both benchmarks with both executors.

Section 4.2, Theorem 1: 'Decreasing r_I/r_S strictly increases both theta* and J(theta*)'; Section 6/Corollary 1 motivates the matched-count random control because uniform thinning 'changes exposure, not composition'.

Section 7 (Evaluation): 'Every trained method has three independent training runs... evaluate it four times on the test set, and average the four scores'; Appendix E notes no-advisor/frozen-advisor SDs 'reflect only evaluation randomness'.
Appendix E 'Scope and limitations': 'Evaluation covers two executor families, one shared reflector, and three runs per trained method. The updates to API models can constrain exact reproducibility.'

Appendix C.3 (end): 'AdviSD's predictive score does not guarantee mu_G > mu_0' and the results 'do not establish finite-run robustness to teacher noise or convergence for AdviSD with its evolving self-teacher and GRPO-AdamW updates'; Appendix E.1: observed retention decline 'does not identify those classes or rule out changes in score scale or in the proposal distribution'.

Appendix H.3: paired-contrast precedents (RLCSD, OCSD, PBSD, RLSD); 'AdviSD differs in the prediction target and the role of the contrast: the advisor scores a separate executor's recorded response with and without issued advice'.

Table 3 (Q3): OOD macro-averages 77.2 (Gemini) and 74.0 (Claude) lead compared methods; Section 7 notes 'AdviSD itself trails standalone execution and GRPO by 1.7% points on Claude's ACEBench multi-step tasks'.

Appendix D, Table 4 and Appendix F: full training configuration (4 H100 GPUs, 200 updates, lr 1e-6, YaRN factor 4, top-100 token support, lambda_s schedule, u_d=0.95) and exact executor/advisor/reflector/teacher prompts; but no release of the authors' own code is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: trains a small LLM advisor (Qwen3-8B) with GRPO plus selective feedback-conditioned self-distillation to steer frozen frontier LLM executors (Gemini, Claude) on multi-turn tool-use benchmarks, hitting LLM, agents/tool-use, and RL/alignment preferences directly. Novelty is moderate: advisor models, feedback-conditioned self-distillation (SDPO, DistIL, HERO, HinT-SD), and paired-contrast selection (RLCSD, OCSD, PBSD, RLSD) are acknowledged close precedents; the distinct contributions are applying paired with/without-advice scoring of a recorded executor response to gate advisor supervision, donor-advice threshold calibration, an abstention bypass, and a stylized two-teacher theory separating supervision composition from exposure. Rigor is solid: explicit assumptions and honest scoping of the theory (does not cover the actual changing-teacher GRPO-AdamW training and the gate is not shown to identify the theoretical sensitivity classes), fixed test sets, validation-based checkpoint selection, well-motivated ablations including a matched-count random control and inverted gate. Evidence is consistent across two executors, two in-domain and four OOD benchmarks plus cross-version/cross-family transfer, with honest negative notes (e.g., trails standalone on Claude ACEBench multi-step; transferred advisors underperform executor-specific training). Deductions: only three runs with SD but no significance tests, a single advisor model and reflector, known confound that the matched-count control runs on its own rollouts, closed API executors, and no code release for the method despite very detailed hyperparameters and prompts.
topics: agent benchmarks (BFCL-v3, EnvScaler, ACEBench, ToolHop, tau2-bench, RoTBench)

primary_link.title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation

papers.summary: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討在無法修改權重的前提下，如何訓練小型「顧問」（advisor）模型，以自然語言建議引導凍結的前沿 LLM 執行者。僅靠任務報酬的 GRPO 難以指出哪些建議決策該改變；反思提出的修正雖合理，卻未必改變執行者行為，學習此類冗餘修正可能透過共享參數損及其他情境的建議。作者在共享參數模型中證明：持續失敗（建議無法影響執行之情境）所供修正偏好較弱，其監督佔比上升會限制學習上限；降低其保留率可提高最終表現。據此，AdviSD 結合結果導向 GRPO 與選擇性自蒸餾：反思提出修正後，顧問在含與不含已發建議的兩種情境下，為同一記錄的執行者回應計算對數概似差異，幅度超過以其他任務建議校準的門檻者才納入監督，被標記的原有棄權則免經門檻；再由具回饋條件的預更新副本教導只見原始情境的學生，無需執行者概似值或額外推論。實驗以 Qwen3-8B 顧問搭配 Gemini 與 Claude 執行者：BFCL-v3 超越 advisor-GRPO 4.2–6.4 個百分點，EnvScaler 超越 3.9–5.1 分，並勝過等量隨機選取 2.5–4.9 分；域外基準（如 ACEBench）較單獨執行提升 2.7–3.6 分，且能跨執行者版本與模型家族轉移。理論假設教師固定、保留機制平穩，未證明實際訓練收斂；評估僅涵蓋兩個執行者家族與三次訓練。此研究顯示「選擇向哪些修正學習」比單純減少監督更重要，對調校黑箱模型具參考價值。
papers.title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation
papers.title_zh: AdviSD：以針對性多輪自蒸餾學習為前沿 LLM 提供建議

links.title: Orthogonal Yet Coupled: Decoupling Geometric Components for Model Merging

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: DiGA orthogonally decomposes task vectors into orientation and structural components and claims cross-component coupling is 'a previously overlooked interference'; repository stated as github.com/wzj1718/DiGA
Section 4.2 Table 1: DiGA reaches Task Avg. 59.18% (LoRA) and 58.60% (OFT) merging five Llama-3.1-8B experts, exceeding strongest baselines by 0.48 and 1.28 points
Section 4.2 Table 2 and Table 3: DiGA averages 41.09% on MergeBench fully fine-tuned Llama-3.2-3B experts (vs 40.87% best baseline) and 61.84% on three Qwen2.5-VL-7B experts (vs 61.66% best baseline)
Section 4.3 Table 4: whole-vector aggregation ablation drops Task Avg. from 58.60 to 58.24; T-only and R-only drop to 51.90 and 55.56, and removing source magnitude causes a 3.42-point drop

Section 4.4 Table 5: component separation improves TIES/DARE/TSVM Task Avg. by +0.26/+0.56/+0.37, while Component-Joint reduces TSVM by 2.25 points; norm ratios near 1.0 indicate gains are directional, not magnitude-based
Appendix F.2 Table 7: Task Avg. 58.03±0.31 over all 120 expert orderings, with 118/120 orderings beating OrthoMerge
Appendix E: derivations and proofs of existence, uniqueness, and cross-component orthogonality of the base-induced decomposition
Appendix D: evaluation uses lm-evaluation-harness, bigcode-evaluation-harness, lmms-eval with specified decoding, fixed expert orderings, and NVIDIA RTX A6000 48GB GPUs
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on task-vector model merging applied directly to Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.2-3B, and Qwen2.5-VL-7B experts, evaluated on reasoning, code, commonsense, safety, and multimodal benchmarks, so it matches LLM/transformer/training preferences well (though not agents, RAG, or Japanese NLP). The orientation/structural orthogonal decomposition via QR of the base weight and the 'cross-component coupling' claim are genuinely new within the geometric merging line (TSVM, OrthoMerge, Iso-CTS), with supporting proofs in Appendix E. Rigor is solid: ablations (Table 4), generality tests over TIES/DARE/TSVM (Table 5), full 120-permutation ordering sensitivity (Table 7), and geometric analyses (Section 4.5), but the aggregation rule (gamma=(1+c_bar)*n_bar) is heuristic, gains are modest (0.18-1.28 points), no significance tests or seed variance for main results, and several ablation deltas are within noise margins. Evidence is consistent and multi-setting but small-magnitude; a weakness is that whole-vector ablation differs by only 0.36 points. Generalizability is shown across LoRA/OFT/full fine-tuning and language plus vision-language settings, but limited to transformer 2D projection matrices and 3B-8B scale. Reproducibility is strong: public code, Algorithm 1, fixed expert orderings, harness specifications (Appendix D), and hardware details.

primary_link.title: Orthogonal Yet Coupled: Decoupling Geometric Components for Model Merging

papers.summary: Merging pretrained models has emerged as an effective approach for consolidating diverse capabilities into a single unified model. However, prevailing merging methods typically treat each task vector as an indivisible merging unit, overlooking the heterogeneous geometric changes encoded within it. This treatment can induce cross-component coupling: when merging decisions are derived from statistics of the complete task vector, the geometric characteristics of one component may influence how anot
papers.summary_zh: 該論文指出,現有模型合併方法多半將任務向量視為不可分割的單位,忽略其內部同時編碼的異質幾何變化。當遮罩、符號選舉、權重等合併決策取自完整任務向量的統計量時,某一幾何成分的特性可能影響另一成分如何被選取、加權或組合,作者稱之為「跨成分耦合」(cross-component coupling);這是有別於不同專家間衝突、發生在單一任務向量內部的干擾來源。為此,論文提出 DiGA 框架:以預訓練權重經 QR 分解所得的正交基底 Q 作為共享幾何參考,將每個任務更新正交分解為「定向成分」(框架內座標呈反對稱,對應參數框架朝向的改變)與「結構成分」(座標呈對稱或超出預訓練子空間),於各自子空間獨立聚合後再重組。聚合運算子透過 Gram-Schmidt 移除冗餘方向、保留原始範數,並以平均成對餘弦相似度校準幅度。實驗涵蓋 Llama-3.1-8B 的 LoRA 與 OFT 五專家合併、MergeBench 全量微調語言專家,以及 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 視覺語言專家,DiGA 皆達到最佳或領先的目標任務平均,遷移表現亦未受損;將成分分離原則套用於 TIES、DARE、TSVM 亦帶來一致增益。限制方面:整向量聚合的消融差距僅約 0.36 分,若干基準增益有限;循序 Gram-Schmidt 對專家順序敏感;分解僅套用於注意力與 MLP 投影矩陣。此研究證明「分別處理幾何成分」是可重複使用的合併原則,兼顧理論嚴謹性與實務價值。

links.title: Alpha Diffusion Language Models: Factorization Alone Is Not the Problem

evidence: Table 1 / Section 4.1: AlphaDLM (k=16) reaches 34.6% GSM8K at 4 NFE versus 4.2% for MDLM evaluated with the same fixed-NFE confidence sampler; other baselines at most 7.7% at 4 NFE.

Section 4.1 (Table 3): matched comparison from shared k=1 checkpoint at 250k updates — sequence-level k=16 34.65% vs best token-wise 19.86% at 4 NFE; k=8 49.20% vs 44.35% token-wise at 16 NFE; single training seed and EMA weights noted.

Section 3.2 / Appendix B, B.1: factorized optimum characterized as marginals of a distribution minimizing D_KL to lower-temperature target plus (alpha/(1-alpha))·TC, building on Lapidoth and Pfister (2019); Proposition 1 proved via arithmetic-geometric mean inequality, with boundary analysis at alpha=1/m and a counterexample showing the support condition is necessary.

Section 4.2 / Appendix D: SDAR-1.7B fine-tuning at threshold 0.99 gives 51.5% MATH500 and 77.2% GSM8K vs 50.6%/76.3% for CE with TPF gains of 31.6%/27.1%; on code, HumanEval pass@1 ties CE+CAP at 60.6% (TPF 1.74→1.94) and across the full sweep peak accuracy is highest for CE/CE+CAP, indicating mixed transfer.

Appendix C (Table 2): shared TinyGSM recipe fully specified (12-block DiT, AdamW lr 3e-4, batch 512, EMA 0.9999, 512-token sequences); reproduction check on IDLM reevaluation yields 12.51%/17.06% vs published 12.81%/15.39%; no code or artifact availability is claimed anywhere in the document.

Section 4.1 limitations acknowledged: one-evaluation accuracy only 7.66% (k=32), best k reverses with decoding budget (k=16 best at 4 NFE but trails k=8 at 16 NFE), and 'These are single-checkpoint estimates, without repeated-training uncertainty.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core language-model methodology paper squarely in scope: a new training objective (sequence-level generalized cross-entropy/alpha loss) for masked diffusion LMs, evaluated on math reasoning (GSM8K/MATH500) and code (HumanEval/MBPP), with low-NFE parallel decoding as the efficiency focus. Matches LLM (2.5), Training (1.5), Inference (1.5), Reasoning (2.5, indirectly via math benchmarks), and Code (2.0) preferences. Novelty is solid: the reframing that factorization alone is not the barrier, plus a characterization of the factorized optimum as marginals of a KL-vs-total-correlation solution, is fresh relative to trajectory-distillation and dependency-modeling approaches, though alpha loss itself and token-wise variants are known. Rigor is high: controlled objective ablations at shared initialization and sampler (Section 4.1), initialization sensitivity (Appendix E), ancestral and adaptive sampling controls, and detailed proofs with boundary cases and a counterexample (Appendix B.1). Evidence is strong for the headline claim (34.6% at 4 NFE vs 4.2% MDLM under the same sampler) but absolute accuracy remains below autoregressive references (53.9-63.3%), single training seed per recipe, gains shrink at higher NFE, and code results are mixed (peak accuracy highest for CE/CE+CAP across the full sweep, Section 4.2). Generalizability is demonstrated at two scales/settings but with per-setting k tuning. Reproducibility is aided by full recipes and documented baseline protocols, yet no code or checkpoint release is stated.

primary_link.title: Alpha Diffusion Language Models: Factorization Alone Is Not the Problem

papers.summary: Discrete diffusion language models can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but reducing the number of denoising steps can lead to inconsistent predictions. Standard cross-entropy training fits conditional token marginals, whereas parallel generation requires consistent joint predictions. We introduce Alpha Diffusion Language Models (AlphaDLM), trained with a sequence-level alpha loss that recovers cross-entropy in the limit of vanishing alpha and has a joint-mode optimum at alpha one. Our anal

primary_link.title: Rethinking Soft Tokens for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models

papers.summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel generation by predicting and committing multiple tokens at each denoising step, yet they can generate individually plausible but mutually inconsistent tokens. Recent work shows that \emph{soft tokens} can mitigate this issue by representing uncertain positions with continuous embeddings built from the model's predictive distribution at the previous decoding step. papers.summary_zh: 擴散語言模型（DLM）透過每次去噪步驟同時預測並提交多個詞元以實現平行生成，但各位置獨立預測易產生個別合理卻彼此不一致的組合。近年以「軟詞元」緩解此問題，將未確定位置表示為連續嵌入並回饋至下一步，惟其改善平行解碼的機制先前未被系統性檢驗。本文在凍結的預訓練 DLM 上分析，先指出傳統歐幾里得式軟詞元建構與預訓練嵌入空間存在幾何不匹配：top-k 候選嵌入彼此相對對齊，其加權聚合卻與 [MASK] 嵌入近乎正交，線性內插會扭曲角度資訊並使範數縮小。作者據此提出免訓練、幾何感知的建構：保留歐氏平均做候選聚合，改以球面線性內插（SLERP）控制方向並維持 [MASK] 嵌入範數。分析顯示此建構的預測更貼近乘法混合而非加法混合，表示單純「保留不確定性」不足以解釋其行為；作者進而提出「尋求一致性」解釋，並以相對序列參考的反向 KL 較低等證據，支持軟詞元回饋會將機率質量導向連貫序列。在 LLaDA、LLaDA-1.5、LLaDA-2.0 mini 與 Dream 四個模型，以及 GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、MBPP 四項數學與程式基準上，本方法多數設定優於標準平行解碼與免訓練歐氏基線，例如 Dream 於 HumanEval 每步四詞元達 32.32%。限制在於與參考混合的精確比較僅涵蓋二至四個遮罩位置的控制型提示，難以擴及真實長序列。此研究將軟詞元的理解由不確定性保留推向一致性尋求，有助設計更有效的平行解碼表示法。

papers.summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate text by unmasking several tokens per step, but they are trained and sampled under different conditions. The model is trained on randomly masked sequences, whereas inference follows a trajectory shaped by the model's own predictions. Additionally, each step has no access to what the previous one computed. Recent methods narrow these limitations from separate angles, leaving open how these choices interact. papers.summary_zh: 遮罩擴散模型（MDM）訓練時以隨機遮罩序列學習，推論時卻沿著模型自身預測與解碼策略決定的軌跡前進，且各去噪步驟間無法傳遞資訊，形成訓練與推論的落差。本文提出統一框架PUMBA，沿三個軸向進行軌跡感知訓練：以漸進式解遮罩（PU）依推論策略建立訓練軌跡；以連續carry（隱藏狀態）跨步傳遞資訊；並以截斷式BPTT在窗口W內聯合最佳化多步損失。TinyGSM實驗顯示：完全對齊訓練與推論會因序列重複造訪而產生局部過擬合，故須以較大訓練解遮罩數訓練，仍能縮小遮罩分布差異；連續carry明顯優於Gumbel-softmax、straight-through與REINFORCE等離散梯度估計器；效能隨窗口W增大而提升且有理論支持。三項設計疊加後，125M模型在GSM8K追平同規模自迴歸模型的最佳checkpoint。作者將PUMBA擴展至LLaDA-8B的監督式微調，在full-canvas與block diffusion下皆推進效能與NFE的Pareto前沿：full-canvas下4000步增益超過SFT預算加倍，相同表現下最多節省22%的NFE；block diffusion最多節省26%。限制包括小解遮罩數下樣本重用導致的過擬合、學生強制取樣失效，理論界亦未涵蓋較小推論u的情形。此研究凸顯擴散模型後訓練須在軌跡對齊與可學習性間取得平衡。

primary_link.title: Tracing the Evidence: Faithful Token Attribution Through Vision-Language Reasoning

papers.summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet the visual and textual evidence supporting the generated responses remains difficult to identify. Faithful token attribution explains an LVLM's response by assigning scores that rank image and prompt tokens by how much the model relies on them, such that removing higher-ranked tokens causes the likelihood of the generated response to drop more rapidly. However, existing token-attribution methods have been developed m
papers.summary_zh: 大型視覺語言模型（LVLM）雖具備強大的推理能力，卻難以辨識其回應背後依據的視覺與文字證據。本文透過實證分析指出，現有 token 歸因方法在多模態場景面臨兩大挑戰：其一，影像與文字 token 聯合排序時，視覺證據常被文字選項等低相關 token 壓過而遭低估；其二，僅追蹤少數推理路徑，會漏掉分散在中間推理步驟的視覺貢獻。為此，作者提出 VTrace 框架：先建構模態感知的成對歸因矩陣，藉扣除各模態平均值凸顯個別 token 的獨特貢獻；再以 Katz 級數的封閉形式聚合所有直接與間接路徑；最後依遮蔽後對數機率的下降量，用兩人 Shapley 值校準影像與文字分數，使兩種模態得以公平地共同排序。在 MMStar、MathVista、MMMU 等六項視覺推理基準上與七種基線比較，VTrace 於聯合設定下將 RISE 插入 AUC 平均提升 7.1%、刪除 AUC 降低 18.0%，並在 Qwen3-VL 與 InternVL3.5 不同規模、以及答對與答錯樣本上皆維持領先，記憶體用量與執行時間亦具競爭力。作者另將 VTrace 歸因分數用於 GRPO 的信用分配（credit assignment），使 Qwen3-VL-4B 平均效能由 63.99 提升至 65.27，顯示其可作為訓練訊號。限制在於目前僅評估單影像推理，尚未涵蓋多影像、長情境與代理式互動等場景。此方法為 LVLM 可解釋性與後續最佳化提供了忠實且實用的工具。

It adapts WUSH, which constructs a data-aware transform from the second-order statistics of both factors in a matrix product to reduce quantization error. WUSH-KV uses calibration data to construct separate key and value transforms, with the value transform folded into the model weights and
papers.summary_zh: KV 快取的記憶體與頻寬成本會隨上下文長度與批次大小成長，是長上下文推論的主要瓶頸。低位元量化可縮減成本，但激進量化會對注意力分數與輸出造成明顯誤差。本文提出 WUSH-KV，將 WUSH 轉換（由矩陣乘積兩個因子的二階統計量以封閉形式建構的資料自適應轉換）應用於 KV 快取量化：針對每個 KV head，以校準資料分別為 key 與 value 建構獨立轉換；value 端轉換可離線摺入權重而不增加線上成本，key 端轉換則在 RoPE 之後施加，並可搭配 per-token 截斷式量化器，另將 sink 與近期視窗保留於全精度。理論上，針對 QuEST 量化器，在加性捨入雜訊模型與尾部、截斷對齊假設下，作者證明理想 WUSH 轉換在所有敏感性平衡的可逆轉換中近乎最佳。實驗顯示，在 2-bit KV 快取下，WUSH-KV 於 Qwen3-8B 的 WikiText-2 困惑度為 10.51，明顯低於 OSCAR 的 13.74（全精度基線 9.72）；下游基準（AIME 2025、MATH-500、GPQA Diamond、LiveCodeBench v6）在 Qwen3-8B 上全面超越 OSCAR，於 4B 與 32B 亦具競爭力；RULER NIAH 與 MRCR 長上下文評測顯示其在最長測試長度保留更高準確率。限制包括：key 端稠密轉換因位於 RoPE 之後必須線上計算，增加推論運算量；理論保證僅涵蓋敏感性平衡轉換，且依賴雜訊模型假設；實驗亦沿用 OSCAR 的截斷參數而未針對 WUSH 調校。整體而言，此方法為 2-bit KV 快取部署提供了兼顧品質與記憶體節省的可行路徑。

links.title: Character Training for Risk-Averse Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'character-trained models are competitive with baselines trained directly on it, and generalise better than them out of distribution on two of our four models'

Section 6 (Results): 'the best student on both Qwen models outperforms every baseline and its own prompted teacher (0.90 and 0.95 averaged over the four risk families, against 0.46–0.57 for the baselines), while on Gemma the baselines match or exceed it'
Section 6 (Figure 5 discussion): 'Myopic-reward preference increases on all four models and is a large, consistent off-target change'
Table 9: best constitution per model, e.g. Gemma-4-31B student 0.905 vs teacher 0.878 vs base 0.138; Qwen3.5-9B student 0.537 vs teacher 0.846 vs base 0.443
Table 14: SFT on Qwen3.5-9B scores 0.714/0.674/0.685 on core stakes, exceeding the best character student (0.537), showing in-distribution competitiveness is model-dependent
Section D.2 (Arms): 'Choosing the best of twelve students does, however, favour character training over the SFT, tie-training and DPO baselines, which are a single run each'
Section 9 (Limitations): 'risk that our findings do not generalise to other model families and parameter sizes' and other risk-aversion forms 'are not examined'

Appendix B (Reproducibility Statement): full constitutions (Appendix C), every hyperparameter (Table 7), evaluation protocols (Appendix D), per-arm results (Appendix F), GitHub link, and promised release of OOD evaluation families
Section 4.1: method is on-policy constitutional distillation with reverse-KL loss training LoRA adapters, teacher = same base weights with constitution as system prompt
Appendix D.2: five structural-ablation families (332 items) frozen before sweep models were trained, with strict-parser audit changing 110/6432 answers (1.7%)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment/safety work: instills CARA risk preferences in four open-weight LLMs (Qwen/Gemma, 9B-31B) via constitution-based on-policy distillation, directly serving the high-weight LLM, alignment, AI-safety, and agent preferences. Methodological novelty is moderate: constitutions (Bai et al.), on-policy distillation (Agarwal et al.), and the risk-aversion benchmark all pre-exist; the contribution is the application, a 12-arm factorial constitution design, and a careful side-effect analysis. Rigor is strong: control constitutions, held-out benchmark format, structural ablations, token ladders, McNemar/Wilson statistics, and honest reporting of failures (Qwen distillation weakness, calibration collapse on Gemma-4-31B character arm), though each arm is a single run and the best-of-12 student selection favors character training (acknowledged in §D.2). Evidence is extensive (Tables 8-30) but rests on single seeds and one sample per item; in-distribution competitiveness vs. SFT baselines is model-dependent rather than uniform. Generalizability is limited by two model families, one utility function (α=0.01), and family-dependent distillation dynamics, which the authors acknowledge. Reproducibility is excellent: GitHub link, verbatim constitutions, full hyperparameters, eval protocols, and promised artifact releases.

primary_link.title: Character Training for Risk-Averse Agents

papers.summary: Risk aversion in resources could prevent misaligned AI agents from causing catastrophic harm. Misaligned but risk-averse agents would tend to favor safer strategies like making deals with humans over riskier strategies like rebelling. We train agents to be risk averse through character training, finding that persona traits provide a robust mechanism for instilling risk preferences. To do this, we construct a model constitution describing constant absolute risk aversion (CARA) over an agent's res
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究如何以「性格訓練」(character training) 使 AI 代理人具備資源上的風險趨避。其動機來自 AI 安全論證:具風險趨避傾向的未對齊代理人會偏好與人類交易等較安全策略,而非冒險反叛,使協商交易更可行。作者撰寫描述固定絕對風險趨避 (CARA, α=0.01) 的人格憲法,以 on-policy constitutional distillation(reverse-KL 損失、LoRA 介面卡)注入 Qwen 與 Gemma 兩個模型家族共四種模型(9B 至 31B);訓練提示為自由形式的不確定決策情境,刻意排除評測所用的選項選單格式,以檢驗泛化能力。並以因子設計消融憲法設計:範例數量、宣告式或程序式語句、是否描繪效用曲線。結果顯示,性格訓練在核心賭注評測上與直接以基準資料訓練的 SFT、DPO、tie-training 基線相當;在五種結構消融評測上,兩個 Qwen 學生模型(0.90、0.95)大幅超越基線(0.46–0.57),並在四個模型中的兩個展現更佳的分布外泛化。宣告式語句在四種模型上一致提升合作率;token 預算是影響最大的因素;Gemma 家族明顯比 Qwen 更容易蒸餾成功。副作用方面,四種模型的短視獎勵偏好皆上升,Qwen 的偏好一致性下降,但 MMLU-Redux 與 GPQA 能力大致不變。限制包括僅測試 CARA 形式的風險趨避、模型家族與規模有限、訓練預算受限。整體而言,本研究顯示性格訓練是灌輸廣泛性情的可行且可擴展途徑,但憲法措辭對下游行為相當敏感,作為安全介入部署前須謹慎設計與審計。

links.title: $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient

evidence: Abstract: reports average 27.4% token reduction and +1.0 percentage point accuracy vs Thinking models across 2B-30B dense and MoE models
Table 1: Qwen3-4B-S3-0.8 reaches 73.3 acc/15,004 tokens on AIME25 vs Thinking 71.7/20,704 and HMMT25 +8.3 acc with -33.0% tokens
Section 4.4 Table 3: probe-family ablation shows Sub stays close to Base while Null matches Full accuracy (70.2 vs 70.3) with fewer tokens (15,071 vs 20,269)
Section 4.1 and Appendix B.1: baselines are TIES-Merging and MI-0.8 interpolation on identical prompts/decoding; vLLM, four seeds {101,202,303,404}, pass@1 and avg@4, CompassVerifier-3B scoring
Section 3.2 Eqs. (4)-(7): method is a closed-form projection swap requiring only the two released checkpoints, no training, data, or roll-outs
Appendix A.2 Table 4: entropy ordering H_Null < H_Base < H_Sub holds on all seven datasets with values reported (e.g., Null 0.861 vs Sub 0.886 all-dataset mean)
Section 5.2 Assumption 5.1 acknowledged as an idealization; Corollary 5.4's entropy ordering depends on empirically observed negative inner product (Appendix A.5, Fig. 6)
Section 4.1: all five backbones are Qwen3-family models (Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-30B-A3B, Qwen3-VL-2B/4B, Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B); no non-Qwen family is evaluated
Table 1 deltas include negative accuracy changes (CMIMC25 -3.1, Omni MMSU -2.15) reported without confidence intervals or significance tests
No code or checkpoint release statement appears anywhere in the document; minor inconsistency between Abstract's '28 evaluation environments' and Conclusion's 'more than 25 evaluation settings'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-LLM paper squarely on multiple high-weight preferences: chain-of-thought reasoning efficiency, weight-space composition of Thinking/Non-thinking checkpoints (Qwen3 dense and MoE), transformer attention/entropy analysis, and inference cost reduction. The spectral null-space swap is a clean, training-free operator with a well-motivated empirical finding (parameter energy vs functional impact mismatch) and a probe-family ablation that isolates the null-space contribution (Table 3: Null 70.2 mean acc at 15,071 mean tokens vs Full 70.3 at 20,269). Evaluation breadth is a strength: five model families, 2B-30B, dense+MoE, text/VL/audio, ratio sweeps (Tables 2, 9), and consistent entropy ordering across seven datasets (Appendix A.2, Table 4). Weaknesses: all backbones are from a single vendor family (Qwen3), so cross-family generality is untested; no statistical significance or error bars despite small competition-math test sets where deltas of a few points (e.g., -3.1 on CMIMC25) are within plausible noise; the theory rests on an acknowledged idealization (Assumption 5.1 local optimality) plus an empirically verified sign condition (Appendix A.5, Corollary 5.4); no code or composed-checkpoint release is stated; minor internal inconsistency (Abstract says 28 evaluation environments, Conclusion says 'more than 25 evaluation settings'). Reproducibility is aided by full decoding configs (Appendix B.1: vLLM, seeds 101/202/303/404, pass@1/avg@4, CompassVerifier-3B) and a fully specified closed-form method, but absence of an availability claim caps this component. Overall a solid, relevant contribution with good ablations but limited family diversity and unquantified variance.

primary_link.title: $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient

papers.summary: LLMs trained with Chain-of-thought excel in reasoning capability, but often come with excessive token cost. We find that the core of reasoning capacity lies in the Thinking model's weight component within the null space of a projection defined by the corresponding Non-thinking model's dominant singular directions, and removing the subspace component can largely improve reasoning efficiency without hurting the accuracy gained during thinking-mode post-training. Unlike existing efforts that mostly
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個核心問題：Thinking 模型相對於對應的 Non-thinking 模型，其推理能力究竟儲存在權重空間的哪個區域？作者觀察到，將兩個 checkpoint 的權重差 ΔW 沿 Non-thinking 模型的主奇異方向做譜分解後，落在既有主子空間內的成分雖佔大部分參數能量，卻只引起微弱的功能變化；真正驅動推理能力的成分幾乎位於其互補的零空間中。據此，論文提出免訓練的 Spectral Null-Space Swap（S³）：保留 Non-thinking 模型在其主譜子空間內的權重，並從 Thinking 模型匯入互補成分，僅以一個比例參數 ρ 控制轉移量。在涵蓋 Qwen3 系列 2B–30B 密集與 MoE 架構、文字、視覺語言與音訊推理共 28 個評估環境的實驗中，S³ 平均較 Thinking 模型減少約 27.4% 的生成 token，同時整體準確率提升 1.0 個百分點，並在多數設定取得相較 TIES 與權重內插基線的 Pareto 前緣；例如 HMMT25 準確率提升 8.3 個百分點且 token 減少 33.0%，MathVista 也以更少 token 達到 78.05%。消融實驗的探針家族（Base、Sub、Null、Full）證實推理增益集中在零空間成分。機制上，作者以注意力熵解釋：Null 模型注意力更集中，並透過局部最佳化的簡化分析模型說明 H_Null < H_Base < H_Sub 的排序。限制包括需要同家族配對的 checkpoint、ρ 需依任務與 token 預算調校，理論亦屬理想化的小擾動分析。整體而言，S³ 為高效推理提供免訓練、具幾何視角的權重組合途徑，深具部署價值。
papers.title: $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient
papers.title_zh: S³：譜零空間互換讓推理模型更有效率

links.title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI

evidence: Abstract: full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 points over no-skill construction and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target
Section 4.1 Baselines: five baselines including No-skill Builder (same construction space/budget, empty bank) and Direct Builder skills controlling for semantic knowledge
Table 3 (Section 4.2): Builder meta-skills, all achieves 65.31 macro-average across Gemini/Qwen/GPT-OSS on Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, outperforming no-skill Builder (56.36) in all six settings

Section 5.3: cross-Builder transfer yields 13.36-point gain with Sol but 4.45-point decline with Gemini-Pro on NewtonBench; 'all confidence intervals include zero, leaving the performance benefits uncertain'
Table 4 (Section 5.4): controller ablation CI excludes zero only for Gemini-3.6-Flash; memory+context effects have CIs containing zero for all three Targets
Appendix B.3: fixed denominator with failed construction/execution scored zero; paired comparisons use 20K task-bootstrap resamples
Appendix A.2: 'Upon paper acceptance, we will release the full code and all prompts for skill learning, harness construction, baseline runs, and evaluation'
Section 5.2: same-model self-evolution shows average gains of 18.71 points over no-skill construction across three settings
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic: an LLM-agent paper on test-time harness construction where a Builder learns reusable 'meta-skills' from Target execution feedback (Sections 1, 3), squarely matching high-weight agent/tool-use and LLM preferences. The Builder-vs-Target knowledge distinction and evidence-grounded keep/revise/add bank updates are a reasonable incremental contribution, but the setting builds directly on the first author's prior strong-to-weak harness work and adjacent skill/meta-skill lines (Voyager, ExpeL, MetaSkill-Evolve, Evo-Harness cited in Section 2), capping novelty. Rigor is above average: five matched baselines including a no-skill Builder controlling for construction capability and a Direct-delivery control for semantic content (Section 4.1), fixed budgets and denominators with failures scored zero (Appendix B.3), and 20K paired task-bootstrap intervals. However, key secondary claims are honestly reported as uncertain: transfer CIs include zero (Section 5.3), and only the Gemini controller ablation excludes zero while memory+context CIs all contain zero (Table 4); evidence rests on a single execution per task-condition and one Builder model (GPT-5.6-Sol). Main gains are consistent across all six Builder-Target-benchmark settings (Table 3: 65.31 macro vs 56.36 no-skill; +12.02 over direct delivery), supporting the headline claim. Generalizability is limited to two benchmarks, ~10% dev splits, within-benchmark held-out tasks, and selected transfer configurations. Code is linked but full release including prompts is promised only upon acceptance (Appendix A.2); proprietary models reduce independent reproducibility despite a detailed Appendix B/C.

primary_link.title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI

papers.summary: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the f
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文研究測試期的 AI-for-AI（AI4AI）問題：在 Builder（建構者）與 Target（目標模型）權重皆凍結的情況下，如何讓 Builder 學會為 Target 打造更佳的執行環境（harness）。作者提出「後設技能」（meta-skills），以 when、provide、use 三個欄位描述「何時需要支援、提供什麼資源、Target 如何使用」，並透過「建構—執行—反思」迴圈，從開發集的執行回饋中迭代更新技能庫；學習完成後凍結技能庫，再為每個測試任務建構全新的任務專屬 harness。實驗涵蓋 Harness-Bench 與 NewtonBench，以 GPT-5.6-Sol 為 Builder，搭配 Gemini-3.6-Flash、Qwen3.8-Flash 與 GPT-OSS-120B 等 Target。完整技能庫的 Builder 達到 65.31% 的 macro-average 分數，較無技能建構高出 8.95 個百分點，較直接把同一技能庫交給 Target 高出 12.02 個百分點；同模型自我改進情境平均提升 18.71 分。分析顯示控制器等 harness 元件有助執行，技能可在不同 Builder 與 Target 之間轉移但效果取決於實作方式，且精煉過程未必單調改善。限制包括：僅驗證同類別任務內的泛化、跨資料集重用尚待研究、證據來自單一 Builder 與每個任務單次執行，且未評估相對於建構成本的增益。本文的意義在於指出「環境與支援設計」是代理自我改進的另一條軸線：學會打造更好的支援環境，可能比直接教導模型更多任務技能更有價值。
papers.title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
papers.title_zh: 在測試期 AI4AI 中學習後設技能以設計代理 Harness

links.title: DScale: Scaling Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Verification

evidence: Abstract: reports geometric-mean throughput gains of 43.9%/48.8% over DFlash, 22.2%/37.7% over DSpark, and 24.4%/32.0% over Domino on Qwen3-8B/4B, with lower request latency
Section II: Nsight Systems profiling of native DFlash on GSM8K, A100, TP1, concurrency 16 attributes 83.3% of summed GPU-kernel time to the target verify graph, motivating verify-side optimization
Section III-C (and Fig. 4): a 1735-64-15 MLP with 112K parameters predicts acceptance; draft Top1-Top2 logit gap correlates with accepted length at Spearman 0.741 (8B) and 0.722 (4B)

Section IV-D: cumulative ablation over DFlash control reaches 40.8%/44.6% geometric-mean throughput with all three mechanisms; budget adjustment raises accepted-token retention from 71.6%/70.5% to 91.3%/91.6% (Fig. 10)
Section IV-A: setup is a single A100-40GB with TP1, temperature 0, Qwen3-8B/4B targets, GSM8K/MATH500/HumanEval/MBPP, concurrency sweep 8-32, five-repetition medians, matched seeds and manifests
Section IV-E: DScale retains 832 MiB (8B) and 724 MiB (4B) graph-pool reserved memory, 20.2%/11.3% below DFlash; Conclusion admits only W=16 blocks are evaluated
Section IV-B (Supplementary Figs. 5-7): the same frozen predictors yield 45.2%/45.8% gains at temperature 1 and 43.9-55.8% under TP2, supporting transfer without retraining
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-inference systems work: adaptive verification budgeting for block-diffusion speculative decoding on Qwen3 targets served via SGLang, squarely matching the LLM (2.5) and Inference & Serving (speculative decoding, KV cache) preferences, with no out-of-scope domain. Novelty is solid but incremental: each mechanism (verify-tile routing, learned per-request verify-length allocation with a 112K-param predictor, fixed-address CUDA-graph integration for ragged prefixes) is a plausible advance over DFlash/DSpark bucketing, well differentiated in Table I and Section II-C. Rigor is strong: formal objective, correctness proposition for Algorithm 1, complexity analysis, 2 models x 4 datasets x 7 concurrencies with five-repetition medians and geometric means, cumulative ablations, GPU profiling, and memory accounting. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (e.g., 83.3% verify-kernel share motivating the work; retention 71.6%->91.3%; 3.08-4.08% allocator overhead), though key results live in figures/supplementary material not verifiable here and no output-quality metric beyond distribution-preservation argument is given. Generalizability is tempered by a single A100-40GB main setup, TP1/TP2 only, two Qwen3 models, and the admitted fixed W=16 block width (Conclusion), although frozen predictors transfer across temperature and TP. Reproducibility is moderate: algorithms, feature dimensions, and training losses are specified and supplements are claimed, but no code or artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: DScale: Scaling Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Verification

papers.summary: Growing large language model applications demand efficient inference. At high concurrency, block-diffusion speculative decoding suffers from verification padding, rejected candidates, and incompatibility between variable prefixes and fixed-shape graphs. Uniform truncation sacrifices acceptable tokens. We present DScale, preserving drafter architecture, weights, and full draft length. A separate 112K-parameter predictor requires neither confidence calibration nor hardware speed-curve preparation.
papers.summary_zh: LLM 服務需兼顧低延遲與高吞吐，但區塊擴散式投機解碼（如 DFlash）在高併發下有三大瓶頸：驗證沿用 prefill 的寬 tile 產生大量無效填充、各請求被接受的草稿長度不一卻共用固定 16 槽視窗，且動態前綴與固定形狀驗證圖不相容。DScale 提出 draft-training-free 的執行期系統，包含三項機制：(1) 路徑感知 tile 路由，驗證改用 16 列短 tile，prefill 保留寬 tile 以重複利用 KV 資料；(2) 動態驗證長度（DVL）預算分配，僅訓練 112K 參數的小型預測器，由草稿 logits 等訊號預測接受潛力，在不重訓草稿模型、無需信心校準或硬體速度曲線下，將各請求前綴打包進原容量一半的驗證空間；(3) 固定位址工作區的圖整合，讓變動邊界貫穿驗證與接受流程並重複使用已擷取圖。實驗於 A100-40GB、TP1，以 Qwen3-8B 與 Qwen3-4B 測試 GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、MBPP 四資料集與 8–32 併發度：相對 DFlash 幾何平均吞吐量提升 43.9%（8B）與 48.8%（4B），亦優於 DSpark 與 Domino，平均 E2E 延遲降低 31.4–33.1%；消融實驗顯示三機制逐項疊加均有增益，預算調整將接受 token 保留率由約 71% 提升至逾 91%，GSM8K 完整解碼步時間縮短 30.8–52.5%，分配器開銷僅佔步時間約 3–4%。限制：目前僅支援 16 槽區塊寬度，主結果限於單卡 A100 與溫度 0 的貪婪解碼（抽樣與 TP2 見補充材料），預測器需對每組目標—草稿配對訓練一次。本研究的價值在於證明驗證端最佳化可在保留草稿模型架構與權重的前提下，大幅提升高併發 LLM 服務的推論效率。

links.title: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation

evidence: Abstract: 'a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMath prompts'

Section 4.2 / Figure 3(b): teacher swap with student and supports fixed reverses source preference on all four evaluations (DeepMath 46.51 vs Eurus 30.89 under Math-RL; reversed under Code-RL); Appendix D.1 Table 19 replicates across five seed configurations with difference-in-differences 13.1-14.1 pp
Table 2 / Appendix D.2 Table 20: GSM8K trails DeepMath by 11.25 points on Math despite approximate token match (16.14M vs 16.63M supervised tokens)
Table 4: uniform random sampling achieves the highest Avg4 (37.65±0.38 at M=8) with zero GPU screening; Appendix F.2 Table 5 shows source filtering yields -0.3±2.0 Math across three paired draws

Section 5.3 / Figure 6(c): continued OPD on an effective 48-prompt support raises Code Macro from 50.03 to 63.16, above the initial student's 53.30; Appendix E.5 shows G→D gains persist under math-verify rescoring (+12.24 pp, 95% CI [8.70, 16.04])
Section 5.1 / Figure 4(a): median parameter cosine 0.069 vs functional cosine 0.859 across 43 checkpoints from seven teacher families

Appendix E.5: bidirectional hidden-state replacement at block 30 changes a 20-question probe pass rate from 18.75% to 24.38% (B→A') and 28.13% to 21.25% (A'→B), with block 10 showing no aggregate improvement

Appendix B: exhaustive hyperparameter tables, nested support construction with seeds 42/43/44 and SHA-256 ordering, and verbatim prompt templates; no explicit code or data release statement appears in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM post-training empirical study of on-policy distillation: how prompt quantity, source, and selection shape teacher-to-student transfer across Qwen3/DeepSeek model pairs. Highly relevant to LLM training, distillation, reasoning transfer, and data curation preferences. The systematic design is unusually careful for an empirical paper (token-matched controls, 5-config seed robustness for teacher swaps, matched-update continuation arms, alternative scoring robustness, RL-instance overlap control), but its headline findings are partly anticipated: few-prompt sufficiency echoes LIMA/one-example RLVR and acknowledged concurrent OPD work (Fu et al., Li et al. 2026b/c), and 'random sampling is competitive' is a negative result rather than a new method. Evidence is strong and well-hedged within studied settings, though several comparisons rest on only 3 support draws and small probes (e.g., a 20-question hidden-state intervention). Generalizability is limited to 1.5B-30B Qwen-lineage models and math/code-heavy capabilities. Reproducibility is very high on protocol detail (hyperparameters, seeds, SHA-256 support construction, verbatim templates) but no code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains students using teacher feedback on their own sampled responses, yet how prompt choice shapes transfer across teacher-student pairs remains poorly understood. We systematically study prompt quantity, source, and selection across RL- and SFT-continuation pairs and cross-model settings. We find that OPD can be highly prompt-efficient: a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMat
papers.summary_zh: 本論文系統性研究 on-policy distillation（OPD）中提示詞的數量、來源與挑選策略如何影響教師—學生模型間的能力轉移，實驗涵蓋 RL 延續配對、SFT 延續配對與跨模型蒸餾，使用 Qwen3 與 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 系列。主要發現有三：第一，OPD 對提示詞數量需求極低，在 JustRL 配對中僅 4 條 DAPO 提示即達到 3,840 條 DeepMath 提示的數學分數；第二，提示詞效用具有關係性，固定學生初始權重與提示集合、僅將 Math-RL 教師換成 Code-RL 教師，即可翻轉數學與程式提示的相對優劣；第三，八種針對性挑選方法（分層、語意多樣性、難度、梯度最佳化等）與混合池來源過濾，皆未穩定勝過均勻隨機抽樣。作者進一步結合參數與函數對齊診斷、KL 閉合、CKA、隱藏狀態替換介入與延續訓練實驗，顯示 OPD 能在參數更新方向迥異的情況下重現教師的預測變化（43 個 checkpoint 的中位數參數與函數餘弦分別為 0.069 與 0.859），而不利轉移可改用有效提示集合持續 OPD 予以恢復。限制包括結論限於所研究的配對與訓練設定，且 token 與更新預算未全程匹配。本研究對 LLM 後訓練的資料策展具務實意義：提示詞效率不等於可互換性，有效的資料選擇取決於教師—學生配對與目標能力，而隨機抽樣是難以擊敗的基線。
papers.title: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation
papers.title_zh: 超越提示詞數量：資料如何形塑 On-Policy 蒸餾中的能力轉移

links.title: EpiCon: Collective Agent Learning through Co-Evolving Multimodal Memory

evidence: Abstract: 'Across four host configurations, EpiCon improves macro-average scores by 1.7 to 4.9 points over No Memory and reduces memory-operation time by 67% to 74% relative to backbone-sized memory models.'

Section 5.1 (Evaluation suite): 4,538 questions from 11 benchmarks across document understanding, visual-to-code, vision-grounded math, and general VL reasoning; baselines are Mem0, Cognee, A-Mem, Agent-KB, No Memory.

Section 5.2 (Table 1): EpiCon (ours 2B) under Codex/Qwen3.8-27B scores 66.1 on MP-DocVQA vs 79.5 No Memory, an unaddressed per-benchmark regression alongside gains on ParseBench (57.1→68.5) and MATH-Vision (20.4→48.6).

Section 5.3 (Table 3): cross-harness evolution raises macro-average from 53.5→55.7 (Codex) and 53.4→56.6 (DeepSeek-Harness); ParseBench for Codex drops 63.4→58.9 after DeepSeek-Harness evolves the bank.
Appendix A.3: 'These checks establish structural validity; tree-operation demonstrations are not individually verified through downstream MAS replay.'
Appendix B: training details — two Qwen3.5-2B models, LoRA rank 16/scaling 32, lr 1e-4, 3 epochs, max seq 8192, checkpoints by validation loss (step 1000 controller, step 258 organizer).
Appendix C (Table 8): construction and evaluation splits are 'project-defined' and disjoint (1,000 construction vs 4,538 evaluation questions), not official benchmark splits.
Section 5.5 (Table 7): with GPT-5.6-Luna, EpiCon improves all four benchmarks (e.g., ParseBench 63.8→66.5, MATH-Vision 51.2→57.2) with fixed 2B memory models and frozen bank.
Resources claim: 'Resources available at https://zzzmyyzeng.github.io/EpiCon' (Abstract); no explicit code/data release statement beyond this link.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core Agents & Tool Use work (weight 2.5) on shared multimodal memory for LLM multi-agent systems, also hitting Multimodal AI, RAG/Knowledge (experience retrieval), and LoRA-based model training, so preference relevance is high and it is clearly in scope (agent memory, not pure CV). Novelty is moderate-to-good: cross-harness/cross-backbone frozen-bank reuse, joint text-visual memory co-evolution, and two dedicated 2B memory models (controller + tree self-organizer) are a sensible advance over Mem0/A-Mem/Agent-KB-style textual memory, though each ingredient builds on existing agent-memory and experience-consolidation work. Rigor is solid but not airtight: 11 benchmarks, 4 host configurations, strong baselines, and ablations (MC-only, visual injection, flat vs tree) are well designed, but results are single-run with no significance testing, splits are 'project-defined' rather than official (Appendix C), and the 2B variant regresses badly on MP-DocVQA (79.5→66.1, Table 1) without full discussion; tree-operation supervision is only structurally validated, not replay-verified (Appendix A.3). Evidence strength is supported by detailed tables and normalized cost accounting (Eqs. 8), but inflated by favorable splits and some mixed per-benchmark outcomes (BabyVision -2.7 to +4.8). Generalizability is decent: two harnesses, two open backbones plus GPT-5.6-Luna, and out-of-domain gains on WorldBench, tempered by inconsistent transfer on some benchmarks. Reproducibility is moderate: training hyperparameters (LoRA r16, lr 1e-4, Appendix B) and splits are given, a project page is linked, but prompts/JSON schemas and an explicit code/data release are not verified in-text, and reliance on very recent/unreleased models and benchmarks hurts replication.

primary_link.title: EpiCon: Collective Agent Learning through Co-Evolving Multimodal Memory

papers.summary: Agents can learn from past executions, but enabling different agents to reuse and build on one another's experience remains challenging. We introduce EpiCon, a shared multimodal memory framework for agent collective learning without updating host model parameters. EpiCon links question-level memory evolution to a persistent experience bank through two independently trained 2B models: a memory controller and a tree self-organizer. The controller jointly refines textual guidance and visual evidenc
papers.summary_zh: 多代理系統（MAS）執行任務時會累積經驗，但讓不同代理系統重用並延伸彼此的經驗仍是一大挑戰，且多數代理記憶僅以文字為主，難以保留圖表或文件中的視覺證據。本文提出 EpiCon，一個共享多模態記憶框架，能在不更新宿主模型參數的前提下支援代理集體學習。方法上，EpiCon 以兩個獨立訓練的 2B 模型組成記憶 harness：Memory Controller 在同一問題內共同演化文字指引與視覺證據，並自適應決定是否注入視覺記憶；Tree Self-Organizer 則以樹狀結構整併累積的經驗庫，供跨問題、跨 harness 與跨骨幹檢索重用。實驗涵蓋十一個基準、四大多模態任務領域，使用 Codex 與 DeepSeek-Harness 兩種 harness 及多個 backbone。單次求解下，凍結的經驗庫即可提升其他系統表現，跨骨幹與跨 harness 移轉分別帶來 3.2 與 4.2 分的 macro-average 提升；跨 harness 經驗演化使原系統再進步 2.1–3.2 分。四種宿主配置中，EpiCon 較無記憶基線提升 1.7–4.9 分，記憶操作時間較骨幹級記憶模型減少 67–74%；樹狀組織亦優於平面記憶，成效可推廣至 GPT-5.6-Luna。限制方面，個別基準改善不一致，跨 harness 演化可能在部分任務（如 MATH-Vision）造成退化，2B 版本效能略遜於骨幹級版本，且樹狀操作僅經結構驗證。整體而言，此研究顯示經驗可跨越系統邊界被累積與重用，為免更新參數的代理集體學習提供務實途徑。
papers.title: EpiCon: Collective Agent Learning through Co-Evolving Multimodal Memory
papers.title_zh: EpiCon：以共同演化的多模態記憶實現代理集體學習

links.title: Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL

evidence: Abstract: proposes GATS, augmenting RL with an OPD term whose weight adapts to the teacher-student gap, improving over reward-only GRPO by 4.37%-11.87% under matched student rollout budgets, with code at github.com/Ricardo-H/guide-then-let-go

Section 4.1 / Table 1: three Qwen2.5 teacher-student configurations (1.5B->7B, 1.5B->14B, 3B->7B), five baselines (Prompt-only, GRPO, GRPO+OPD, ATOD, SOD); GATS attains best Avg. SR of 64.84, 66.30, and 64.74 across configs

Section 4.4 / Table 2: ablations over decay shapes (linear/cosine/step, N=80) and linear horizons N in {20,40,60,80} plus matched N=52/29/29, with GATS best at 69.70 average; the paper notes N=20 is comparable but selected only via sweep
Section 4.5 / Table 3: GPU-hour accounting including teacher training and online inference on 8x H200; GATS exceeds GRPO by +13.1 to +18.2 pp at the 150-update reference budget
Appendix B.1 / Table 7: gap-utility diagnostic with eight Qwen2.5-3B checkpoints on ALFWorld showing OPD gain turning negative (e.g., -20.8 pp at -9.9 pp gap) once the student exceeds the teacher

Appendix A.2 Tables 5-6 and Algorithm 1: full shared hyperparameters (150 updates, group size 8, AdamW lr 1e-6), environment-specific settings, withdrawal rule, and K=5 lagged window; Appendix C provides verbatim interaction templates

Limitations from text: evaluation is 3 runs of 128 episodes on a fixed checkpoint with no training-seed variance or significance tests reported (A.1), and the diagnostic 'does not establish a universally optimal withdrawal threshold' (B.1)
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agentic RL methodology for LLMs: gap-adaptive on-policy distillation scheduling over GRPO for long-horizon agents (ALFWorld/WebShop/ScienceWorld) with Qwen2.5 teacher-student configs. Strong preference fit (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RL, Training) and unusually complete experimental design for its class: five baselines, matched rollout budgets, OOD splits, schedule-shape and horizon ablations (Table 2), GPU-hour cost accounting including teacher inference (Table 3), and a checkpoint diagnostic showing the gap-utility sign reversal (Appendix B.1, Table 7). Novelty is moderate: the mechanism is a simple monotone weight lambda_t = max(1 - M_S/M_T, 0) with permanent withdrawal, an intuitive refinement over existing annealed (ATOD) and divergence-weighted (SOD) teacher supervision rather than a new training paradigm. Rigor and evidence are good but not top-tier: training appears single-seed, no statistical significance or variance over training runs, the diagnostic covers only 8 checkpoints on one environment, and the code-release claim is unverifiable from text. Internal numbers are consistent (e.g., 64.84 vs 52.97 = +11.87 in Table 1). Generalizability is bounded by text-based interactive benchmarks and the requirement of a task-trained teacher reference. Reproducibility is strong: Algorithm 1, full hyperparameters (Tables 5-6), K=5 window, baseline implementations (A.3), and verbatim prompts (Appendix C), plus a code URL.

primary_link.title: Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents typically relies on sparse outcome-based rewards. This leads to a severe cold-start problem, as early-stage policies often fail to solve sampled tasks, leaving little useful reward signal for learning. To mitigate this problem, we use on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level guidance on the student's own rollouts. We find that the benefit of this guidance depends on the performance gap between the teacher and the student. When the teacher
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理長時程代理（agent）強化學習中的冷啟動問題：當獎勵僅來自最終結果且相當稀疏時，早期策略難以取樣到成功軌跡，GRPO 的群組內相對優勢會歸零，學習訊號嚴重不足。作者引入同策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation, OPD），在學生自身的 rollout 上提供 token 層級指導，並以診斷實驗發現關鍵規律：OPD 的增益與師生效能差距呈強烈單調正相關——教師明顯領先時有幫助，學生追平甚至反超後，持續蒸餾反而抑制進步。據此提出 GATS（Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling）：以教師參考分數與學生滯後移動平均分數之間的正規化差距決定 OPD 權重，隨差距縮小遞減；學生達到教師參考水準後即永久撤除教師，改以純 GRPO 繼續訓練。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 三個互動基準與三組 Qwen2.5 師生配置下，GATS 在相同的學生 rollout 預算下，較純 GRPO 提升平均成功率 4.37%–11.87%，於各配置均居首，並能在撤除教師後超越規模較小的任務訓練教師，兼顧蒸餾成本；消融實驗（線性、餘弦、階梯衰減及不同時間窗掃描）證實增益來自差距自適排程本身，而非單純的蒸餾。限制在於差距診斷基於特定配置，未建立通用的撤除門檻；未來仍需處理任務分布變動下的排程與教師重新啟用。此方法凸顯「何時放手」比「是否指導」更關鍵，同時達成早期加速與後期突破教師上限。
papers.title: Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL
papers.title_zh: 先引導再放手：稀疏獎勵代理式強化學習的差距自適應教師排程

links.title: Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers

evidence: Abstract: local second-order geometry of layerwise loss-to-go functions is 'governed, up to low-loss residual terms, by a pullback Fisher operator on hidden-state space'; evaluated across decoder-only models on WikiText, OpenWebText, FineWeb.
Theorem 1 (Section 3.1): Hessian decomposition ∇²J_ℓ = J̄ᵀF*J̄ + R_ℓ with ‖R_ℓ‖_op ≤ M_ℓ√(2ε_*) via Cauchy-Schwarz and Pinsker; full proof in Appendix A.2.

Proposition 1 (Section 3.2): tokenwise score κ_ℓ,s = ‖F*^{1/2}H_ℓ,s‖²_F vanishes outside the causal ancestor set; pathwise coupling bound Eq. (10) — correct but bounds over exponentially many causal paths may be loose.

Section 4.3/Figure 3: rank-allocation advantage concentrated on Gemma 2B, Qwen2.5 3B, SmolLM2 1.7B, OLMo-3 7B at τ=0.05/0.1; 'for larger and more homogeneous model families... the advantage is smaller'.
Section 4.4: κ-based pruning 'competitive with attention-based pruning and slightly better in several model/drop-fraction settings' — modest claim, not dominance.
Table 1 (Section 4.5): RKL+Geo wins 9/14 (mean ΔGeo 21.3), SkewKL+Geo 10/14 (mean 59.3), but FKL+Geo has mean ΔGeo = -38.4; Appendix E.8 admits 'the sweep contains incomplete runs'.

Appendix E.4/E.5: distillation grid restricted to SmolLM2-135M/360M and Qwen2.5-0.5B, ranks {16,32,64}, seq len 256; final PPLs in Tables 3-4 range from ~324 to ~2400, limiting practical significance; regularizer uses a readout-Fisher proxy rather than the full pullback operator (Appendix E.3, Eq. 30-32).

Appendix C: matrix-free K_ℓv via JVP-Fisher-VJP with torch.func.jvp/vjp code sketch and Hutchinson estimation (Algorithms 1-2); Table 2 lists ten Hugging Face checkpoints; Table 6 reports 0.8-6.0 GPU hours per model.
Appendix G: explicit limitations on locality, perturbation scale, architectural scope (decoder-only pre-norm only), and cost of curvature estimation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: a decoder-only LLM methodology paper (10 models 1B-9B on WikiText/OpenWebText/FineWeb) combining transformer interpretability (pullback Fisher geometry of the residual stream), efficiency (layerwise rank allocation, structured token pruning), and distillation. Theory is clean but largely elementary (chain rule + spectral bounds); novelty is moderate since Fisher/pullback analyses and attention-based token pruning exist, though the causal-support tokenwise score κ_ℓ,s is a fresh formulation. Evidence is mixed but honestly reported: geometry-guided rank allocation helps only some mid-size models (Section 4.3/Fig. 3), pruning is 'competitive' with attention rather than dominant (Section 4.4), FKL distillation is hurt by the geometry term (mean ΔGeo = -38.4, Table 1), and the distillation sweep is confined to sub-1B models with degraded perplexities (Tables 3-5, Appendix E.4) and acknowledged incomplete runs. Reproducibility is strong (checkpoint list, matrix-free JVP/VJP algorithms, hyperparameters, compute costs), but no public code link beyond checklist claims was verifiable in the text.

primary_link.title: Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers

papers.summary: Decoder-only transformers are trained only through a terminal next-token prediction loss, yet this loss constrains every intermediate hidden state through the fixed downstream computation. We formalize this constraint by studying layerwise loss-to-go functions: the terminal loss obtained by continuing a candidate hidden state through the remaining transformer blocks. Around successful validation trajectories, we show that the local second-order geometry of these functions is governed, up to low-
papers.summary_zh: Decoder-only Transformer 僅以最終的下一詞預測損失訓練，中間隱藏狀態如何受此目標約束？本文提出「預測幾何」觀點：對已訓練模型定義層級 loss-to-go 函數，證明低損失成功軌跡附近的局部曲率主要由輸出分布拉回至隱藏空間的 Fisher 算子 Kℓ 主導，其譜可區分輸出敏感方向與近似「預測零」方向；對因果 Transformer 更導出 token 級曲率分數 κℓ,s，僅在目標詞的因果祖先上非零，可作為損失感知的剪枝訊號。所有幾何量皆以 matrix-free 的 JVP/VJP 乘積估計。實驗涵蓋 WikiText、OpenWebText、FineWeb 與十個約 1B 至 9B 的模型：可觀測方向擾動的 KL 敏感度比零方向高數個量級，有效可觀測秩隨深度增加但遠低於隱藏維度；幾何引導的秩配置對部分中小型模型優於均勻 SVD/LoRA 基線；κ 剪枝明顯優於隨機剪枝並與注意力基線相當；幾何正則化搭配 reverse KL 與 skew KL 蒸餾，分別在 9/14 與 10/14 配對設定改善困惑度，forward KL 則無助益。限制：理論僅在參考軌跡附近局部成立，幾何量估計較前向統計昂貴，壓縮與剪枝實驗屬受控測試而非完整管線。本研究將終端預測目標化為殘差流內可量測的局部幾何，為壓縮、蒸餾與高效推論提供損失感知依據。
papers.title: Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers
papers.title_zh: Transformer 隱藏狀態軌跡的預測幾何

links.title: Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: claims +9.7 average math points over vanilla OPD and student surpassing its larger teacher
Section 5.1 Evaluation: 'We evaluate checkpoints every 10 optimization steps... and report the best checkpoint for each method' — selection-over-checkpoints protocol inflates all reported numbers
Table 1: Dr. OPD 35.0 avg math vs teacher Qwen3-4B 34.1; +9.7 over OPD (25.3) for Qwen3-1.7B
Table 3: lambda ablation shows non-monotonic sensitivity, jump from 27.8 (λ=0.3) to 35.0 (λ=0.4), unexplained
Section 5.1 Models: only Qwen3 family (1.7B/4B) used for both regimes; Section 5.1 Training: only 50 post-training steps
Appendix C: Assumption 6 regularity conditions, proofs of Theorem 3 (weighted-OPD validity) and Theorem 5 (one-step reward improvement); guarantees are local one-step only
Appendix B.2-B.3: implementation adds optimizer-scaled reward direction and RMS normalization beyond the Section 3-4 derivation
Section 6: dense concurrent related work on OPD weighting/trust (REOPD, TrOPD, IW-OPD, SparseOPD, Unmasking OPD) limits incremental novelty
Footnote 1 / Section title page: code released at github.com/zywang0701/Dr-OPD; Appendix A.1: verl implementation, 8xH100, shared hyperparameters in Table 4
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM training-methodology paper: token-weighted on-policy distillation of Qwen3 students, evaluated on math reasoning and code, with GRPO-style outcome rewards. High preference relevance (LLMs, reasoning, RL, code, training efficiency). Novelty is moderate: token-level trust/weighting in OPD is a crowded space (Section 6 lists TrOPD, IW-OPD, REOPD, SparseOPD, Unmasking OPD), but the specific mechanism—reward-sensitivity credits from a one-step inner update, closed-form clipped weights from a reward lower bound, and a single-JVP credit computation—is a distinct contribution. Theory is sound but local (one-step improvement under Assumption 6), and the implementation deviates from the clean derivation via unstated-in-theory stabilizations (optimizer-scaled reward direction, RMS normalization in Appendix B). Evidence is solid across four student-teacher configurations (Tables 1-2) but weakened by best-checkpoint selection over evaluation (Section 5.1), a single model family, only 50 training steps, no error bars, and a suspiciously sharp lambda=0.4 peak in the ablation (Table 3, 27.8→35.0). Good reproducibility: code link, full hyperparameters (Tables 4-5), prompt templates, and detailed Appendix B implementation.

primary_link.title: Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using dense, token-level supervision from a stronger teacher. Vanilla OPD treats all teacher signals equally, assuming that the teacher's supervision is equally important for every token. However, teacher signals at different tokens may have very different effects on the student's performance: some correct important reasoning errors, while others have little effect on the final answer. Motivated by this observation, we
papers.summary_zh: 本論文重新檢視同策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation, OPD）的核心假設：一般 OPD 對教師模型在每個 token 上給予的密集監督訊號一視同仁，但實際上部分訊號能修正關鍵推理錯誤，部分則幾乎不影響最終答案。作者提出 Dr. OPD，將權重選擇形式化為雙層最佳化：下層在給定 token 權重下以加權反向 KL 訓練學生模型，上層依訓練後學生的期望任務獎勵挑選權重。為使求解可行，他們設計交替迭代演算法：以閉式解更新權重 w_t = clip(1 + λc_t)，其中信用度 c_t 衡量加強遵循教師訊號與獎勵梯度方向的對齊程度，並透過單次 JVP 高效計算，避免逐 token 建立參數維度梯度；理論證明在正則條件下，此加權更新比 vanilla OPD 獲得更高的期望獎勵。實驗涵蓋 Qwen3 系列在數學與程式碼任務的強到弱及同尺寸蒸餾，Dr. OPD 全面優於 OPD、ExOPD、OPD+GRPO、GRPD 等基準：強到弱設定下數學平均提升 9.7 分，使 1.7B 學生超越 4B 教師（35.0 對 34.1）；同尺寸設定亦超越 RL 訓練的教師。限制在於依賴可驗證結果獎勵或學習式獎勵模型，Base 學生因成功取樣稀少使信用估計較不準確，理論保證亦僅限單步改進。此研究提供原則性準則判斷教師訊號該信任多少，連結蒸餾與結果獎勵，兼具理論與實務價值。

links.title: From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation

evidence: Abstract: MAESTRO achieves highest macro-average accuracy among compared methods for 0.6B and 1.7B Qwen3 students and reduces average training response length by 67.3% relative to standard OPD
Section 4.1 Baselines: comparison against initial student, SFT, KD, GRPO, OPD, TRD, FastOPD, SKD, and Relay-OPD on eight math benchmarks with avg@32 accuracy
Section 2.1: log-scale fits report R^2=0.993 for accuracy and R^2=0.968 for off-policy load, supporting the approximate logarithmic intervention scaling claim
Section 4.3 Ablation Study: full MAESTRO 47.1 avg vs 43.3 (Cov. only), 44.5 (Sim. only), 43.6 (w/o weighted-agg), 45.1 (w/o adapt. depth)
Appendix C Training Details: PDS threshold 0.14 (0.6B) / 0.10 (1.7B), alpha=0.5, tau=12, max two interventions, batch 128, LR 1e-6, eight H20 GPUs, code at github.com/yhao-wang/MAESTRO
Appendix D.2 / Figure 8: MAESTRO uses only 1.05x the average teacher tokens per training step of Relay-OPD, attributing gains to allocation rather than budget
Appendix D.1 / Figure 7: sensitivity sweeps show default alpha=0.5 and tau=12 achieve 47.1 versus 43.4-44.2 and 43.9-44.6 for alternatives
Section 4.4 / Figure 6: hard-case trigger rate rises from 21% on AMC23 to 60% on AIME24 and 70% on HMMT, and intervention ratio decreases from about 16% to 5% during training
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on on-policy distillation for mathematical reasoning, strongly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, training/optimization, efficiency). The controlled characterization of teacher intervention (logarithmic scaling of benefit and off-policy load, peak-vs-retention dissociation, difficulty/position dependence) is a genuinely informative empirical contribution, and MAESTRO's PDS (teacher-weighted coverage x Bhattacharyya similarity, paragraph-level weighted aggregation) adaptively timing and sizing intervention is a meaningful but incremental advance over Relay-OPD/SKD. Rigor is solid: eight benchmarks, avg@32, two student scales, eight baselines, component ablations, threshold/alpha/tau sensitivity, and a teacher-budget control showing only 1.05x Relay-OPD tokens, ruling out a 'more teacher' explanation. Weakened by single model family/teacher, math-only evaluation, no error bars or seed variance, reliance on unverifiable figure fits, and some analysis probes on restricted settings (e.g., 515-token rollouts). Hyperparameters, data, and hardware are documented and code release is claimed, supporting good reproducibility; generalizability beyond Qwen3 math reasoning remains untested.

primary_link.title: From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own reasoning trajectories using feedback from a stronger teacher. Teacher interventions can improve these trajectories, but also change the distribution on which the student learns. Our controlled studies show that rollout quality alone is an incomplete criterion for allocating teacher guidance. Deeper intervention yields diminishing gains in rollout accuracy while increasing off-policy load. In a training probe with a restricted rollout hori
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討同策略蒸餾(OPD)中教師介入的兩難:教師暫時接管學生生成雖能矯正推理軌跡,卻使訓練資料偏離學生自身策略(off-policy)。作者以控制實驗歸納三項發現:軌跡品質增益與 off-policy 負擔皆隨介入深度近似對數成長,少量介入即可大幅提升軌跡準確率;在有限生成長度下,適度介入能推高峰值準確率,較強介入則改善訓練後期的表現保留;最佳介入深度與位置隨題目難度與推理進度而異。據此提出 MAESTRO,設計「策略分歧分數」(PDS),結合教師加權的候選詞覆蓋率與局部分布相似度(Bhattacharyya 係數),在推理段落邊界評估分歧,動態決定教師何時接管與介入深度,每條軌跡最多介入兩次,並在最後一次介入後終止生成。實驗以 Qwen3-4B 為教師、Qwen3-0.6B 與 1.7B 為學生,在 AIME、HMMT、MATH500 等八個數學基準上,MAESTRO 分別取得 31.36% 與 47.12% 的最高 macro-average 準確率,1.7B 學生於全部基準領先 Relay-OPD 等對比方法,平均訓練回應長度較標準 OPD 縮短 67.3%;教師用量會隨題目難度自動增加、隨訓練進展遞減,展現自適應行為。限制在於 PDS 閾值等超參數仍需調校,且實證僅涵蓋數學推理與 Qwen3 系列模型。本研究指出有效教師指導的關鍵不在最大化教師參與,而在依學生狀態選擇性調度,對小型模型的蒸餾訓練設計深具參考價值。
papers.title: From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation
papers.title_zh: 從不協調到統籌調度:同策略蒸餾中的教師介入

links.title: Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: count-only estimator achieves average ECE of 13.0% vs 32.7%-42.4% for standard full-sequence confidence methods in white-box settings
Section 3.3: replacing UQAC's selected-token probabilities with a shared constant (C_global^S) still improves calibration over UQAC, showing count rather than probability drives gains
Section 5.1 Implementations: disagreement threshold theta is set per family (0.50/0.60/0.85) using 100 random MATH training problems, a validation-tuned hyperparameter
Section 5.2 Main Results: on DeepSeek-V3.2, mean ECE falls from 32.1%-40.2% (verbalized) to 13.7%-16.3% with DTC_lin rescoring
Table 7: for Qwen3-30B-A3B Verb.TopK trajectories, DTC_prod raises ECE from 40.2 to 46.7 on AIME24, a partial failure not emphasized in the main claims
Appendix C.3: count-based accuracy decline (r=-0.985) persists after dividing by path length (ratio r=-0.937), addressing the overthinking/length confound
Reproducibility statement and Section 4: code released at github.com/szu-tera/DTC.git; a, b, n, k, theta, decoding settings, and prompts (Appendix A) are specified
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper on calibrated uncertainty for chain-of-thought reasoning, strongly matching the highest-weighted preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, plus safety/evaluation tangents). The pilot study deconstructing UQAC (Section 3.3) is a genuinely interesting finding that count, not selected-token probability, drives calibration gains, and the JSD-threshold divergent-token count is a simple but fresh confidence signal. However, the ingredients (cross-model disagreement, JSD, entropy-style aggregation) build on known ideas (Section 2 acknowledges MUSE, CrossCheckGPT, BaseCal, TokUR), the DTC_lin mapping (a=0.95, b=0.05, n=10) is ad hoc, and threshold theta must be tuned per model family on a small validation set (Section 5.1 Implementations). Rigor is solid: 8 white-box and 3 black-box generators, 8 benchmarks, strong baselines including PRM reference, and ablations for threshold, auxiliary size, n, k, divergence choice, and a count-vs-length-ratio confound check (Appendix C.3). Evidence is weakened by math-only evaluation, DTC_lin's sometimes-lower AUROC than baselines in black-box settings, and DTC_prod failures in some cells (e.g., Table 7 Qwen3-30B-A3B Verb.TopK ECE rises 40.2 to 46.7) while headline claims emphasize DTC_lin. Generalizability is limited to math benchmarks and requires auxiliary models; reproducibility is good with released code and detailed hyperparameters and prompts.

primary_link.title: Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs

papers.summary: As the chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities of large language models improve, evaluating and calibrating their reasoning confidence is becoming increasingly important for quantifying the uncertainty of their answers. Current methods for estimating the confidence of large language models are generally based on probabilities of selected key tokens, but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Our pilot study finds that replacing selected token probabilities with coarse substitutes can also imp
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型透過 Chain-of-Thought 推理解決複雜問題,但現有信心估計多依賴 token 機率,普遍過度自信。本文研究「推理不確定性量化」,目標是為每條推理路徑給出能反映答案可靠度的校準信心。先導實驗顯示:把 UQAC 所選 token 的機率換成路徑平均值甚至固定常數,校準效果反而更佳,暗示真正有效的訊號可能是「選中 token 的數量」而非機率值本身。據此提出 Divergent Token Confidence(DTC):以 Jensen-Shannon 散度比較生成模型與輔助模型在同一軌跡各位置的下一個 token 分布,統計超過門檻 θ 的「分歧 token」數,再分別以線性映射(DTC_lin)或與平均 token 機率結合(DTC_prod)轉為信心分數;白盒情境用生成模型本身的機率,黑盒情境改用兩個外部輔助模型,皆不需訓練,也不改變生成過程。實驗涵蓋 Qwen2.5、Qwen3、Gemma3 與 DeepSeek-V3.2 等模型及 MATH-500、AMC23、AIME、HMMT 等數學基準:白盒下 DTC_lin 平均 ECE 降至 13.0%,明顯優於全序列機率法的 32.7%–42.4%,DTC_prod 並保有 80.8 的平均 AUROC;黑盒下 DeepSeek-V3.2 的 verbalized 信心 ECE 由 32.1%–40.2% 降至 13.7%–16.3%,與 verbalized 分數結合也能大幅降低 ECE 且 AUROC 變動有限。限制方面,θ 需按模型家族以小型驗證集調校,實驗集中於數學領域,部分黑盒情境的 AUROC 仍遜於 verbalized 基準。整體而言,跨模型分歧計數提供簡單、可解釋且免訓練的信心訊號,對安全關鍵應用中的拒答與人工覆核深具價值。
papers.title: Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 機率並不足夠:探索與計數分歧 Token 以量化 LLM 推理不確定性

links.title: AgentBug-Smith: Automatically Reproducing Real-World Harness Bugs in Agentic Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'AgentBug-Smith consistently outperforms existing bug reproduction techniques designed for general software, achieving 10.67% - 27.56% higher success rates of reproducing harness bugs'; benchmark 'currently contains 200 reproducible harness bugs'.
Section 4.1 Table 1: 'AgentBug-Smith achieves ... 95% repository-level accuracy ... 92% issue-level accuracy'; 'The resulting Cohen's kappa is 0.88' over 132 sampled issues with two annotators.
Section 4.2 Table 2: AgentBug-Smith 45/225 (20.00%) with GPT-4.1-mini, 46/225 (20.44%) Kimi-k2.5, 63/225 (28.00%) DeepSeek-v3.2, vs best baseline SWE-Factory 9.33%-13.78%; cost $0.56-$2.44 per issue.
Section 4.2: 'manual inspection of all the 75 successfully-reproduced bugs, showing 74 (98.67%) of them are valid'; overlap analysis: '45 unique bugs that cannot be reproduced by either baseline'.

Section 4.3 Table 3: ablation shows env build 37.33%-41.33% vs baselines <=19.56%, and 'both baselines fail to reproduce any such issues when no in-patch tests are available' (w/o IPT = 0 for baselines, 21-29 for AgentBug-Smith).

Section 4.4 Table 5: mini-SWE-agent best with 19.50% plausibly / 9.00% correctly resolved on Live-Harness-Bench; Table 6: skill distillation raises correct resolution from 1.27% to 7.59% with train/test repo-disjoint split of 121/79 bugs (Appendix I defines feasible-set constraint against memorization).

Section 4.4 Table 4 and Figure 5: benchmark stats (avg repo 123k LoC, avg patch 202.9 lines) and component coverage (31.5% tool registries, 30.5% context/memory); Figure 6: temporal coverage 'as recently as August 2026'.

Reproducibility gap: no explicit code or benchmark release URL appears in the provided text (only 'Its current release contains 200 reproducible harness bugs'); appendices A-H supply filtering rules, judge prompts, matching math, and stability metrics, and baselines 'directly adopt their released implementations' (Sec 4.2).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agents + code-agent paper squarely in scope: automated reproduction of LLM-agent harness bugs, an agent-oriented benchmark (Live-Harness-Bench), evaluation of coding agents, and skill distillation for agent improvement. Strong matches to Agents & Tool Use (2.5), Code & Programming (2.0), and LLM backbone evaluation. Rigor is solid: human-annotated identification accuracy with Cohen's kappa 0.88 (Sec 4.1), three backbone LLMs, two adapted baselines (SWE-Factory, SWE-bench-Live), ablations separating environment construction and test generation (Sec 4.3), manual validation of 74/75 reproductions (Sec 4.2), failure-mode analysis (Appendix G), and a leakage-controlled train/test split for the skill-distillation application (Sec 4.4). Evidence is quantitative but absolute performance is modest (max 28.00% reproduction; agents at most 9.00% correctly resolved), and the skill gain (+6.32%) is small with a single basic distillation pipeline. Novelty is moderate: benchmark-from-GitHub-issues automation is established, contributions are the harness-specific identification, mock-service environment injection, joint test-environment co-refinement, and a live/extensible benchmark. Reproducibility is hurt by no explicit artifact/code release link in the provided text, though detailed appendices (A-K) give rules, prompts, metrics, and a worked case.

primary_link.title: AgentBug-Smith: Automatically Reproducing Real-World Harness Bugs in Agentic Systems

papers.summary: Agent harness bugs exhibit unique characteristics and remain challenging for state-of-the-art software agents to repair. Progress in this area is further hindered by existing benchmarks, which contain only a small and fixed number of executable harness bugs while requiring hundreds of human hours to construct. This work presents AgentBug-Smith, an automated harness bug reproduction approach that continuously discovers and reproduces real-world harness bugs from open-source agentic systems. Acros
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討代理系統中 harness（代理執行框架層）的實作錯誤：此類錯誤源自複雜流程編排與外部資源互動，現有軟體代理難以修復，而唯一可執行基準 AgentIssue-Bench 僅 43 個錯誤、耗時約 150 小時建置，且有訓練資料汙染之虞。作者提出 AgentBug-Smith，以多代理管線串連三階段：(1)持續挖掘開源代理儲存庫並篩選 harness 錯誤相關 issue；(2)自動建構容器化環境，以 mock 服務隔離外部模型呼叫；(3)合成能重現所述失敗的測試，於錯誤版本失敗、修補版本通過，並支援測試與環境聯合最佳化。辨識儲存庫與錯誤 issue 的準確率分別為 95% 與 92%；在 GPT-4.1-mini、Kimi-k2.5 與 DeepSeek-v3.2 上，重現成功率達 20%-28%，較 SWE-Factory 與 SWE-bench-Live 高 10.67-27.56 個百分點；重現案例經人工檢驗 74/75 有效。據此建立的 Live-Harness-Bench 收錄 200 個可重現錯誤；下游實驗顯示主流代理正確修復率最高僅 9.00%，蒸餾技能可將 mini-SWE-agent 的修復率由 1.27% 提升至 7.59%。限制：重現成功率仍不足三成，失敗多源自相依套件安裝、Docker 建置與磁碟耗盡等環境問題，部分失敗模式亦隨骨幹模型而異。本研究將真實代理失敗轉為可執行評估實例與可重用知識，為代理 harness 修復能力的持續評估與改進、邁向遞迴自我改進奠定可擴充的基礎。
