links.title: Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning

evidence: Section 5.2, Table 2: OASIS improves over OPSD by +0.59, +1.86, +3.05 average points at Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B on Avg@12 across AIME 2024/2025/HMMT 2025; OPSD gain over base falls 3.05 -> 1.98 -> 0.14.

Section 3.4, Table 1: gold-context teacher recovers correct answers on 0.77 of failed prefixes vs 0.37 student-alone at 1.7B (Delta=+0.40), shrinking to +0.17 at 4B; verified-prefix gap is only +0.04.
Section 3.5 and Appendix A.1.1, Proposition 1: forward-KL optimum under privileged context is the mixture teacher, with irreducible loss I(A;R|Z).

Appendix A.1.2/A.3, Proposition 2 and Figure 4: per-entry KL clip kappa=0.05 removes 97%/94% of positive KL mass on verified/failed scaffolds and can reverse logit-gradient sign; derivation verified by finite differences.

Section 5.1: 'each reported score is from a single training run evaluated once'; Table 3 gives 3-eval-seed standard deviations (e.g., OASIS AIME25 Avg@12 69.1±0.23 vs OPSD 67.9±1.33) only for one Qwen3-4B checkpoint; Section 5.2 concedes the 1.7B gap is within sampling variation on 30 problems.
Appendix A.4, Tables 7-8: ablations show shortest verified scaffold (54.17 Avg@12) beats longest (52.33), and K=8 (54.17) beats K=4 (52.77) at 1.7B on AIME24.
Appendix A.5, Table 9 and Algorithm 1: full training config (LoRA r64/alpha128, lr 5e-6, kappa=0.05, T=1.1, 2xH100+8xA100) disclosed; no explicit code or data release claimed.
Section 6 (Conclusion): limitations stated—competition mathematics only, one model family, higher generation cost (51.2K rollouts vs 12.8K in Table 4), single runs at 4B/8B.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: diagnoses why on-policy self-distillation for LLM reasoning degrades with scale and proposes OASIS, which supervises only outcome-verified on-policy scaffolds using self-generated teacher context, requiring only final-answer labels. Strongly aligned with top-weighted preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, training/distillation, scaling). Novelty is solid but incremental: scaffold/context factorization, the privileged-information imitation gap (Prop. 1), and the KL-clipping sign-reversal analysis (Prop. 2) are clean contributions, yet the method is a targeted modification of OPSD and close to concurrent dissection work (Shen et al., Ichihara et al.) and to rejection-sampling/STaR ideas. Rigor is good: factorial probes with bootstrap intervals, two propositions with proofs, three model scales, baselines (SFT, GRPO, OPSD, AVSD, CRISP), and ablations (scaffold rule, K). Evidence is tempered by single training runs at 4B/8B, small eval sets (30-problem AIME), the 1.7B OASIS-OPSD gap being within sampling noise by the authors' own admission (Section 5.2), and one model family/domain. Generalizability is explicitly limited to verifiable-answer math. Reproducibility benefits from full hyperparameters (Table 9), Algorithm 1, and probe protocols, but no code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning

papers.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student to match a privileged teacher distribution along its own sampled trajectory. Standard OPSD applies this supervision to unverified student rollouts while conditioning the teacher on privileged context, typically a reference solution. We separate these roles in a factorial analysis and find that scaffold correctness has a stronger effect on downstream accuracy than context correctness. Unverified scaffolds create an imitation gap because the teac
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討 on-policy self-distillation（OPSD）在 LLM 數學推理訓練上的規模瓶頸。OPSD 讓同一模型同時扮演學生與教師：學生僅依題目取樣解答，教師則額外獲得參考解答等特權上下文，並在學生軌跡的每個前綴提供 token 級監督。作者以因子式分析拆解兩個被混淆的角色——決定監督位置的 scaffold 與決定教師目標分佈的 context——並以訊號重播與截斷續寫探針進行診斷。結果顯示教師的優勢集中在失敗軌跡（1.7B 時答對率 77% 對 37%），在已驗證軌跡上卻幾乎消失（99% 對 95%）；但 OPSD 約七成更新仍落在未驗證軌跡，形成無法消除的模仿落差，且此優勢隨模型規模擴大而遞減，使 OPSD 增益由 1.7B 的 3.05 點降至 8B 的 0.14 點；per-entry KL clipping 更會反轉梯度方向、加劇後期偏離教師。據此，作者提出 OASIS：保留 OPSD 目標，對每題取樣 K 條 rollout 並以最終答案驗證，選最短的正確軌跡作為 scaffold，改用另一條同題 rollout（通常為學生未驗證的嘗試）作為教師上下文，因此只需最終答案標籤、不需書面解答。在 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 與 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT 2025 上，OASIS 較基礎模型分別提升 3.64、3.84、3.19 點，並超越 OPSD 0.59、1.86、3.05 點，亦優於 SFT、GRPO 等基線。代價是生成成本上升（K=8 rollouts）。限制為僅涵蓋競賽數學與單一模型家族，且 4B 與 8B 僅有單次訓練結果。本研究指出特權自我蒸餾的成效取決於教師訊號能否由學生可觀測的資訊重現，對只有可驗證答案的資料集極具實用價值。
papers.title: Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 突破 LLM 推理中 On-Policy 自我蒸餾的規模極限

links.title: Effective Dense Retrieval using Only In-Context Examples

evidence: Abstract: RICE is described as a training-free approach extracting high-quality dense representations from LLMs conditioned on few in-context examples, with code released at github.com/nourj98/RICE.

Section 3 (Implementation): uses Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B with thinking disabled, 10 in-context examples, vLLM/FAISS/Pyserini, and replaces any test-set exemplar in-place so RICE is never exposed to a test judgment during encoding.

Table 1: RICE average Recall@100 is .539 (Qwen3-8B) and .558 (Qwen3.5-9B) vs PromptReps-Dense .503/.534; RICE (Zero-Shot) at .522 (Qwen3.5-9B) isolates the effect of in-context examples from prompt wording; supervised upper bounds reach .578-.645.

Section 4: text claims a 1.6-point improvement over LLM2Vec-Gen using Qwen3.5-9B, but Table 1 only lists LLM2Vec-Gen with the Qwen3-8B backbone (.542), making this comparison cross-backbone rather than matched.

Section 5 (Table 3): relevant, non-relevant, mixed, and random same-corpus exemplar pairs all outperform None (.343-.346 vs .305 on NFCorpus) while relevant cross-corpus pairs (.312) do not, supporting a domain-language-over-relevance hypothesis.

Section 5 (Table 4): shuffled or blank representative words barely change effectiveness (.355/.343 NFCorpus vs .343 original) while ten distinct unrelated words collapse it (.268 NFCorpus, .697 SciFact).
Section 5 (Table 2): dynamic BM25-based exemplar selection helps query-side encoding (NFCorpus .360 vs .343 fixed) but hurts when applied to documents (.333).

Section 4 (Limitations acknowledged): RICE lags fine-tuned retrievers (Qwen3-Embedding-8B .645 avg) and is positioned as a middle ground between training-free and trained systems; only Recall@100 is reported as the metric (Section 3, Datasets).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: training-free dense retrieval from decoder-only LLMs via in-context examples, squarely matching LLM, prompting/ICL, and RAG/retrieval preferences. Method is an incremental extension of PromptReps (add few-shot exemplars to the encoding prompt), but the paper earns credit with a prompt-wording control (RICE Zero-Shot, Table 1), 10 BEIR datasets, trained upper bounds, and four ablations. The most interesting finding—that same-corpus language matters more than relevance-label accuracy (Tables 3-4, cross-corpus .312 vs in-corpus .343-.346 on NFCorpus)—echoes Min et al. (2022) in a new embedding setting. Weaknesses: single metric (Recall@100 only, no nDCG), no significance testing or variance, ablations limited to 2-3 datasets, one model family, and a cross-backbone comparison where Section 4 claims a 1.6-point gain over LLM2Vec-Gen with Qwen3.5-9B although Table 1 lists LLM2Vec-Gen only with Qwen3-8B. Main empirical claims are well supported by the tables; reproducibility is strong with released code, full prompt templates (Figure 2), and explicit leakage handling (Section 3).

primary_link.title: Effective Dense Retrieval using Only In-Context Examples

In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can instead be prompted to produce effective representations for dense retrieval given only a few in-context examples. papers.summary_zh: 如何將 decoder-only 大型語言模型(LLM)變成強大的稠密檢索器,通常需要額外的檢索器訓練。本文探討:能否僅憑少量 in-context 範例,以提示方式讓 LLM 產生有效的檢索表徵?作者提出 RICE,一種免訓練方法:延續 PromptReps 的做法,請 LLM 為查詢或文件生成一個代表性單字並擷取其最終隱藏狀態作為向量;關鍵差異在於,RICE 先以少量人工標註的查詢—文件配對(搭配 PromptReps 生成的代表詞)作為示範,為查詢與文件編碼建立共享脈絡,使兩者內積更能反映相關性。實驗在 BEIR 的 10 個資料集上以 Recall@100 評估,使用 Qwen3-8B 與 Qwen3.5-9B 各 10 個範例。RICE 分別較 PromptReps-Dense 提升 3.6 與 2.4 點,平均優於 HyDE、PRF-Umbrela、CSQE 等免訓練方法,並與自監督式訓練的 LLM2Vec-Gen 相當;但仍落後於以大量高品質資料訓練的 BGE-base-en-v1.5 與 Qwen3-Embedding-8B。分析顯示範例越多通常越好,但到 20 個時可能開始下滑;查詢端動態選例可再提升效果。消融實驗進一步發現,範例效益主要來自任務與領域特定的語言,而非標註準確性:打亂或清空代表詞影響不大,無關的隨機單字則會嚴重損害效果,跨語料庫的相關範例也不如同語料庫的非相關範例。整體而言,RICE 展示了免訓練、易於適應新任務與新領域的 LLM 稠密檢索路徑,有助縮小免訓練方法與監督式檢索器之間的差距。

evidence: Abstract & Section 4.3.3 (Fig. 6b): under oracle knowledge (MRR 0.93-0.95 per Section 4.3.2), mean pairwise accuracy is only 0.51 with best detector Qwen3.6-27B at 0.73, establishing detection as the bottleneck.

Section 4.2 (Table 2): unified PrimeVul Paired benchmark gives Vul-RAG the highest mean pairwise accuracy (0.20 intersection / 0.21 top-5) vs. GRACE 0.03 and SVD-Bench/Llama-VD 0.08; reported SOTA (VulTriage 0.34 with GPT-4o) does not transfer.

Section 4.1 (Fig. 3, Table 6): reproducibility varies substantially - SVD-Bench recall deviation 58.2% on Python (not reproducible), Llama-VD within ~1%, Vul-RAG <=2.5%, LLM4Vuln not reproducible under open-weight substitution.
Section 3.4 & Appendix B (Table 5): model pool of 22 open-weight models from 7 families spanning ~3B-32B with full Hugging Face checkpoints listed.

Section 1 & Section 3.5: public replication package (github.com/hs-esslingen-it-security/RAG4SVD) with documented parser hardening and model substitutions; only remote dependency is GPT-oss-120B judge via Blablador.
Table 3: inter-judge agreement alpha 0.16-0.63 with MAD up to ~1.0; authors acknowledge high judge sensitivity in RQ3 abstraction scoring.

Section 5 & Appendix A (Table 4): component analysis limited to Vul-RAG and LLM4Vuln with sampled test probes of 46 and 42 vulnerable functions; authors note small differences may reflect sampling noise.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM/RAG methodology study: reproduces six open-source RAG-based vulnerability detection systems under open-weight inference, runs a unified PrimeVul Paired benchmark with 22 open-weight models (7 families, 3B-32B), and adds a component-level decomposition (input abstraction, knowledge retrieval, detection). Rigor is high: 3-run reproductions with deviation thresholds (Nong et al.), 95% parseability gating, oracle upper bounds, judge-sensitivity analysis (Krippendorff's alpha, MAD), and a thorough threats-to-validity section. Evidence is concrete (reproduction deviations, retrieval Hit@k/MRR, oracle detection ceilings) but bounded: component analysis covers only two pipelines using small sampled probes (~46/42 vulnerable functions) and abstraction-quality claims rest on judges with low agreement (alpha 0.16-0.63). Novelty is moderate: the paper extends the authors' prior single-system Vul-RAG reproducibility work and prior component-wise SE studies (Ke et al.) to a joint reproducibility+benchmark+attribution protocol; the 'Retrieval Utility' judge dimension and oracle-does-not-solve-detection finding are the most original results. Generalizability is explicitly limited to the six artifact-complete systems, PrimeVul-family data, and open-weight scales. A public replication package with model checkpoints and documented adaptations supports reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Retrieve, Reproduce, Reveal: Dissecting Retrieval-Augmented Software Vulnerability Detection

papers.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly used to enhance Large Language Model (LLM)-based software vulnerability detection by grounding predictions in retrieved vulnerability knowledge, such as vulnerability reports. However, existing RAG-based software vulnerability detection (RAG4SVD) systems are often evaluated using proprietary models, which challenges open science and reproducibility. Further, studies use different datasets, custom knowledge bases, different backbone models, and
papers.summary_zh: 本文聚焦以檢索增強生成(RAG)輔助大型語言模型進行軟體漏洞偵測(RAG4SVD),指出現有研究存在三大缺口:結果鮮少被獨立重現、各系統的資料集與指標各異而難以比較、僅做端對端評估而無法歸因成效來源。作者在開放權重環境重現六個系統(SVD-Bench、Llama-VD、GRACE、LLM4Vuln、Vul-RAG、VulTriage)的原始結果,再以 PrimeVul Paired 資料集、共同指標與 22 個 3B–32B 開放權重模型進行統一基準評比,並將代表性管線拆解為輸入抽象、知識檢索與偵測三階段,做元件級分析。結果顯示重現性差異甚大:Llama-VD 與 Vul-RAG 偏差多低於 1%,SVD-Bench 逾 5%,LLM4Vuln 因依賴專有模型而無法在開放權重設定下重現。統一基準下 Vul-RAG 成對準確率最高(平均約 0.20–0.21),原始 SOTA 排名無法轉移,且效能強烈取決於骨幹模型與輸出格式的可解析性。元件分析進一步顯示,抽象品質主要由系統摘要提示決定;檢索成效取決於知識庫與目標分布的對齊;即使在保證含正解知識的 oracle 條件下,檢索 MRR 達 0.93–0.95,平均成對準確率仍僅 0.51(最佳 0.73),可見正確運用檢索知識才是瓶頸。研究限制在於僅涵蓋六個系統、採抽樣探針,並以 CWE 一致性近似檢索相關性。本文貢獻在於提出元件感知的標準化 RAG 評估做法,主張未來進展應來自管線各階段的介面對齊,而非單純擴大模型或知識庫規模。

Appendix C.3, Table 8: GradDiff four-field primary shows Projected Causal leads DIR-R by mean J 7.104583 with 4/0/8 W/T/L, and several static baselines rank ahead

Appendix C.4, Table 12: three-field replication on new seeds reverses the near-tie (Projected Causal +0.861389, same 4/0/5 W/T/L); DIR-R captures only 5.45% of available candidate-set gain in the replication

Reproducibility Statement plus Appendix B/C: calibration equations, frozen seeds (e.g., final 4099/8191/16381, calibration 73/311/997), complete audited tables, and an anonymized supplementary code package organized by table
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper (localized LLM unlearning across Llama 3, Gemma 2, Qwen2.5, OLMo) touching LLM (2.5), AI safety/privacy (2.0), interpretability/localization (1.8), and training/optimization (1.5) preferences. Novelty is moderate: the central finding that accurate localization does not predict the better intervention extends known results (Hase et al. 2023 for editing; Lee et al. 2025 for unlearning), while the objective-conditioned Intervention Score and gated checkpoint re-ranking (DIR-R) are reasonably new but incremental. Rigor is unusually high: frozen baselines and thresholds, an audited appendix, LOO ranges, W/T/L, and candid boundary reporting (composed Natural-TOFU margins are explicitly non-paired; the GradDiff four-field primary is unfavorable). Evidence strength is mixed: the controlled separation experiment (AUROC 0.981 but only 17/36 agreement, LoRA 35/36) and six direct LACUNA NPO/SimNPO comparisons (+0.431 to +0.848, +0.503 to +0.571) are solid, but DIR-R gains are tiny (median +0.0025), the replication captures only 5.45% of available gain and reverses orderings, and Projected Causal leads the GradDiff primary by 7.10. Generalizability is limited by a single MLP down-projection column geometry, synthetic/PII-only benchmarks, one checkpoint, and acknowledged field/seed sensitivity. Reproducibility is strong: full algorithm, calibration equations, seeds, and an anonymized code package.

papers.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 機器遺忘的參數定位問題。現行局部化遺忘方法多先以定位訊號挑出與遺忘目標相關的少量參數，再固定該子集進行最佳化。作者以受控實驗證明兩者並不等價：在 Qwen2.5-7B 以已知介面注入合成事實時，儲存定位分數的 AUROC 高達 0.981，卻僅在 36 個目標中的 17 個預測出較佳介入點，而 LoRA 介面贏得其中 35 個。論文據此提出 Intervention Score，以一階診斷衡量各可編輯群組（MLP down-projection 欄位）對實際遺忘更新的預期效應，獎勵遺忘、懲罰副作用與非特異性變動，據此選出初始子集（Static-IV）；再提出選擇性 DIR-R，僅當檢查點的短探測訊號超過校準閾值時，才在凍結候選族內執行完整延續比較，否則沿用原子集。Natural-TOFU（Llama 3 8B、Gemma 2 2B）上對十種基線有 19/20 正向敘述性差距；LACUNA（OLMo 3 7B）六項 NPO/SimNPO 比較全數領先，NPO 差距 +0.431 至 +0.848。GradDiff 則顯示明顯欄位異質性，四欄位主評估中若干靜態方法仍領先；但相對 Static-IV，DIR-R 於六個評估集皆為正向，約以 1.45× 運算捕捉 29.1%–58.3% 可得增益。限制包括 Natural-TOFU 差距混合不同評估集、外部排序對種子敏感，且搜尋僅限凍結候選族。本文價值在於將定位、初始介入選擇與依檢查點調整支援集區分為三個可獨立檢驗的設計與評估問題。

links.title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing

evidence: Abstract: uses about 33-41% of available training feedback, reduces break-even deployment volume by ~1.9-9.5x vs fastest conventional router, code at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/SaveRouter
Section 5.1: four benchmarks (LLMRouterBench, Mixinstruct, MMR-Bench, RouterBench) with 10 baselines inside the ORBIT toolkit; WISERouter, BaRP, and SemiRouter are paper-derived reimplementations
Table 1: SaveRouter achieves highest Ps and lowest CR on all four benchmarks; SA-BEP 5.3K vs 11.5K fastest baseline on LLMRouterBench and 42.6K vs 326.4K on RouterBench

Section 5.3 / Table 2: estimator ablations (w/o Query Residual drops Ps 0.6338->0.6175, CR 0.2320->0.3484) and acquisition ablations (Random-K reaches earlier SA-BEP 3.8K but lower Ps and worse SA-CR@1M)
Appendix E.7 / Table A13: cached-feedback sensitivity reduces BaRP SA-BEP by ~7.3-11.1x, yet SaveRouter still breaks even earlier on all four benchmarks
Appendix A: explicit cost-accounting protocol defining C0, fresh vs cached feedback, and the caveat that costs are not comparable across benchmarks
Appendix C, Tables A1-A3: complete hyperparameters, grouping configurations, per-benchmark statistics, and acquisition seeds (42+1009p), supporting reproducibility
Section 5.4 / Figure 3: non-monotonic performance in supervision budget is reported honestly; error bars shown only for Random-K, main split is single seed 42
Appendix E.2 / Table A6: on RouterEval SaveRouter attains best Ps (0.8056) and reduces SA-BEP ~55.2% vs TRouter, but SA-CR@1M remains 1.1943 (above 1)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work: sparse-supervision LLM routing that jointly accounts for upfront feedback-acquisition cost and serving-time savings, with new metrics (SA-BEP, SA-CR). Strong preference fit (LLMs, inference/serving, efficiency; UCB/bandit-style acquisition). Novelty is moderate: the economic framing and metrics are fresh, but the machinery (UCB acquisition, two-way ridge prior, shrinkage, residual ridge predictor) is classical and sparse/partial-feedback routing baselines already exist. Rigor and evidence are above average: four benchmarks plus RouterEval, ten baselines, estimator/acquisition ablations, budget sweeps, quality-target sweeps, caching sensitivity, and model-pool expansion; headline claims (33-41% supervision, 1.9-9.5x earlier break-even) are verifiable from Tables 1 and A5. Weaknesses: single seed-42 split for main results, author-run reimplementations of WISERouter/BaRP/SemiRouter, fresh-feedback accounting choice that inflates BaRP (partially mitigated by Appendix E.7), benchmark-specific cost units limiting absolute comparability, and SA-CR@1M still above 1 on RouterEval/Mixinstruct. Reproducibility is strong: public code, full hyperparameters, grouping configs, and seeds in Appendix C.

primary_link.title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) routing reduces serving cost by assigning each query to an appropriate model while preserving response quality. Learning such a router, however, often requires executing multiple candidate models on historical queries to collect query--model quality feedback, creating a nontrivial supervision cost before deployment. Existing work largely focuses on serving-time efficiency, overlooking whether the resulting savings are sufficient to recover this upfront expenditure. We
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）路由可依查詢分配合適模型以降低推論成本，但訓練路由器通常需在歷史查詢上執行多個候選模型蒐集品質回饋，產生部署前的監督成本。現有研究多半只關注服務階段效率，忽略這筆前期支出能否被後續節省回收；論文並觀察到路由品質在收集完整回饋前即趨飽和，稠密監督在經濟上明顯過度供給。作者提出 SaveRouter：先將查詢分組，依能力估計與不確定性（UCB）自適應挑選少量查詢—模型配對取得回饋；再以雙向可加模型建立群組—模型先驗，結合局部證據收縮估計，並以輕量殘差預測器捕捉查詢層級差異，最後進行成本感知路由；同時提出 SA-BEP（監督攤銷損益兩平點）與 SA-CR（攤銷成本比）指標。在 LLMRouterBench、Mixinstruct、MMR-Bench 與 RouterBench 四項基準上，SaveRouter 僅使用約 33–41% 的可用訓練回饋即維持同等或更佳的路由品質，相較最快的傳統監督式路由器將回本部署量縮短約 1.9–9.5 倍，也優於 BaRP、WISERouter 等稀疏回饋方法。限制方面：效能對監督預算 K 並非單調遞增，增加監督未必更早回本或降低攤銷成本；各基準成本尺度不同，指標不宜跨資料集比較；路由器訓練本身成本未計入。本文提醒經濟的 LLM 路由不能只看服務成本，監督本身是稀缺資源，應以「決策充分性」取代「資訊完整性」。

Appendix D: judge-free Telecom probe finds 54 missed gold writes among 658 trajectories, 23 of which pass every applicable criterion; adding it changes Telecom UFS by .009-.070 without changing ranking

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: an agentic-benchmark evaluation paper measuring LLM user simulators against their stated contracts, with frozen-agent controlled experiments, tool-call analysis, and implications for multi-turn RL. The angle—scoring user-proxy fidelity to the benchmark's own user specification rather than human realism—is a genuine complement to prior simulator-reliability work, supported by a large rubric set (2,141 criteria), a judge-free gold-action probe, cost-fidelity frontier, and unusually candid limitations. Main weaknesses: UFS is LLM-judged by the same model that generated the rubrics (generator=grader, Claude Opus 4.8), the manual audit is single-rater, non-blinded, and tiny (10 tasks + 50 judgments), one rollout per task with no variance estimates or confidence intervals, no second frozen agent, and no explicit code/data release despite deterministic-regeneration claims. Scoped to one benchmark family and one agent, limiting generalizability; judged numbers without human agreement statistics cap evidence strength.

primary_link.title: UserProxyBench: Evaluating LLM User Simulators for Agent Benchmarks and Training

papers.summary: Interactive agent benchmarks and multi-turn reinforcement learning increasingly place a second language model in the role of the user. This simulated user controls what information the agent receives and when, yet current benchmarks score only the agent and do not directly measure whether the user correctly executed its assigned role. We introduce UserProxyBench, an evaluation layer over the tau-bench family, and the User Fidelity Score (UFS), which measures adherence to the benchmark's private
papers.summary_zh: 互動式代理人基準（如 τ-bench）與多輪強化學習日漸將另一個語言模型置於使用者角色，由其控制代理人可取得哪些資訊及其時機；但現有基準只評分代理人，並未檢驗使用者模擬器是否確實執行被指派的角色。本文提出 UserProxyBench，作為 τ-bench 系列之上的評估層，並定義使用者忠實度分數（UFS）：由每個任務的私人使用者藍圖產生可證偽的評分準則，獨立於代理人成敗計分，涵蓋資訊有據（groundedness）、過早揭露、目標偏離與遺漏資訊四大失敗類別。實驗在四個企業領域共 375 個任務上，固定代理人為 GPT-5.5、僅替換七種使用者代理（user proxy）模型：平均任務獎勵變動達 15.2 點；成功回合中有 24.4% 存在使用者規範違反。最常見的失敗「過早揭露」對任務獎勵幾乎無感（平均僅 −.043），卻使成功的代理人平均少執行 1.06 次工具呼叫，代表被評估或被強化的互動本質已改變。研究進一步繪出成本–忠實度前沿，供實務者選出符合所需忠實度的最低成本模擬器，如 q=.84 時為 Gemma-31B。限制包括：UFS 評審與準則產生者為同一模型（Claude Opus 4.8）、人工稽核規模小且僅單一評分者、每任務僅一次 rollout、伺服器定價具時效性，且未量測對下游訓練策略的影響。此工作說明任務獎勵無法取代使用者側的忠實度評估，對互動式評測與多輪 RL 訓練的可信度極為關鍵。

Section 3.5: Direct Control Agent 'uses the same workers and the same interfaces for delegation, context selection, artifact writing, and stopping,' isolating the control design, though the paper concedes it 'does not separately identify the effects of staging, state compression, or memory access.'

Appendix A (Scope of the Evidence): 'Stage-removal, state-only, and memory-interface ablations would be required to determine which mechanisms matter'; also states point estimates 'do not establish significance' and IMO ProofBench-Advanced has only 30 problems.

Section 6.4: controller verdict Type-2 AUC of 0.88 vs worker confidence 0.55 (Gemini 3.1 Pro, IMO ProofBench-Advanced), supporting the monitoring claim; but frontier selection gains are 'not uniform across models.'
Section 6.2: 'Meta-reasoning does not win at every budget' — trails direct control 56.6% vs 62.7% at 400 calls with Opus 4.8; Sec 7.3 reports underperformance on the LongCoT chess subset.

Appendices B-D and F provide verbatim stage prompts, worker prompts, and tool schemas for both agents, enabling reimplementation, but no code or artifact release statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-inference paper: an explicit controller (Assess/Propose/Evaluate/Dispatch) over persistent artifact memory separates control from object-level work in LLM agents, directly matching high-weight preferences (agents, reasoning/CoT, code agents, long-context memory). Main strength is the matched Direct Control Agent using identical workers, interfaces, and call budgets (Sec 3.5, Table 1), plus informative coverage/selection decomposition and Type-2 AUC monitoring diagnostics (Sec 4, 6.4). Weaknesses: novelty is incremental over known orchestration/memory/metacognition lines the paper itself cites (MemGPT, GPTSwarm, harness optimizers, Large Language Monkeys); no component ablations (acknowledged in Appendix A), no significance testing on 12 point estimates including a 0.4-point gain, only 30 IMO problems, no token/FLOP matching, frontier-model-only scope, and a confirmed failure mode on chess (Sec 7.3) and at small budgets (Sec 6.2). Prompts, tool schemas, and baseline modifications are documented verbatim (Appendices B-I), but no code/artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning

papers.summary: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next option
papers.summary_zh: 隨著 AI 代理承接越來越長的任務,決定下一步做什麼的控制判斷本身已成為一項工作。現有代理多半將控制決策與物件層級工作交錯進行,效能難以隨運算資源擴充。本文提出「代理式後設推理」,一個推論時的 harness:工作者負責任務本身的運算,控制器則在每個控制週期依序執行 Assess(盤點進度)、Propose(提出候選行動)、Evaluate(在剩餘預算下衡量各選項價值)與 Dispatch(派發工作)四個階段;產出以工件(artifact)存入持久記憶,控制器僅維護精簡狀態而非重播完整歷史,所有模型呼叫計入同一預算。在 IMO ProofBench-Advanced、ARC-AGI-2、LongCoT-mini 與 ProgramBench 四項基準、三個前沿模型上,後設推理在全部 12 組配對比較中皆優於直接控制代理;ProgramBench 搭配 GPT-5.5 達 71.5%,明顯高於 Codex 的 58.0%,效能亦隨預算持續提升,而直接控制多半停滯。產物圖分析顯示更多重用先前成果、正確解覆蓋率提升,控制器對候選品質的判斷(Type-2 AUC 最高 0.88)亦優於工作者自我信心。限制包括:階段式控制有額外開銷,小預算時反而落後;錯誤的控制器評估可能傳播誤導狀態或捨棄良好進展;西洋棋子集中因過度重新考慮而損害已正確的答案;效益亦隨模型而異。此研究顯示「指揮長程任務」本身即是可分離測量與改進的代理能力;當可用運算越充裕,把運算花在結構化控制上就越重要。
papers.title: Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 先思考,再思考:透過後設推理擴展代理式推論

links.title: TabFM-Auto: Self-Evolving Pipelines for Tabular Foundation Models

evidence: Abstract: five TabFM-Auto configurations take the top five positions across all 51 TabArena datasets; best raises TabFM from 1785 to 2013 Elo and transfers to other frozen TFMs (+69 to +143 Elo)

Table 2 (Section 4.1 ablation): unconstrained coding agent (AGY + Gemini 3.8 Flash, same 6h budget) reaches 1468.8 Elo vs 1979.6 for TabFM-Auto; text decomposes gains as +316.5 Elo from TabFM's pretrained prior and +194.3 from pipeline search
Section 4.1 'Validation-to-Test Generalization': mean official test error falls 4.0%-4.7% from P0 to full budget; both configs exceed TabFM+ (1856 Elo) within the first 2.5% of search

Appendix A 'Operating-System Sandboxing and Split Isolation' and 'Row-Order Permutation': bubblewrap namespace sandbox disables network, unmounts held-out test splits, and deterministically shuffles classification folds to prevent index leakage

Appendix B.1 'Fold-0 held-out evaluation': on the split sharing no rows with the search split, TabFM-Auto (Codex, Opus 5) still ranks #1 at 1950.7 overall Elo, and pairwise win rates are similar on fold 0 (91.1%-95.7%) vs later folds (94.4%-95.9%)

Section 4.2 / Appendix D.1: on MLE-Bench-Tabular, Claude Code with Opus 5 ranks first at 1827 Elo with 86.7% graded-match win rate across 12 external agents, with per-competition detail (e.g., volcanic-eruptions MAE 97,355 vs PiEvolve 0.92M)
Table 3 and Appendix B.1: token/tool accounting across five configurations (1.28B-12.13B prompt tokens; ~$17.6K API cost), supporting evaluation-cost transparency

Section 5 limitations: 'Gains are generally smaller on anonymized tables' and 'pipeline search requires repeated validation evaluations'; Table 6 shows Cat. II (generic schemas) mean reductions of 2.31%-3.87% vs 7.25%-8.85% for informative schemas

Reproducibility gap: the document provides the identity-pipeline template (Appendix Figure 8) and protocol but states no code, prompt, or checkpoint release; TabFM is cited to a Google Research Blog (Kong et al., 2026) and agents use proprietary frontier models
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM-agent preferences: the method's core is LLM coding agents (Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.8 Flash via Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity harnesses) searching executable data pipelines around a frozen tabular foundation model, fitting 'Agents & Tool Use' (MLE/coding agents, sandboxed tool use) and LLM keywords, though it applies rather than advances LLM methodology. Novelty is moderate: LLM feature engineering (CAAFE, FeatLLM) and retraining-based MLE agents (AIDE, R&D-Agent) exist; the frozen-model/no-retraining-noise search design and cross-TFM pipeline transfer are the new twists. Rigor is strong: 51 TabArena datasets, bootstrap Elo with CIs, an unconstrained-agent ablation decomposing gains (+316.5 from frozen TabFM, +194.3 from search), validation-to-test checkpoint analysis, and disclosed protocol caveats (search on fold 0 train, transductive features, row-order permutation); deducted for single search run per dataset (agent variance unquantified) and unequal-budget MLE-Bench comparisons. Evidence is extensive and specific (per-dataset Table 9, token/cost accounting ~$17.6K). Generalizability is supported by pipeline transfer (+68.8 to +143.3 Elo to TabICLv2/TabPFN-3/EXAONE-Tabular) but shrinks on anonymized schemas and depends on proprietary frontier LLMs. Reproducibility is limited: no code/prompt release stated, proprietary models and a blog-cited TabFM checkpoint.

primary_link.title: TabFM-Auto: Self-Evolving Pipelines for Tabular Foundation Models

papers.summary: Tabular foundation models achieve strong zero-shot accuracy on structured data by pretraining on synthetic tables, but they ignore the column names, task descriptions, and auxiliary files that carry dataset semantics. Meanwhile, self-evolving machine learning engineering (MLE) agents train models from scratch on each dataset, yet jointly searching over features, architectures, and hyperparameters is noisy and prone to overfitting. We introduce TabFM-Auto, which pairs a tabular foundation model,
papers.summary_zh: 表格基礎模型(Tabular Foundation Models)如 TabPFN、TabFM 雖能在結構化資料上以零樣本方式達到高準確率,卻忽略欄位名稱、任務描述與輔助檔案所蘊含的領域語意;另一方面,現有的機器學習工程(MLE)代理從零訓練模型,同時搜尋特徵、架構與超參數,雜訊大且易過度擬合驗證集。TabFM-Auto 將凍結的 TabFM 與 LLM 編碼代理配對:代理在沙箱中依資料集詮釋資料與三折交叉驗證回饋,反覆改寫資料清理、特徵工程、上下文選擇與後處理等管線程式,模型權重完全不動,因此候選管線評估快速且不受重訓雜訊干擾。在 TabArena 全部 51 個資料集上,五種組態包辦總榜前五名,最佳組態(Codex 搭配 Claude Opus 5)將 TabFM 由 1785.3 提升至 2013.0 Elo;所得管線無需再搜尋即可遷移至 TabICLv2、TabPFN-3 等其他凍結模型(增益 +68.8 至 +143.3 Elo),並在 MLE-Bench 八項表格競賽中總體排名第一。分析顯示,在欄位語意明確的 17 個資料集上,代理寫出 Strouhal 數、ICD-9 器官分章等領域公式,誤差降幅遠大於匿名化表格上的統計特徵。限制包括:匿名化表格增益較小,且每個資料集需反覆進行驗證評估,搜尋成本可觀。本研究證明 LLM 的領域推理能力與表格基礎模型的快速前向推論互補,為結構感知預訓練與可複用管線庫指出未來方向。
papers.title: TabFM-Auto: Self-Evolving Pipelines for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.title_zh: TabFM-Auto:表格基礎模型的自演化資料管線

links.title: ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context

evidence: Abstract: ContextRender outperforms evaluated baselines at a 6K history budget, 'reducing mean inference cost by 10.2%-32.2% relative to Full history'.

Section 4.1: evaluation on AppWorld (all 168 Test-Normal and 417 Test-Challenge tasks) and 8-objective QA (100 tasks) against five budgeted baselines (Prune, Compact LLM, Recency+Summary, Semantic Retrieval, ACON) plus Full history.

Section 4.2 and Appendix B.1: three execution models (GPT-4.1, Muse Glimmer 30B, DeepSeek V4 Pro); 'Each method is executed once per task' with temperature 0.0 and seed 42; no variance estimates or significance tests are reported.

Table 1 / Table 6: ContextRender is below Full history in two of nine settings (AppWorld Normal GPT-4.1 -2.3%, AppWorld Challenge DeepSeek -0.9%), and the reuse ablation gain is 4.1% relative TGC / 4.5% relative F1 (Section 4.4, Table 2).

Appendix A.2: TFA extraction uses pattern '[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.\-]{4,}' with exact case-sensitive whole-token matching; the paper states it 'does not establish a dependency on the particular value needed by an upcoming operation'.
Appendix D (Table 9): runtime adapters demonstrated for five runtimes (opencode, AppWorld ReAct, ACON UnifiedAgent, OpenClaw, Meta ARE default agent).

No code, dataset, or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the paper; implementation is in the Jac language (Section 3.4), and evaluation depends on proprietary APIs (gpt-4.1, text-embedding-3-small).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic for the stated preferences: a systems method for LLM agent context management on long-horizon tool-use tasks (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, Long Context & Memory 1.8, LLMs 2.5, Inference & Serving 1.5). Novelty is moderate: the 'observed reuse' signal from Tool-Flow Analysis is a genuinely new selection signal versus recency/relevance/compaction baselines (ACE, PACE, Sculptor, ACON), but the mechanism is a heuristic regex value extraction with exact case-sensitive matching combined linearly with recency and embedding relevance. Evaluation is solid: two benchmarks (AppWorld 168+417 tasks, 8-objective QA 100 tasks), three execution models, five budgeted baselines plus full-history reference, signal ablations, budget sweep, and unusually careful cost accounting with honest protocol appendices. Weaknesses: single run per task (temperature 0, seed 42) with no variance or significance testing, gains over Full history are sometimes small or negative (e.g., -2.3% and -0.9% TGC in two of nine settings, Table 1), the ablation gain from reuse is modest (+4.1% relative TGC), and the recall metric is an acknowledged lexical proxy that 'does not establish causal dependency' (Appendix B.4). Hyperparameters (lambda=0.3, gamma=0.2, equal weights) are fixed without tuning or sensitivity analysis. Generalizability is decent (five runtime adapters, three models) but the identifier-based matching relies on information locality and may not transfer to paraphrased reuse or non-English/value-poor domains. No code or artifact release is stated, and the Jac implementation is niche, limiting reproducibility despite detailed appendices.

primary_link.title: ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context

papers.summary: LLM agents performing long-horizon tasks accumulate tool results that later steps may need. Passing the full history to every invocation is costly even when it fits within the context window, while reducing it risks omitting needed information. Existing context management methods can overlook how earlier tool results are used in subsequent execution, leaving needed information out of context. We introduce ContextRender, which manages context through a persistent graph of execution dependencies.
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理執行長程任務時，互動歷史隨工具呼叫不斷累積，完整傳遞推論成本高，而修剪、壓縮或摘要等縮減方法可能漏掉後續步驟仍需要的早期工具結果，如 Venmo 分帳任務中早先查得的聯絡人資訊。作者提出 ContextRender，以持久化上下文圖保存訊息、工具呼叫與完整工具結果，並透過 Tool-Flow Analysis（TFA）追蹤後續操作如何重用早期結果導入的值，記為 observed reuse；渲染器結合 observed reuse、新近度與語意相關性，在固定 6K 歷史預算內選出完整工具結果，未入選者保留於圖中供之後重新選用。實驗以 GPT-4.1 等三個執行模型在 AppWorld 與 8-objective QA 顯示，ContextRender 在九種設定中任務表現皆優於五種基線，其中七種接近或超越 Full history，平均推論成本較 Full history 降低 10.2%–32.2%；消融實驗顯示 observed reuse 能提升任務表現與重用結果的召回率，對逾 25 輪才被重用的結果效益最明顯。限制在於 TFA 採精確、區分大小寫的匹配，僅為啟發式訊號而非因果依賴，且在 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的 AppWorld Challenge 略遜於 Full history。此工作顯示，追蹤執行相依性能在低預算下兼顧效能與成本，對部署長程代理具實務價值。
papers.title: ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context
papers.title_zh: ContextRender：從執行相依性到代理上下文管理

links.title: EnterpriseBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise-Level Strategic Reasoning and Decision-Making

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments with nine agent methods under four backbone models show that current agents have not yet achieved stable, comprehensive, and cross-task reliability'; code 'publicly available' at github.com/sduyangmin/FirmBench

Section 2.3: Consulting uses 423 curated MBA casebook cases with hidden facts and an LLM interviewer; Beer Game is a 25-step four-stage supply chain; EDT evaluates workforce/risk/project planning via accumulated earnings

Section 4.3 / Appendix A.10: expanded transcript-level validation on 500 method-case transcripts with three human annotators achieves Pearson r=0.887, 85.0% within-one-point agreement, human ICC(2,3)=0.892; prompt robustness max deviation 0.12 points

Appendix A.9, Table 5: under DeepSeek-V4-Pro the BeerGame column reports 4.67 for CoT, Reflexion, Debate, Discussion, and GEPA (with Self-refine 4.64, AMEM 2.99), an unexplained repeated value pattern
Section 4.4: AOA adaptive routing achieves overall QA score 0.729 vs ACE's 0.725, described by authors as a 'modest' gain from rule synthesis over execution traces
Appendix A.11, Table 9: resource budgets show GEPA uses 13.84 calls and ~48.9K tokens per sample versus CoT's 1.00 call and ~1.1K tokens at the same 0.94-0.98 accuracy on the 50-instance probe

Limitations: benchmark is text-only, uses controlled environments, covers nine methods and four backbones, and results 'should not be interpreted as evidence that LLM agents are ready for autonomous deployment'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent evaluation paper (agents, multi-agent methods, LLM-as-judge, prompt-optimization baselines) with a genuinely useful interactive layer: simulated consulting interviews, Beer Game, and an Enterprise Digital Twin simulator, going beyond static financial QA. Novelty is solid but incremental: Beer Game and reorganized QA datasets are adaptations, and the AOA routing proof-of-concept yields only 0.725→0.729. Rigor strengths include four backbones, resource-budget accounting (A.11), and expanded human validation (500 transcripts, r=0.887, ICC(2,3)=0.892 in A.10). Weaknesses: no seed/variance reporting for stochastic simulations (EDT has stochastic extensions/follow-ons), an unexplained near-tie 0.725 vs 0.729, and Table 5 (A.9) shows the identical BeerGame cost 4.67 for five of seven methods under DeepSeek-V4-Pro, an internal consistency red flag. Evidence is reasonably strong for the judge-validation claims but weaker for headline method rankings. Reproducibility is supported by a public GitHub link, full prompts (A.2-A.4), and simulation configs (A.5-A.6), though proprietary casebook-sourced Consulting cases and non-public backbones limit replication. Limitations section appropriately scopes claims (text-only, controlled environments).

primary_link.title: EnterpriseBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise-Level Strategic Reasoning and Decision-Making

papers.summary: LLM agents are increasingly expected to support enterprise workflows, where tasks often involve missing information, uncertainty, feedback, and long-term trade-offs. However, existing enterprise and financial benchmarks mainly test static capabilities such as information extraction, numerical calculation, domain knowledge, and financial QA, leaving interactive and long-horizon decision-making underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnterpriseBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLM agents a
papers.summary_zh: 現有企業與金融基準大多著重靜態能力，例如資訊擷取、數值計算與財務問答，難以評估 LLM 代理在資訊不完整、回饋延遲與長期權衡下的互動式決策。本文提出 EnterpriseBench，採雙層評測架構：基礎層將既有企業與金融問答資料集重整為資訊擷取、數值計算、領域知識與複雜推理四大類，並標註 0 至 10 的難度分數；互動層則引入三項專業任務，包括以 MBA 顧問案例進行多輪資訊蒐集的 Consulting、模擬四階供應鏈庫存控制的 Beer Game，以及規劃人力、風險與專案組合的企業數位分身（EDT）。作者以九種代理方法搭配四種骨幹模型（DeepSeek-V3、GPT-4.1、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.2）進行實驗，發現靜態問答表現無法可靠預測互動任務成效，最佳方法也隨任務與模型而異；概念驗證的自適應路由方法 AOA 僅將整體問答分數由 0.725 微幅提升至 0.729。可靠性方面，顧問任務的 LLM 評審與人類評分相關性達 r=0.887，提示詞變異造成的分數偏移不超過 0.12 分，難度標註與專家評分相關性達 r=0.96。論文亦坦言任務屬受控環境、僅涵蓋文字場景，結果不宜解讀為代理已能自主執行高風險商業決策。整體而言，此基準為企業級策略推理與決策評測提供了更貼近實務的標準化平台。

links.title: HARISSA: Inference-Time Self-Checks for Efficient and Safe Local Language Model Deployment

evidence: Abstract: 'within one accuracy point of chain-of-thought at 2.7 times lower latency'
Section 5.1: 'On MedQA it answers 85.7% of queries correctly at 33.0 s against chain-of-thought's 86.2% at 81.0 s'
Table 1 (Server): HARISSA 81.8% @ 11.6 s vs FrugalGPT 69.4% @ 11.4 s on MedQA
Table 6: ablations 'HARISSA without fine-tuning 83.2% @ 36.5 s' vs 85.7% @ 33.0 s on device MedQA
Section 6.2: 'Each probe is calibrated within one size... comparing two such outputs does not pick the better size. The policy therefore cascades'
Appendix B: LoRA rank 16, alpha 32, per-size probed layers (layer 32 for 4B/9B, 64 for 27B)
Appendix E: replication on 'Gemma 4 E4B' and 'Cogito v1 8B' with Table 9 marked 'test split, one seed'
Appendix C: latency computed from prefill/per-token rates 'measured for each size on one NVIDIA A40'
Reproducibility Statement: 'The fine-tuning, probe, and cascade code, the configuration of every run, and the graded answers behind every table are in the supplementary material'
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM-methodology paper on inference-time self-assessment for local deployment: hidden-state probes decide compute allocation (CoT vs direct, model size) and deferral to a human. Highly relevant to LLM inference/efficiency, CoT routing, selective prediction, and probing preferences. The unified prefill+answer-state policy under one latency/deferral objective is a sensible but incremental combination of existing pieces (Kadavath-style prefill probes, Azaria/Orgad-style answer-state probes, FrugalGPT/Self-REF cascades, learning-to-defer); the honest Section 6.2 analysis that calibrated probes cannot compare across sizes is a genuine insight. Rigor is solid: three benchmarks, two settings, baselines (FrugalGPT, Self-REF, self-consistency), ablations (no skip, no answer check, no fine-tuning in Table 6), latency-price sensitivity (Table 8), and replication on Gemma 4 and Cogito (Appendix E). Spot-checked claims hold: 85.7% @ 33.0 s vs CoT 86.2% @ 81.0 s on MedQA (Section 5.1); server MedQA 81.8% @ 11.6 s vs FrugalGPT 69.4% @ 11.4 s (Table 1). Weaknesses: multiple-choice tasks only, per-task labeled training data required for fine-tuning, one seed for most cells (Tables 9, 11, 12), and latency modeled from measured rates on an A40 rather than end-to-end wall-clock (disclosed in Appendix C). Reproducibility statement is strong with code, configs, graded answers, LoRA/layer details in Appendix B. Not a pure domain application; no instruction-following from paper text was detected.

primary_link.title: HARISSA: Inference-Time Self-Checks for Efficient and Safe Local Language Model Deployment

papers.summary: Running a language model locally offers advantages in privacy, latency, and cost, but local hardware fits only small models, which are less capable than frontier models. The usual remedy for a hard query, escalating it to a cloud model, gives up the privacy and cost advantages of running locally. A deployment that stays local faces two decisions for hard queries instead. First, it can spend more computation on a query, e.g., reasoning before answering, which raises accuracy at a cost in latency,
papers.summary_zh: 本地執行語言模型能保留隱私、低延遲與成本優勢，但本地硬體只裝得下小型模型，遇到困難查詢容易答錯，又不能交給雲端處理。本地部署因此必須自行決定：哪些查詢值得投入更多運算（效率），哪些答案不可靠、應轉介給人類（安全）。作者提出 HARISSA，利用模型自身隱藏狀態同時處理這兩項決定：prefill 狀態（生成任何 token 前）預測模型是否會答對，answer 狀態（答案結尾）預測已生成的答案是否正確。經 LoRA fine-tuning、線性探針與 isotonic regression 校準後，單一策略從最便宜到最昂貴的回答方式級聯推進：prefill 機率低於門檻就跳過該方式，answer 機率夠高就交付答案，最後仍不確定則轉介人類。實驗涵蓋 MedQA、MedMCQA 與 BBH：在裝置上以 Qwen 3.5 4B 部署時，HARISSA 平均準確率只落後 chain-of-thought 不到一個百分點，延遲卻低 2.7 倍；在搭載 2B 至 27B 四種尺寸的伺服器上，相同延遲下準確率高於 FrugalGPT 與 Self-REF 級聯；在相同轉介率下，answer 機率於六組任務與設定配對中的五組，留下的錯誤答案少於序列概似、logit margin 與 Self-REF 信心。分析亦顯示 answer 狀態預測正確性的 AUROC 高於 prefill 狀態，且 fine-tuning 能提升探針表現而不大幅改變模型答案。限制包括：級聯最終準確率仍可能不及最大模型、轉介需人類在場、需要標註資料進行 fine-tuning，且探針僅能在單一尺寸內比較、難以跨尺寸挑選模型。整體而言，此研究證明小型模型可憑自身內部訊號，在效率與安全之間取得平衡，對醫療、法律等重視隱私的本地部署場景極具價值。

evidence: Section 2.1: analysis of six pretrained models (Gemma-2B/7B, Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B, Mistral-7B, Llama-3-8B) on 1,024 non-overlapping 256-token FineWeb sample-10BT contexts with a 1,023-endpoint bank

Appendix E: document-level one-sided t-tests show positive own-endpoint margin from the first measured layer in all six models, but p-values are unadjusted for multiple testing across layers
Appendix F: controls include excluding same-document endpoints, a separate 2,000-context sample matching 50 frequent final input tokens, and removing the input-token embedding direction (Eq. 64)

Appendix L: 'Extraction and analysis code, per-context residual arrays, fitted endpoint models, and random seeds are not included' and are 'needed to independently reproduce the reported numerical results'

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-interpretability research: analyzes residual-stream geometry in six pretrained LLMs (Gemma, Qwen2.5, Mistral, Llama-3) via a novel endpoint-bank competitor framework, supported by proofs (straight-path nestedness), controls (document exclusion, input-token matching, embedding-direction removal), bootstrap uncertainty, and held-out distribution fitting that beats a uniform-sphere baseline in all six models (Appendix I.3, Table 3). Rigor is high, with unusually explicit caveats (unadjusted layerwise p-values in Appendix E, non-joint bootstraps, precision limits). Limitations: purely observational with no causal interventions (acknowledged in Section 4), single dataset/context length/final-token position limiting generalizability, and no code, data, or seeds released (Appendix L), which substantially hampers independent reproduction.

papers.summary_zh: 本文探討 Transformer 語言模型在推論過程中,中間殘差狀態如何逐步變得專屬於其最終表徵。作者提出「幾何推論假說」,以固定端點庫實證檢驗:針對六個預訓練模型(Gemma-2B/7B、Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B、Mistral-7B、Llama-3-8B),取 FineWeb 的 1,024 個 256-token 上下文,將每條軌跡的最終殘差狀態(自身端點)與其他上下文的端點比較,定義在歐氏與餘弦距離下更貼近中間狀態的「競爭者」集合。主要結果:從最早可測層起,平均而言自身端點已較貼近,但個別競爭者仍眾多;競爭者數量隨深度下降,惟成員有進有出,違反正路徑收斂會形成巢狀集合的理論基準;方向對齊可持續改善,而歐氏距離卻近乎停滯;共享軸高維模型顯示漸進對齊能造成競爭者數量驟減;輸出機率較低的 token 對應餘弦距離較遠的端點。僅以最終端點擬合的投射常態分布在六個模型中的五個最能預測留出軌跡的競爭比例,優於均勻球面基線,vMF 混合模型居次。限制:幾何僅解釋部分輸出變異、殘差更新的來源與時機未解、競爭集合依賴端點庫與度量選擇,觀察到的成員更替亦不代表模型內部有顯式搜尋過程。本研究的價值在於將最終表徵幾何與中間狀態的精煉過程量化連結,為理解 Transformer 推論的專屬性形成提供新視角。

Novelty is a moderate increment: reward-free search via self-modification experience is a new combination over DGM/HGM/STOP/SICA (Table 13), but experience sharing and self-modifying scaffolds exist in prior work the paper itself cites. Rigor is solid — ablations (Table 4), evaluation-guided baselines (Table 2), cross-model transfer (Table 3), formal cost metrics (Appendix C.4) — but weakened by single search runs per configuration, no significance testing on small eval sets (60–120 tasks where 2–3 tasks swing a point), and an explicitly acknowledged non-budget-matched baseline comparison (Appendix C.3). Reproducibility documentation is extensive (prompts, task IDs, pricing) though no explicit code/artifact release is stated.

evidence: Abstract/§3: SCSP partitions documents into sentence-aware chunks, appends a 'Brief summary:' prompt per chunk, and uses a prompt-isolated attention mask (Eq. in §3.3) so prompts do not contaminate document representations.
§3.4: Token importance is the max attention over layers/heads from each prompt's final token, with selection threshold s > α/|C_i| relative to uniform attention.
§4.1: Evaluation on QMSum, 2WikiMQA, SumFD, NQA, MultiFieldQA with nDCG@10; α is grid-searched over the evaluation settings with no held-out dev set.
Tables 1-2 (§4.3): SCSP improves Vanilla Mean, Echo Mean, and HTP for Mistral-7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B at 512/8192 tokens; largest gain +15.94 avg (Echo Mean + SCSP, LLaMA, 8192).
Table 3 (§4.4): Random token selection scores 32.66 vs Vanilla Mean 32.44, showing gains come from identifying informative tokens, not fewer tokens; removing the compression prompt drops avg by 4.77.
Tables 4 and 6 (§4.7, §4.9): Gains transfer to Gemma2-9B (+4.34), Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (+1.76), and fine-tuned GritLM (+11.33) and NV-Embed (+3.06).
Appendix A/B, Tables 7-8: Robustness across prompt phrasings and +5.00 avg on 8 LOCOV1 datasets.
Section titled 'Github' exists after the abstract but contains no verifiable URL in the provided document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: training-free long-context embeddings from LLMs via attention-based selective pooling. Strongly matches LLM, transformer/attention, prompting, long-context, and embedding/dense-retrieval preferences. The core idea (chunk-wise semantic compression prompts as intrinsic token-importance signals, with a prompt-isolated attention mask) is a sensible but incremental extension of PromptEOL/TP/Echo/HTP and is close in spirit to landmark pooling; attention-as-importance is a well-worn signal. Rigor is good but not airtight: α, chunk size, and output layer are grid-searched directly on the evaluation benchmarks with no dev/test split, no significance tests or variance reported, and only nDCG@10 on 5+8 datasets. Evidence is nevertheless substantial: consistent average gains (+2.40 to +15.94 across Tables 1-2), coherent ablations (random selection ≈ Vanilla Mean, Table 3), prompt-variant robustness (Table 7), and generalization to 4 backbones and fine-tuned GritLM/NV-Embed (Tables 4, 6) plus LOCOV1 (Table 8). Reproducibility is moderate: detailed hyperparameters, public datasets, and a 'Github' section heading, but no verifiable code URL in the document.

links.title: It's Not What the Image Shows: Irrelevant Context Destabilises VLM Judges Without Informing Them

evidence: Abstract: 'Across thirteen VLM judges, an aligned image changed 20.5% of labels and a misleading one 19.4%, close for every judge and both above the 11.6% produced by deleting the ignore-the-image instruction' — presence over content result with prompt-edit control.

Section 3.2 Results: 'Of these, 37% move toward the sense the misleading image depicts and 63% move away from it... Every judge that passes the alt-test falls below chance' — quantitative support for the no-content-steering claim.

Section 2 Human annotation: 'Fleiss kappa 0.65 and 0.57, p=0.22' for the two trios; Appendix E.1 adds 10,000-resample bootstrap intervals and two-sided Welch t-tests (blind p=0.27, informed p=0.92) with explicit power statements (~0.15/0.20 resolvable effects).

Appendix B Limitations: 'Only two images, both phrase-relevant', 'No human change rate... the human figure remains an assumption of this design rather than a measurement', and 'All items are English, drawn from one corpus' — honest scope bounding.

Section 2 footnote 1: dataset and all human/VLM labels released at huggingface.co/datasets/naghamo/mist-vlm-judges; Appendix D fixes random.seed(123) and names the source AdMIRe-derived release; Appendix I reproduces the full prompt template.

Section 3.1: 13 judges, '4 x (1 + 2 x 2) = 20 labels per item, 52,000 in total, decoded greedily with the output constrained to the four labels'; Appendix F gives per-judge change rates for all 13 including the six non-passing judges.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A VLM-as-judge robustness/evaluation methodology paper squarely within preference space: LLM judges (GPT-5.2, Gemini, Qwen, Gemma families), LLM-as-judge substitutability (alt-test), prompting factors (zero-shot/few-shot/CoT crossed with explicit vs silent image arms), and invariance testing. Novel contribution: a label-preserving cross-modal stress test showing judge instability from mere image presence rather than image content, which no prior substitutability or irrelevant-context work measures. Rigor is high: seeded construction, two human trios with Fleiss kappa 0.65/0.57, bootstrap CIs and Welch t-tests on human contrasts, a prompt-edit control, 52,000 judge labels over a 13-judge x 4-prompt grid, and an unusually candid limitations section (no human change-rate baseline, only two phrase-relevant images, partially ordinal scale, slack selection in alt-test reporting). Evidence is strong for the central negative result (37% toward-image vs 50% chance, 71% of movement stays within the figurative-literal side). Generalizability is the weak point: one English task (idiom annotation) from one source corpus, reasoning modes disabled, and authors themselves flag scope as the next question. Reproducibility is good: HF dataset release, full prompts in Appendix I, seed and source dataset named, though proprietary judge versions may drift.

We introduce MIST, the Misleading-Image Stress Test: 200 English sentences, each built around a phrase readable either figuratively or literally and shown with an aligned image depicting its reading, a misleading image depicting the opposite, or no image at all. The guidelines require the label to be deci
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討當視覺語言模型(VLM)取代人類標註者時,可替代性測試(如 alt-test)的結論是否穩健,還是只是測量條件的產物。作者提出 MIST(Misleading-Image Stress Test):200 個含慣用語的英文句子,每句搭配一致影像(呈現句中語義)、誤導影像(呈現相反語義)或無影像;指引要求標籤僅由句子決定,影像屬於應被忽略的無關情境,故任何標籤改變都是錯誤。研究以四種提示技術,並搭配明示或沉默的影像指令,評估十三個 VLM 評審,共產生 52,000 個標籤。主要結果:對七個至少在一種配置下通過 alt-test 的評審,加上影像會改變 15.9%(一致)與 14.7%(誤導)的標籤,皆高於僅刪除「忽略影像」指令時的 11.6% 對照值;但改變的標籤只有 37% 朝影像呈現的語義移動,低於 50% 的隨機水準,且與人類多數決的一致性(約 54%)不受影像影響。未通過 alt-test 的六個評審波動更大(25.8%),顯示此效果普遍存在,但程度因模型而異。限制包括:僅比較兩張與片語相關的影像、缺乏人類自身的變動率基準、資料全部來自英文慣用語語料。本文的意義在於:可替代性判決同時描述了模型與配置,部署報告應一併揭露提示詞與附帶的無關情境。

links.title: Concealing LLM-Based Multi-Agent Topology via Phantom Structure Injection

evidence: Abstract: Mirage 'operates in three stages: phantom topology synthesis, semantic edge realization, and protected MAS execution' to reduce topology inference effectiveness while preserving task utility.

Sec. 3 (Threat Model): adversary is strictly black-box and 'cannot modify agent configurations, communication edges, or any other internal component'; defense is designed against CIA (Wu et al., 2026) only.
Sec. 5.1 (Datasets): 'we sample 100 tasks from each dataset for evaluation' across MMLU, GSM8K, SVAMP, HumanEval.

Table 1: with G-Designer, Mirage lowers topology inference AUC from 0.79/0.81/0.72/0.78 (Instruction baseline) to 0.67/0.64/0.64/0.68 and ACC/F1 to ~0.44-0.52/0.39-0.52 across MMLU/GSM8K/SVAMP/HumanEval.
Sec. 5.2 (Ablation/Parameter Analysis): ablation 'using G-Designer on MMLU' only (Fig. 8a); rho_0 shows concealment-utility trade-off, M saturates beyond 5.
Sec. 5.2 (Utility Preservation): claims task utility 'largely preserved' with 'only minor performance variations', but quantitative utility values appear only in Fig. 7, not in text.

Sec. 4.2: phantom evidence s^ph_{j->i} generated by LLM generator M_phi per phantom edge and M paraphrase candidates per agent per query; no cost or latency analysis is reported anywhere in the paper.
No code, data, or artifact availability statement appears in the document; implementation details are deferred to App. C/D.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: a defense method for LLM-based multi-agent systems against black-box topology inference (CIA), squarely in LLM/agents/AI-safety territory. The problem (topology confidentiality of MAS) is genuinely underexplored and the phantom-topology dual-view design is a novel combination of k-anonymity and dependency-obfuscation ideas, though the ingredients are familiar. Rigor is mixed: three topology frameworks and four benchmarks with baselines, ablation, and parameter sweeps, but evaluation is against a single non-adaptive attack (CIA), ablation/parameter analysis restricted to G-Designer on MMLU, only 100 sampled tasks per dataset, and no compute/latency overhead analysis despite generating M paraphrases plus phantom evidence per agent per query. Evidence is moderate: Table 1 gives concrete AUC/ACC/F1 reductions (e.g., AUC 0.79->0.67 on MMLU, 0.81->0.64 on GSM8K), but utility preservation, ablation, PPL-detection, and case-study results live in figures with no numbers in the text and no significance testing. Generalizability is decent across frameworks/datasets but confined to DAG topologies and one adversary model. Reproducibility is weak: no code/data release, and implementation details (generator model, agent backbones) are deferred to appendices not verifiable here. Overall a relevant, reasonably solid, but incrementally evidenced paper.

primary_link.title: Concealing LLM-Based Multi-Agent Topology via Phantom Structure Injection

radar.summary: Driven by the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for collaborative reasoning over complex tasks. A key design element of MAS is the communication topology, which governs information flow among agents and often encodes proprietary knowledge about the system architecture. However, recent work has shown that such topologies can be inferred even in black-box settings by exploiting semantic dependencies in observa
radar.summary_zh: LLM 多代理人系統（MAS）的通訊拓撲編碼了系統設計的專有知識，但 CIA 攻擊顯示黑箱攻擊者可從可觀察推理軌跡的語意依賴重建拓撲，造成智慧財產外洩與結構性弱點暴露的風險。本文提出 Mirage 防禦框架，將任務執行與對外交互解耦：①幽靈拓撲合成—在保留執行順序與連通性的約束下，以邊重接建構拓撲匿名集合，選出與真實拓撲偏差足夠大的幽靈拓撲；②語意邊實現—透過幻影邊具象化生成看似合理的依賴證據，並以受控改寫進行真實邊混淆，抑制隱藏真實邊的語意線索；③受保護執行—雙視圖設計使內部訊息傳遞仍依真實拓撲進行，而對外暴露的軌跡則塑形為幽靈拓撲。實驗涵蓋 G-Designer、AGP、ARG-Designer 三種拓撲最佳化框架與 MMLU、GSM8K、SVAMP、HumanEval 四個基準，顯示 Mirage 大幅壓低推斷攻擊的 AUC、ACC 與 F1，AUC 降至 0.64 至 0.68、接近隨機猜測，且優於 Instruction 與 Delimiters 等基線，任務準確率僅輕微下滑。消融與參數分析證實幻影邊具象化與真實邊混淆缺一不可，結構偏差門檻 ρ0 決定保護與效用間的權衡，改寫候選數 M 超過 5 後效益飽和。限制在於需額外的生成與改寫運算開銷，且防禦主要針對 CIA 式黑箱推斷，對其他攻擊情境仍待驗證。此研究首次系統性處理 MAS 拓撲機密性，對保護專有架構與防範針對性攻擊深具意義。

Limitations section: 'TADM's generation quality degrades at larger anchor refresh intervals' and post-train accuracy 'is constrained by the capabilities of its frozen pretrained backbone'
Table 3 (Appendix D): zero-shot perplexities show TADM behind ADLM on most datasets (e.g., Lambada 46.04 vs 44.93; Wikitext 35.03 vs 32.45) while competitive with MDLM/SEDD
No code or model release is mentioned anywhere in the document; corruption evaluation (Table 6, Appendix E) uses Qwen3-30B as an unvalidated LLM judge
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core language-model methodology work squarely in scope: diffusion LMs (LLaDA/Dream/DiffusionGemma cited), inference-time latent caching, throughput/compute optimization, and distillation-based post-training. The technical contribution is a credible but incremental extension of ADLM (same research lineage, heavily reused machinery): 'time-based' self-supervised anchors trained to tolerate staleness plus a small gated fusion module, formalized via a T-ANELBO whose proof largely re-derives ADLM's Theorem 4.1. Rigor is solid: refresh-interval sweeps (Table 4), a naive-caching baseline showing ADLM/DiffusionGemma degrade under reuse while TADM does not (Tables 5-6), honest zero-shot results where TADM trails ADLM (Table 3), and a stated limitations section. Weaknesses: no confidence intervals, AIME26 has only 30 problems so ±1pp swings are one item, corruption metric relies on an unvalidated LLM judge, pretraining throughput measured over only 20 generations, layer-call compute accounting omits attention/FLOPs, and no code or checkpoint release is claimed. Generalizability is limited by demonstration on one 26B post-training host plus one 224M scratch model; the method requires internal layer splits. Reproducibility is helped by exhaustive hyperparameters and public datasets but the 262B-token pretraining is expensive and no artifact availability is stated.

links.title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization

evidence: Abstract: reports relative improvements over Meta-Harness of 34.8% on Olympiad-level math, 11.6% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 3.8% on SWE-bench Lite, 'with harness selection and router configuration based solely on development data'.

Section 4.1: small development/test splits (250 dev / 200 held-out IMO-level math problems; 30/58 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks; 50/250 SWE-bench Lite tasks) with one candidate harness per branch per iteration and B=2 branches, N=20 iterations.

Section 4.5 Table 3b: ablation combining development pruning and optimizer updates reaches 62.0% vs 51.0% with neither, 50.0% with optimizer updates alone, and 54.0% with pruning alone on Math-Gemini.

Section 4.4: router 'remains 4.4-5.5% below combined coverage' and falls short of the stronger head by one test case on Math-Sonnet and SWE-bench Lite; recovers 75.0% of head-exclusive successes on Math-Gemini.
Appendix A Table 5: full-run token usage for ours vs Meta-Harness totals 172.90M vs 79.92M (math), 4,001.39M vs 2,366.80M (Terminal-Bench 2.0), 2,951.48M vs 1,907.17M (SWE-bench Lite).

Conclusion: authors state 'unequal total token usage and limited repeated evaluations constrain conclusions about efficiency and reliability' and that trajectory changes are not established as causal for test gains.
Appendix C.1 and D.1: full proposer-guidance update prompts and router instruction templates are reproduced, but no code, data, or artifact release is mentioned anywhere in the paper.

Section 4.6 Table 4: test-best harnesses from our pool reach 58.0/32.5/50.0/66.4 vs Meta-Harness 49.0/32.5/46.6/63.6, and Meta-Harness itself gains 3-3.5 points from test-based selection, indicating development-test selection noise.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-fit LLM-agent paper: branching search over agent harnesses with evolving development subsets, branch-local proposal guidance, and development-informed routing, evaluated on math reasoning, Terminal-Bench 2.0, and SWE-bench Lite. Methodologically, it is an incremental but sensible extension of Meta-Harness: dynamic development-subset ownership via comparative frontier coverage is the main new idea, while guidance adaptation and expert routing recombine known techniques (SkillOpt, GEPA, FrugalGPT-style routing). Rigor is mixed: clean held-out protocol with development-only selection (Section 4.1: 250/200 math, 30/58 TB2.0, 50/250 SWE splits), component and frequency ablations (Table 3), and honest test-best gap analysis (Section 4.6); however, only B=2 branches, single runs without variance or significance tests on small test sets (differences of 1-3 cases, e.g., 29.0->30.5 on Math-Sonnet), fixed hyperparameters (q=5, Delta=2) without sensitivity analysis, and substantially higher token cost (Appendix A: 172.90M vs 79.92M total on math, ~1.5-2.2x elsewhere) weaken claims. Evidence strength is moderate: consistent quantitative tables and trajectory/case studies, but headline relative gains (34.8%) rest on one large setting while others are marginal, and the router falls below the stronger head in two of four settings (Section 4.4). No code or artifact release is stated anywhere, and the pipeline depends on proprietary models (Claude Opus 4.6 proposer, Gemini 3 Flash / Claude Sonnet 4.5 action models), limiting reproducibility. Generalizability is plausible but untested beyond three agentic domains with one action model per coding benchmark.

evidence: Section 3.2 / Figure 3: the same router evaluated on the noisy pass yields the prior p(z|x_t) and on the clean pass the posterior, 'no recognition model is added and no prior over the latent has to be designed' (Section 1 contributions).
Section 5.3, Table 4: at NFE=1 E-MoE reaches Gen-PPL 643.8 (H=4.35) vs MDLM 1433.8 and VADD 1270.8; at NFE=2, 383.7 vs 763.2/997.5, i.e., the claimed 2–2.6x few-step gain.
Appendix C.3.2, Table 9: switching the trained checkpoint to greedy routes (τ_s→0) raises Gen-PPL 1.72x at NFE=1 and 2.14x at NFE=2 toward MDLM, isolating the mixture as the source of the gain.

Appendix B.3, Table 7: E-MoE totals 536.1M but 139.4M active parameters per token vs MDLM's 139.3M, supporting the equal-active-parameter comparison; training protocol (1M steps, batch 512, 65B tokens) is specified.

Appendix C.3.3, Figure 9: routing KL settles at ~0.65 nats/token without warmup while VADD's Gaussian KL stays near ~0.14, evidencing the discrete latent remains in use (anti posterior-collapse claim).
Section 5.2, Table 3: Binarized-MNIST test BPD 0.062 (E-MoE, 2.49M params) vs VADD 0.064 (2.50M) and MDLM 0.077 (2.07M).

Appendix B.3: 'Our evaluation reproduces official publicly reported test perplexities (31.90 against 31.87 for MDLM and 22.83 against 22.8 for the AR transformer), which validates the correctness of the pipeline.'

Appendix D Limitations: benefit diminishes as NFE grows and 'if the noisy router cannot recover the clean routing decisions... the mixture degenerates toward a single factorized component'; Reproducibility Statement commits code to supplementary materials.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope language-model methodology: a masked diffusion LM whose reverse process becomes a mixture of factorized distributions over discrete routing latents, directly addressing few-step generation quality (Scaling/Efficiency, MoE architecture, text generation preferences). The core idea—reusing the MoE router as both variational prior and posterior without a recognition network or extra active parameters—is a genuinely new angle versus continuous-latent VADD and copula/correlated-output alternatives. Rigor is solid for the scale: matched training budgets, matched active parameters (139.4M vs 139.3M), a derived ELBO with proofs, a pipeline validated against published MDLM/AR perplexities, and a targeted ablation showing the mixture (not capacity) drives the gain. Evidence is consistent across 2D toys, binarized MNIST (BPD 0.062 vs 0.064/0.077) and LM1B (Gen-PPL 643.8 vs 1270.8/1433.8 at NFE=1, MAUVE 24.6% vs 3.8%/3.0% at NFE=2), but all experiments are small-scale (139M, LM1B, L=128) with bespoke metrics (Gen-PPL under GPT-2 judge, hand-defined 'validity'), leaving scaling claims to the limitations discussion rather than demonstrated. Generalizability is plausible for MoE-based diffusion LLMs (e.g., LLaDA-MoE) but untested beyond tiny backbones; code is promised in supplementary material with detailed hyperparameters, but no public release is confirmed. Score: 0.4*0.75 + 0.15*0.7 + 0.15*0.65 + 0.15*0.65 + 0.1*0.6 + 0.05*0.6 ≈ 0.69.

evidence: Abstract: retrieval-guided framework builds a knowledge base of domain, reasoning, and format cards and composes capability modules per instruction.
Section 5.1 (Implementation details): LLaVA-v1.5-7B with CLIP ViT-L/14-336, K0=8, δ=1, ρ=0.99, Qwen3-Embedding-4B, GPT-4o mini for offline knowledge construction.
Section 5.2 / Tables 1-2: UCIT average 70.65 vs SAME 67.12; CoIN average 69.10 vs SAME 66.82; vanilla-RAG controls give LoRA-FT+RAG 58.87 and SAME+RAG 65.74 on UCIT.

Section 5.3 / Table 3: ablations show w/o Adaptive Subspace Recycling 49.88 and w/o Core Routing 31.50, but w/o Domain Guidance 70.02 and w/o Reasoning-Guided Ordering 70.08 (marginal drops from 70.65).
Table 4 (Section 5.3): ρ sensitivity from 0.50 (67.49) to 1.0 (66.52), best at 0.99 (70.67), with protected ranks 1.01-8.37.
Appendix E: Propositions E.1 (exact preservation under QR reparameterization and zero-padded expansion) and E.2 (residual-energy bound ≤1-ρ) with proofs.
Appendix C / Table 5-6: fixed retrieval and routing coefficients with sensitivity analysis; balanced-retrieval variant drops to 67.41.
Appendix G / Tables 9-10: 25.340M trainable parameters, lowest peak inference memory (14.73 GB), mixed device-hour results vs HiDe-LLaVA.
Limitations: knowledge base limited to concise textual cards; no code-release statement appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-methodology paper: continual instruction tuning of LLaVA's language layers with a retrieval-guided knowledge base (domain/reasoning/format cards), capability-path composition, and energy-based subspace recycling over factorized LoRA-style modules. Strong match to LLM (2.5), RAG & Knowledge (1.8), Training & Optimization (1.5), and partial match to Reasoning (2.5) and Multimodal (1.8); it is not pure vision. Novelty is solid but not exceptional: retrieval-organized parameterized modules for MCIT is a fresh combination, while the shared-basis/protected-subspace machinery is a refinement of known orthogonal/importance-protection continual learning ideas. Rigor is good: two benchmarks, eight baselines including recent SAME/SEFE/HiDe-LLaVA, vanilla-RAG controls isolating external-knowledge effects (Section 5.2), component ablations, ρ/δ/coefficient sensitivity, and two proved propositions (Appendix E). Weaknesses: single backbone (LLaVA-v1.5-7B), no variance/significance reporting, small gains from domain guidance and reasoning ordering (70.65 vs 70.02/70.08 in Table 3), and per-task losses on IconQA/CLEVR/Flickr30k despite average wins (+3.53 UCIT, +2.28 CoIN). Reproducibility is aided by full hyperparameters, fixed coefficients (Table 5), and prompts (Appendix B), but no code release is stated and GPT-4o mini/external-search construction introduces nondeterminism.

links.title: Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?

evidence: Abstract: SDG 'has a small effective dimensionality (~10 dimensions for Ministral 3 (3B))' and the model performs dimensionality reduction in early layers.
Sec 4.1 Ablation: 'Ablating the top 15 dimensions of the SDG decreases model accuracy by 12.9%, boosting them increases accuracy by 3.9%, whereas ablating a random subspace has a negligible effect.'
Sec 5.2, Eqs. (9)-(12): linear self-attention with chosen W_KQ/W_OV implements a gradient step minimizing Gram error E(Z), with local exponential convergence O(exp(-4*eta*lambda_M*l)).

Appendix C.2: numerical validation under causal masking, softmax, normalization, and three initializations reaches relative Gram error below 1e-5; causal masking slows convergence but does not prevent it.
Sec 5.1/Fig 4 (Right): 'random label assignment has close to no effect during the formation phase of Text SDG', ruling out supervision-driven compression during formation.
Appendix B.3 Table 5: effective dimension of Vision SDG depends on training domain (Textures 9.71, Aircraft 6.57, all-10-datasets 9.69), an honest caveat to the 'shared 10D' claim.
Appendix E Table 8: Text SDG effective dimension 7.46-10.28 across Ministral 3 (3B/8B), Qwen 3.5 (4B/9B), and Qwen 3 (4B).
Sec 6 Table 2: SDG ablation hurts classification benchmarks (e.g., -17.0 Matching-classification split) but improves matching benchmarks (e.g., +6.5 VLGuard), delimiting scope of the geometry's role.
Limitations: 'Because our theoretical circuit assumes linear non-causal attention, it does not explain how LVLMs approximate it' and average pooling 'is a simplification'.

Reproducibility statement: 'The code is included in the supplementary material for reproducibility and will be publicly released'; Sec B.1 specifies single A100 80GB, ~3h20m training, full optimizer settings.
Sec 4.2 Table 1: staged ablations (Text SDG at l*-1: -3.2, Vision SDG at l*-1: -6.4, vision-to-text attention: -5.2, Text SDG at l*: -11.4) support the two-step formation circuit.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic-interpretability study of in-context learning inside LVLM/LLM decoders: it identifies a shared ~10-dimensional linearly separable subspace (SDG), gives a linear-attention theory of in-context PCA-like dimensionality reduction with a convergence proof, and supports claims with controlled interventions. Strongly matches Interpretability (1.8), Multimodal AI (1.8), ICL/prompting (1.5), and Transformer Architecture (1.2), and partially LLMs (2.5), but misses the heaviest preference clusters (Japanese LLM, reasoning, agents), capping relevance at ~0.6. Not pure computer vision: the object of study is the language-model decoder circuit, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply. Novelty is solid: claimed first showing linear transformers perform in-context dimensionality reduction, and a two-step vision-to-text formation circuit, though closely adjacent to von Oswald/Ahn gradient-descent-in-attention and existing subspace work. Rigor is high (Lean-verified proof, numerical validation relaxing causal/softmax/normalization assumptions, random-subspace controls, random-label control, 1000-task averages, 5 models), with honest limitations that the theoretical non-causal linear circuit is only indirectly matched in trained models and that effective dimension varies with setup/domain (6.57-11.08). Evidence is quantitative and intervention-based but the mechanism link remains correlational-plus-ablation rather than direct identification. Generalizability is moderate: consistent across five models and 10 vision datasets plus SST-2 and 7 multimodal benchmarks, but classification-centric, LVLM-family-only, and matching tasks show the opposite SDG effect. Reproducibility is good: code in supplementary with release promise, full hyperparameters (B.1), and public datasets.

links.title: Scaling Zero-Order Pretraining through Model Sharding

evidence: Abstract: SOMA N=2 with 64 perturbations reaches 1.76 test nats/byte at 150 aggregate GPU-hours vs 2.00-2.11 for monolithic SPSA (64/256/1024 perturbations) and 2.21 for EGGROLL at ~8.44M parameters.

Section 5 and Appendix F, Proposition 1: independent losses reduce relative gradient variance to ~1/N on a separable objective; Figure 11 shows 4.02x measured error reduction vs 4.00x predicted on SOMA N=4.
Section 6, External-corpus evaluation and Table 9: frozen checkpoints near 150 GPU-hours score 2.07 (SOMA N=2) vs 2.25-2.36 (monolithic SPSA) and 2.49 (EGGROLL) on WikiText-103.

Appendix I, Table 5: BPTT reaches lower ensemble validation loss at every tested budget (e.g., 1.0198 vs 2.1237 at 50 GPU-hours for N=1), explicitly showing no advantage over backpropagation for these recipes.

Appendix J: paired continuations with fixed weights, data, perturbations and compute show independent losses improve test loss by 0.035 nats/byte after 1,000 updates across three seeds, with variance reduced 3.19-4.64x.

Section 8, Tables 12-13: SOMA N=256 achieves 2.36M tokens/s vs 257k for SOMA N=8 (9.19x including routing) at lower test loss (1.68 vs 1.71), but uses 59.9x more aggregate training compute; Table 13 notes the endpoint comparison does not establish a matched-duration loss advantage.
Section 9 and Appendix O: limitations include one byte-level corpus, 8.44M parameters, mostly single-seed scaling runs, ~700 passes per shard at N=256, and a fixed tf-idf router that does not adapt.

Reproducibility statement and Appendix L: release of all training/evaluation code, checkpoints, plotted CSVs, frozen dataset manifest, and a CPU evaluation package with pinned dependencies and expected scores.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodology paper on zero-order (backprop-free) pretraining of language models via sharded LSTM expert ensembles (SOMA). Topic relevance is moderate: it matches LLM/pretraining, training-optimization, and scaling/efficiency preferences, but not the highest-weighted areas (reasoning, agents, Japanese NLP), and the models are tiny (8.44M params), limiting 'large language model' relevance. Novelty is solid: applying CBTM-style sharding to ZO pretraining with independent losses appears new, with a clean 1/N variance proposition and a novel inference-throughput analysis of heavily sharded ZO ensembles, though it recombines known ingredients (SPSA/ES + branch-train-merge). Rigor is high: formal proofs (Appendix F), variance predictions verified empirically (4.02x measured vs 4.00x predicted), a three-seed equal-tuning comparison (Table 7), paired controlled continuations (Appendix J), overlap-screened test set (Appendix L), and unusually honest reporting that BPTT beats ZO at every tested budget (Table 5). Evidence strength is good but bounded: headline comparisons are at ~150 GPU-hours with different update counts, the EGGROLL baseline is a GRU-based reproduction, most scaling runs are single-seed, and all conclusions are at 8.44M scale on one corpus family (plus WikiText-103 frozen eval). Generalizability is limited by explicit scope restrictions: byte-level LSTM experts, one fixed tf-idf router, single corpus, and unknown behavior at larger scale where ZO variance grows with dimension. Reproducibility is strong: detailed hyperparameters, compute accounting (Table 3), and specific release claims (code, checkpoints, CSVs, manifests, CPU evaluation package), though release could not be independently verified from the document.

links.title: CompOrca: Corpus-Scale Compliance Labelling of Instruction-Tuning Data

evidence: Abstract: unanimous compliance/noncompliance labels are '97.3% and 86.7% precise' against 450 human-annotated examples; 'Published refusal-detection methods recall only between 0.4% and 94.1%'.

Section 3: five independent passes of LongCat-2.0 (1x T=0, 4x T=0.7); Table 1: 94.75% unanimous compliance, 1.28% unanimous noncompliance, 3.97% nonunanimous; '21,169,615 classifications over 15.19B tokens'.
Section 4.2: human-human agreement 96.7% [92.4, 98.6], Cohen's kappa=0.933; unanimous labels agree with human labels on 97.2% of rows reweighted (CI [94.5, 99.2]).
Table 3 (Section 5): methods span 0.4% recall (Do-Not-Answer Longformer) to 94.1% (WildGuard) on human labels; WildGuard corpus-wide precision only 19.5% at 1.28% base rate.

Limitations: 'Five passes of one model improve self-consistency instead of correctness'; 4/150 sampled compliance rows human-labelled noncompliance imply 'a corpus-reweighted recall of 30.4%... CompOrca provides a subset of the corpus's noncompliance, rather than a complete enumeration'; validation set labelled by one author with a 150-row second annotation.
Appendix A-C: full judge prompt reproduced, codebook with 12 cases, and Appendix B Table 4 gives inference configuration; dataset and gold annotations released at HuggingFace links in Section 7.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A corpus-scale data-labelling contribution squarely within LLM scope: refusal/noncompliance labelling of the 4.2M-row OpenOrca instruction-tuning corpus using a five-pass LLM-as-judge protocol, with comparisons against six published refusal-detection methods. Strong preference match (LLMs, AI Safety, Alignment/RLHF data, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Data & Datasets) and not a domain application. Novelty is moderate: multi-pass judging for self-consistency is borrowed (Section 2 cites Wang et al. 2023), so the contribution is primarily scale and the first full row-level release, not methodological novelty. Rigor is reasonable but constrained: a 450-row human validation set with double annotation on 150 rows (Section 4.2), bootstrap CIs, corpus reweighting, and a second-judge check (Section 4.1), yet labels were authored mainly by one annotator who also wrote the judge prompt and codebook, and the Limitations section concedes unanimous compliance labels have only ~30.4% corpus-reweighted recall for noncompliance, i.e., the release is a high-precision subset, not an enumeration. Evidence strength is adequate with internally consistent tables (Tables 1-3), but the small, single-annotator validation set caps confidence in corpus-wide claims; honesty about incompleteness is a plus. Generalizability is moderate since findings on substring-list failure (12.6% precision, 6.3% recall) and single-pass judge instability (52-60% of flags fail unanimity) likely transfer, but labels are tied to one corpus, one judge model, and a broad noncompliance definition. Reproducibility is strong: judge prompt (Appendix A), inference config (Appendix B), codebook (Appendix C), dataset and gold labels released on HuggingFace, and the judge is open-weight, though it was served via a stealth endpoint.
